import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { getUserByUsername, saveUser } from '@/lib/users'

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { username } = (await request.json()) as { username?: string }
    if (!username) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
    const user = await getUserByUsername(String(username).slice(0, 30))
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 404 })
    user.views = (user.views || 0) + 1
    await saveUser(user)
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, views: user.views })
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
  }
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\proxy\route.ts
// ==========================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const url = searchParams.get('url')
  const referer = searchParams.get('referer') || 'https://hianime.to'

  if (!url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL gerekli' }, { status: 400 })

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'Referer': referer,
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'Origin': referer,
      }
    })

    const data = await res.text()
    
    // Eğer m3u8 dosyasıysa içindeki alt linkleri de proxy'e çevir
    let finalData = data
    if (url.includes('.m3u8') || data.includes('#EXTM3U')) {
      // m3u8 içindeki göreceli linkleri (segmentleri) proxy'e yönlendir
      const baseUrl = url.substring(0, url.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)
      finalData = data.split('\n').map((line: string) => {
        if (line.trim() && !line.startsWith('#')) {
          // Mutlak URL ise direkt, göreceli ise birleştir
          const absUrl = line.startsWith('http') ? line : new URL(line, baseUrl).toString()
          return `/api/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(absUrl)}&referer=${encodeURIComponent(referer)}`
        }
        return line
      }).join('\n')
    }

    return new NextResponse(finalData, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': url.includes('.ts') ? 'video/mp2t' : 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      }
    })
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Proxy bağlantı hatası' }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

import { quickSearch } from '@/lib/anilist'

export async function GET(request: Request) {

  if (q.length < 2) return NextResponse.json({ results: [] })
  const results = await quickSearch(q)
  return NextResponse.json({ results }, { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'public, s-maxage=600, stale-while-revalidate=3600' } })
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\stream\proxy\route.ts
// ==========================================
export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36'

const wrap = (u: string, ref: string) => `/api/stream/proxy?u=${Buffer.from(u).toString('base64url')}&r=${encodeURIComponent(ref)}`

function rewrite(text: string, base: string, ref: string) {
  return text
    .split('\n')
    .map((line) => {
      const t = line.trim()
      if (!t) return line
      if (t.startsWith('#')) return line.replace(/URI="([^"]+)"/g, (_, u: string) => `URI="${wrap(new URL(u, base).toString(), ref)}"`)
      return wrap(new URL(t, base).toString(), ref)
    })
    .join('\n')
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url)
  const target = Buffer.from(searchParams.get('u') ?? '', 'base64url').toString()
  const ref = searchParams.get('r') || 'https://animekai.to/'
  if (!/^https?:\/\//.test(target)) return new Response('geçersiz url', { status: 400 })

  const upstream = await fetch(target, {
    headers: {
      'User-Agent': UA,
      Referer: ref,
      Origin: new URL(ref).origin,
      ...(req.headers.get('range') ? { Range: req.headers.get('range') as string } : {}),
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  })
  if (!upstream.ok) return new Response(`kaynak ${upstream.status}`, { status: upstream.status })

  const type = upstream.headers.get('content-type') ?? ''
  const isPlaylist = type.includes('mpegurl') || /\.m3u8(\?|$)/i.test(target)

  if (isPlaylist) {
    const text = rewrite(await upstream.text(), target, ref)
    return new Response(text, {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=10' },
    })
  }

  return new Response(upstream.body, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': type || 'application/octet-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400, immutable',
      ...(upstream.headers.get('content-range') ? { 'Content-Range': upstream.headers.get('content-range') as string } : {}),
      'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
    },
  })
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\stream\route.ts
// ==========================================
// SSL sertifika doğrulama hatasını aşmak için (Vercel ortamı için)
process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '0'

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { ANIME } from '@consumet/extensions'

const provider = new ANIME.AnimePahe()

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const title = searchParams.get('title')
  const epNum = searchParams.get('ep')

  if (!title || !epNum) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Başlık ve bölüm numarası gerekli' }, { status: 400 })
  }

  try {
    // 1. Animeyi ara
    const searchResults = await provider.search(title)
    
    if (!searchResults.results || searchResults.results.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Anime AnimePahe üzerinde bulunamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    const anime = searchResults.results[0]
    
    // 2. Bölüm listesini al
    const info = await provider.fetchAnimeInfo(anime.id)
    
    if (!info.episodes || info.episodes.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Bu anime için bölüm listesi bulunamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    // 3. İstenen bölümü bul
    const episode = info.episodes.find((e: any) => e.number === Number(epNum))
    if (!episode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Bölüm ${epNum} bulunamadı.` }, { status: 404 })
    }

    // 4. Bölümün video kaynaklarını çek
    const sources = await provider.fetchEpisodeSources(episode.id)
    
    if (!sources || !sources.sources || sources.sources.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Video kaynakları çekilemedi.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    // 5. M3U8 formatındaki kaynağı bul
    const source = sources.sources.find((s: any) => s.isM3U8) || sources.sources[0]

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      streamUrl: `/api/proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(source.url)}`,
      originalUrl: source.url 
    })

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Stream API Hatası:', error)
    
    let errorMessage = 'Bilinmeyen bir hata.'
    if (error.message) errorMessage = error.message
    else if (typeof error === 'string') errorMessage = error
    else if (error.toString) errorMessage = error.toString()

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      error: 'Sağlayıcı Hatası: ' + errorMessage
    }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\subtitle\upload\route.ts
// ==========================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { kvSet } from '@/lib/store';
import { toVtt } from '@/lib/subtitles'; // Senin kendi çevirici fonksiyonun

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get('subtitle') as File;
    const episodeId = formData.get('episodeId') as string;
    const animeId = formData.get('animeId') as string;

    if (!file || !episodeId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ message: 'File or episode ID is missing.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const fileContent = await file.text();
    
    // Eğer senin lib/subtitles.ts dosyan varsa onu kullan, yoksa basitçe VTT'ye çevir
    const vttContent = toVtt ? toVtt(fileContent) : 'WEBVTT\n\n' + fileContent;

    const key = `subtitle:${animeId}:${episodeId}`;
    await kvSet(key, vttContent);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Subtitle saved successfully.' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Subtitle upload error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Internal server error.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\subtitle\[id]\route.ts
// ==========================================
import { getEpisodeById, logEvent } from '@/lib/site'
import { toVtt } from '@/lib/subtitles'

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const ep = await getEpisodeById(id)
  if (!ep) return new Response('Bulunamadı', { status: 404 })

  let raw = ep.subtitleText ?? ''
  if (!raw && ep.subtitleUrl) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(ep.subtitleUrl)
      if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && url.protocol !== 'http:') throw new Error('Geçersiz protokol')
      const res = await fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)
      raw = await res.text()
    } catch (e) {
      await logEvent({ 
        level: 'warn', 
        source: 'server', 
        message: `Altyazı alınamadı (${ep.animeTitle} #${ep.number}): ${(e as Error).message}`, 
        path: `/api/subtitle/${id}` 
      })
      return new Response('WEBVTT\n', { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/vtt; charset=utf-8' } })
    }
  }
  
  return new Response(toVtt(raw || ''), {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/vtt; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=300' },
  })
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: app\api\torrents\route.ts
// ==========================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

// Tarayıcıda (WebTorrent) çalışabilmesi için gerekli WSS Tracker'ları
const WSS_TRACKERS = [
  'wss://tracker.btorrent.xyz',
  'wss://tracker.openwebtorrent.com',
  'wss://tracker.webtorrent.dev',
]

function addWssTrackers(magnet: string) {
  let url = magnet
  for (const tr of WSS_TRACKERS) {
    if (!url.includes(encodeURIComponent(tr))) {
      url += `&tr=${encodeURIComponent(tr)}`
    }
  }
  return url
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const rawQuery = searchParams.get('q')

  if (!rawQuery) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Arama terimi gerekli' }, { status: 400 })

  // Gelen aramayı temizle (örneğin "One Piece 1" -> "One Piece")
  // Sadece bölüm numarasını ayırıp Nyaa'da daha iyi sonuç almak için kullanacağız.
  const parts = rawQuery.trim().split(/\s+/)
  const episodeNum = parts.length > 1 ? parts.pop() : ''
  const animeName = parts.join(' ') || rawQuery

  // Nyaa aramasını bölüm numarasıyla veya tek başına yap
  const searchTerm = episodeNum ? `${animeName} ${episodeNum}` : animeName
  // Nyaa sadece İngilizce çevirileri arasın (c=1_2)
  const nyaaUrl = `https://nyaa.si/?page=rss&q=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}&c=1_2&f=0`

  try {
    const res = await fetch(nyaaUrl, {
      headers: { 
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
        'Accept': 'application/rss+xml, application/xml, text/xml'
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    })

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Nyaa HTTP Hatası: ${res.status}`)

    const xml = await res.text()
    const items = [...xml.matchAll(/<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/g)]

    if (items.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Bu arama için Nyaa üzerinde sonuç bulunamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    const results: { title: string; magnet: string; seeders: number; size: string }[] = []

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const itemXml = item[1]
      
      const titleMatch = itemXml.match(/<title>(.*?)<\/title>/)
      const infoHashMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:infoHash>(.*?)<\/nyaa:infoHash>/)
      const seedersMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:seeders>(.*?)<\/nyaa:seeders>/)
      const sizeMatch = itemXml.match(/<nyaa:size>(.*?)<\/nyaa:size>/)

      if (titleMatch && infoHashMatch) {
        // CDATA etiketlerini temizle
        const title = decodeURIComponent(titleMatch[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>/g, '').trim())
        const infoHash = infoHashMatch[1].trim()
        const seeders = seedersMatch ? parseInt(seedersMatch[1], 10) : 0
        const size = sizeMatch ? sizeMatch[1].trim() : 'Bilinmiyor'

        const magnet = `magnet:?xt=urn:btih:${infoHash}&dn=${encodeURIComponent(title)}`
        
        results.push({ title, magnet, seeders, size })
      }
    })

    // Seed sayısına göre en yüksekten en düşüğe sırala
    results.sort((a, b) => b.seeders - a.seeders)

    // En iyi sonucu seç
    const best = results[0]

    if (!best) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Uygun magnet linki oluşturulamadı.' }, { status: 404 })
    }

    // WebTorrent için WSS tracker'larını ekle
    const finalMagnet = addWssTrackers(best.magnet)

    return NextResponse.json({
      magnet: finalMagnet,
      title: best.title,
      seeders: best.seeders,
      size: best.size,
    })

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Torrent arama hatası:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      error: 'Nyaa sunucusuna ulaşılamadı veya bir hata oluştu.',
      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

        <Script
          id="sw-register"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
            __html: `
              if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                window.addEventListener('load', function() {
                  navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js');

        <FloatingInstall />

        {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && <Analytics />}
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}

// DOSYA: components\admin\admin-login.tsx

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useActionState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, Loader2, LockKeyhole, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react'
import { adminLogin } from '@/app/admin/actions'

export function AdminLogin({ configured }: { configured: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [state, action, pending] = useActionState(adminLogin, null as null | { error?: string; ok?: boolean })
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state?.ok) router.refresh()
  }, [state, router])

  return (
    <main className="dark relative grid min-h-dvh place-items-center overflow-hidden bg-scrim px-4 text-foreground">
      <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.07]" style={{ backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(var(--foreground) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--foreground) 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '48px 48px' }} aria-hidden="true" />
      <form action={action} className="relative flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-5 rounded-[2rem] border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/[0.04] p-8 backdrop-blur-xl">
        <span className="grid size-14 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_50px_-5px_var(--primary)]">
          <LockKeyhole className="size-6" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <p className="label-mono text-primary">Kısıtlı alan</p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Yönetim <span className="font-serif font-normal italic text-primary">paneli</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground/60">Devam etmek için yönetici şifresini gir.</p>
        </div>
        {!configured && (
          <p className="rounded-2xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/15 p-3 text-sm">
            <strong>ADMIN_PASSWORD</strong> henüz tanımlanmadı. v0 ayarlarındaki <em>Vars</em> bölümünden ekledikten sonra giriş yapabilirsin.
          </p>
        )}
        <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
          <span className="text-foreground/60">Şifre</span>
          <input suppressHydrationWarning name="password" type="password" required autoComplete="current-password" autoFocus className="h-13 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-4 outline-none transition focus:border-primary" />
        </label>
        {state?.error && (
          <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
            {state.error}
          </p>
        )}
        <button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="flex h-13 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-70">
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <ShieldCheck className="size-4" />}
          Giriş yap
        </button>
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/50 transition hover:text-foreground">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Siteye dön
        </Link>
      </form>
    </main>
  )
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: components\admin\episode-manager.tsx
// ==========================================
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Eye, Loader2, Plus, Trash2, Wand2, Tv } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { addEpisodeAction, deleteEpisodeAction } from '@/app/admin/actions'
import type { Episode } from '@/lib/site'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Card } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { AnimePicker } from '@/components/compare/compare-picker'

const field = 'h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

type CatalogItem = { animeId: number; title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; episodes: Episode[] }

export function EpisodeManager({ catalog }: { catalog: CatalogItem[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [anime, setAnime] = useState<{ id: number; title: string; cover: string | null } | null>(null)
  const [subMode, setSubMode] = useState<'url' | 'text'>('url')
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(false)
  const [searchingTorrent, setSearchingTorrent] = useState(false)
  const [searchingStream, setSearchingStream] = useState(false)
  
  const [f, setF] = useState({ number: 1, title: '', videoUrl: '', magnetUrl: '', thumbnail: '', subtitleUrl: '', subtitleText: '', subtitleLang: 'tr' })

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!anime) {
      toast.error('Önce bir anime seç')
      return
    }
    start(async () => {
      const res = await addEpisodeAction({
        animeId: anime.id,
        animeTitle: anime.title,
        animeCover: anime.cover,
        number: Number(f.number),
        title: f.title,
        videoUrl: f.videoUrl.trim(),
        magnetUrl: f.magnetUrl.trim(),
        thumbnail: f.thumbnail.trim(),
        subtitleUrl: subMode === 'url' ? f.subtitleUrl.trim() : '',
        subtitleText: subMode === 'text' ? f.subtitleText : '',
        subtitleLang: f.subtitleLang,
      })
      if (!res.ok) {
        toast.error(res.error)
        return
      }
      toast.success(`${anime.title} · ${f.number}. bölüm eklendi`)
      setF((x) => ({ ...x, number: x.number + 1, title: '', videoUrl: '', magnetUrl: '', thumbnail: '', subtitleUrl: '', subtitleText: '' }))
      router.refresh()
    })
  }

  const handleFindStream = async () => {
    if (!anime || !f.number) {
      toast.error('Anime ve bölüm numarası gerekli')
      return
    }
    setSearchingStream(true)
    toast.loading('HLS/MP4 Akış linki aranıyor...', { id: 'stream' })
    
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/stream?title=${encodeURIComponent(anime.title)}&ep=${f.number}`)
      
      const text = await res.text()
      let data
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(text)
      } catch {
        throw new Error('Sunucu geçersiz yanıt döndürdü (HTML veya boş sayfa). Vercel loglarına bakın.')
      }
      
      if (data.streamUrl) {
        setF((prev) => ({ ...prev, videoUrl: data.streamUrl }))
        toast.success('Akış linki bulundu ve eklendi!', { id: 'stream' })
      } else {
        toast.error(data.error || 'Bulunamadı', { id: 'stream', duration: 6000 })
        console.log('Detaylı Hata:', data)
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Bağlantı hatası', { id: 'stream', duration: 8000 })
      console.error(error)
    } finally {
      setSearchingStream(false)
    }
  }

  const handleFindTorrent = async () => {
    if (!anime || !f.number) {
      toast.error('Anime ve bölüm numarası gerekli')
      return
    }
    setSearchingTorrent(true)
    toast.loading('Torrent aranıyor...', { id: 'torrent' })
    
    try {
      const q = `${anime.title} ${f.number < 10 ? '0'+f.number : f.number}`
      const res = await fetch(`/api/torrents?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`)
      const data = await res.json()
      
      if (data.magnet) {
        setF((prev) => ({ 
          ...prev, 
          magnetUrl: data.magnet,
          title: prev.title || data.title || `${prev.number}. bölüm`,
          thumbnail: prev.thumbnail || anime.cover || ''
        }))
        toast.success(`Torrent bulundu! (${data.seeders} seed)`, { id: 'torrent' })
      } else {
        toast.error(data.error || 'Bulunamadı', { id: 'torrent' })
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error('Arama hatası', { id: 'torrent' })
    } finally {
      setSearchingTorrent(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Yeni bölüm" accent="ekle">
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Anime</span>
            <AnimePicker label="Anime adı yaz ve seç" value={anime} onPick={(m) => setAnime(m ? { id: m.id, title: pickTitle(m.title), cover: m.coverImage.large ?? null } : null)} />
          </div>
          
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[140px_1fr]">
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Bölüm no</span>
              <input type="number" min={1} required className={field} value={f.number} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, number: Number(e.target.value) })} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Bölüm başlığı</span>
              <input className={field} value={f.title} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, title: e.target.value })} />
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">HLS / MP4 Linki</span>
                <button 
                  type="button" 
                  onClick={handleFindStream}
                  disabled={searchingStream}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {searchingStream ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Tv className="size-3.5" />}
                  Akış Bul
                </button>
              </div>
              <input type="text" className={field} placeholder="https://.../master.m3u8" value={f.videoUrl} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, videoUrl: e.target.value })} />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">Magnet Linki</span>
                <button 
                  type="button" 
                  onClick={handleFindTorrent}
                  disabled={searchingTorrent}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-secondary px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {searchingTorrent ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Wand2 className="size-3.5" />}
                  Torrent Bul
                </button>
              </div>
              <input type="text" className={field} placeholder="magnet:?xt=urn:btih:..." value={f.magnetUrl} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, magnetUrl: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Küçük resim (opsiyonel)</span>
            <input type="url" className={field} placeholder="https://…/kapak.jpg" value={f.thumbnail} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, thumbnail: e.target.value })} />
          </label>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">Altyazı (SRT, VTT)</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <select value={f.subtitleLang} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, subtitleLang: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-2 text-sm">
                  <option value="tr">Türkçe</option>
                  <option value="en">İngilizce</option>
                  <option value="ja">Japonca</option>
                </select>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-xl bg-muted p-1">
                  {(['url', 'text'] as const).map((m) => (
                    <button key={m} type="button" onClick={() => setSubMode(m)} className={cn('rounded-lg px-3 py-1 text-xs transition', subMode === m ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                      {m === 'url' ? 'Bağlantı' : 'Metin'}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            {subMode === 'url' ? (
              <input type="url" className={field} placeholder="https://…/bolum-1.tr.srt" value={f.subtitleUrl} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, subtitleUrl: e.target.value })} />
            ) : (
              <textarea className="min-h-40 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 font-mono text-xs outline-none focus:border-primary" value={f.subtitleText} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, subtitleText: e.target.value })} />
            )}
          </div>

          <button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="flex h-13 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-foreground font-semibold text-background transition hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-70">
            {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="size-4" />}
            Bölümü ekle
          </button>
        </form>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Eklenen" accent="videolar">
        {catalog.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Henüz video yok.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
            {catalog.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.animeId} className="rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
                <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={c.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-14 w-10 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate font-medium">{c.title}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Link href={`/anime/${c.animeId}`} target="_blank" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border hover:border-primary">
                    <ExternalLink className="size-4" />
                  </Link>
                </div>
                <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border">
                  {c.episodes.map((ep) => (
                    <li key={ep.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 text-sm">
                      <span className="w-12 font-mono text-xs text-ink">#{ep.number}</span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{ep.title || `${ep.number}. bölüm`}</span>
                      <span className="hidden font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground sm:inline">
                        {ep.videoUrl ? 'HLS/MP4' : (ep.magnetUrl ? 'Torrent' : 'Yok')}
                      </span>
                      <Link href={`/anime/${c.animeId}/izle/${ep.number}`} target="_blank" className="text-xs text-ink hover:underline">
                        İzle
                      </Link>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (!confirm(`${ep.number}. bölüm silinsin mi?`)) return
                          start(async () => {
                            await deleteEpisodeAction(c.animeId, ep.id)
                            toast.success('Bölüm silindi')
                            router.refresh()
                          })
                        }}
                        className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { CheckCircle2, Copy, Loader2, PlayCircle, XCircle } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { testIntegration } from '@/app/admin/actions'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Card } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'

type Group = { title: string; vars: { key: string; note: string; required?: boolean; set: boolean }[] }
type Result = { ok: boolean; ms: number; detail?: string }

const SERVICES = [
  { id: 'anilist', label: 'AniList API', note: 'Anime verileri' },
  { id: 'animethemes', label: 'AnimeThemes', note: 'OP / ED müzikleri' },
  { id: 'store', label: 'Veri deposu', note: 'Kullanıcı, video, ayar' },
  { id: 'gemini', label: 'Google Gemini', note: 'Bulut yapay zekâ' },
  { id: 'ollama', label: 'Ollama (sunucu)', note: 'Yerel yapay zekâ' },
] as const

export function IntegrationPanel({ groups, providers, origin }: { groups: Group[]; providers: { id: string; label: string; configured: boolean }[]; origin: string }) {
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Record<string, Result>>({})
  const [running, setRunning] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [, start] = useTransition()

  const run = (id: (typeof SERVICES)[number]['id']) => {
    setRunning(id)
    start(async () => {
      const r = await testIntegration(id)
      setResults((x) => ({ ...x, [id]: r }))
      setRunning(null)
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Card title="Servis" accent="durumu">
        <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => SERVICES.forEach((s, i) => window.setTimeout(() => run(s.id), i * 300))} className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-4 text-sm transition hover:border-primary">
            <PlayCircle className="size-4" /> Tümünü test et
          </button>
        </div>
        <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-col divide-y divide-border">
          {SERVICES.map((s) => {
            const r = results[s.id]
            return (
              <li key={s.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 py-3">
                <span className={cn('size-2.5 rounded-full', !r ? 'bg-muted-foreground/40' : r.ok ? 'bg-primary shadow-[0_0_10px_var(--primary)]' : 'bg-destructive')} />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block font-medium">{s.label}</span>
                  <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r?.detail ?? s.note}</span>
                </span>
                {r && <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.ms}ms</span>}
                <button type="button" onClick={() => run(s.id)} disabled={running === s.id} className="flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted px-3 text-xs font-medium transition hover:bg-accent">
                  {running === s.id ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
                  Test et
                </button>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Giriş" accent="sağlayıcıları">
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Her sağlayıcının geliştirici panelinde aşağıdaki yönlendirme (callback) adresini ekleyin, ardından istemci kimliği ve gizli anahtarı ortam değişkeni olarak girin.</p>
        <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
          {providers.map((p) => {
            const cb = `${origin}/api/auth/${p.id}/callback`
            return (
              <li key={p.id} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <BrandIcon name={p.id} />
                  <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{p.label}</span>
                  <span className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 text-xs', p.configured ? 'text-ink' : 'text-destructive')}>
                    {p.configured ? <CheckCircle2 className="size-4" /> : <XCircle className="size-4" />}
                    {p.configured ? 'Hazır' : 'Eksik'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(cb)
                    toast.success('Callback adresi kopyalandı')
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate rounded-xl bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-left font-mono text-xs transition hover:bg-accent"
                >
                  <Copy className="size-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{cb}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Ortam" accent="değişkenleri">
        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-6">
          {groups.map((g) => (
            <div key={g.title}>
              <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{g.title}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border rounded-2xl border border-border">
                {g.vars.map((v) => (
                  <li key={v.key} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                    {v.set ? <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0 text-ink" /> : <XCircle className={cn('size-4 shrink-0', v.required ? 'text-destructive' : 'text-muted-foreground')} />}
                    <code className="font-mono text-sm">{v.key}</code>
                    <span className="ml-auto hidden text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:inline">{v.note}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Değişkenleri v0 içinde sağ üstteki ayarlar menüsünden &quot;Vars&quot; bölümüne ya da Vercel proje ayarlarına ekleyebilirsiniz. Değerler güvenlik nedeniyle burada gösterilmez.</p>
        </div>

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { clearLogsAction } from '@/app/admin/actions'
import type { LogEntry } from '@/lib/site'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function LogsPanel({ logs }: { logs: LogEntry[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'error' | 'warn'>('all')
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const list = logs.filter((l) => filter === 'all' || l.level === filter)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {(['all', 'error', 'warn'] as const).map((f) => (
          <button key={f} type="button" aria-pressed={filter === f} onClick={() => setFilter(f)} className={cn('rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', filter === f ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary')}>
            {f === 'all' ? `Tümü (${logs.length})` : f === 'error' ? `Hatalar (${logs.filter((l) => l.level === 'error').length})` : `Uyarılar (${logs.filter((l) => l.level === 'warn').length})`}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={pending || logs.length === 0}
          onClick={() =>
            start(async () => {
              await clearLogsAction()
              toast.success('Kayıtlar temizlendi')
              router.refresh()
            })
          }
          className="ml-auto flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm text-destructive transition hover:bg-destructive/10 disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="size-4" />} Temizle
        </button>
      </div>
      {list.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Kayıt yok. Sistem sorunsuz çalışıyor.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {list.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.id}>
              <details className="group rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 open:border-primary/40">
                <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-start gap-3">
                  <span className={cn('mt-0.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase', l.level === 'error' ? 'bg-destructive text-on-scrim' : 'bg-accent text-ink')}>{l.level}</span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block text-sm">{l.message}</span>
                    <span className="mt-1 block font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {new Date(l.at).toLocaleString('tr-TR')} · {l.source} {l.path ? `· ${l.path}` : ''}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </summary>
                {(l.stack || l.userAgent) && (
                  <pre className="mt-3 max-h-64 overflow-auto rounded-xl bg-muted p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                    {l.stack}
                    {l.userAgent ? `\n\nUA: ${l.userAgent}` : ''}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </details>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

          </label>

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: components\admin\subtitle-uploader.tsx
// ==========================================
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';

export function SubtitleUploader({ episodeId, animeId }: { episodeId: string, animeId: string }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleUpload = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!file) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setStatus('Yükleniyor...');

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('subtitle', file);
    formData.append('episodeId', episodeId);
    formData.append('animeId', animeId);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/subtitle/upload', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setStatus('✅ Altyazı başarıyla yüklendi!');
        setFile(null);
      } else {
        const error = await res.json();
        setStatus(`❌ Hata: ${error.message}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus('❌ Yükleme başarısız oldu.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl shadow-lg max-w-md">
      <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-lg mb-4">Altyazı Yükle</h3>
      <form onSubmit={handleUpload} className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".srt,.vtt"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            className="block w-full text-sm text-neutral-400
              file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4
              file:rounded-md file:border-0
              file:text-sm file:font-semibold
              file:bg-red-600 file:text-white
              hover:file:bg-red-700 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 mt-2">Sadece .srt veya .vtt formatı desteklenir.</p>
        </div>
        
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!file || isLoading}
          className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-md hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors"
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Yükleniyor...' : 'Yükle'}
        </button>
        
        {status && (
          <p className={`text-sm text-center ${status.includes('✅') ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400'}`}>
            {status}
          </p>
        )}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

                </p>
              </div>
              {u.provider !== 'email' ? <BrandIcon name={u.provider} className="size-4" /> : <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">e-posta</span>}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  start(async () => {
                    await setUserBanned(u.id, !u.banned)
                    toast.success(u.banned ? 'Yasak kaldırıldı' : 'Kullanıcı askıya alındı')
                    router.refresh()
                  })
                }
                className={cn('flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 text-xs font-medium transition', u.banned ? 'bg-accent text-ink' : 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20')}
              >
                {u.banned ? <ShieldCheck className="size-3.5" /> : <Ban className="size-3.5" />}
                {u.banned ? 'Yasağı kaldır' : 'Askıya al'}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: components\ai\ai-assistant.tsx
// ==========================================
'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowUp, Bot, Cpu, Loader2, RotateCcw, Sparkles, Square, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { getPrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

type Msg = { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string; provider?: string }

const SUGGESTIONS = ['Frieren gibi sakin bir fantastik anime öner', 'Bu sezonun en iyi aksiyon animeleri neler?', 'Kısa ve bitmiş bir psikolojik gerilim öner', 'Yeni başlayanlar için 5 anime']

const SYSTEM = `Sen "Sytheris AI"sın: Sytheris anime keşif platformunun Türkçe konuşan asistanısın. Her zaman Türkçe yanıt ver, emoji kullanma. Anime önerirken 3-5 başlık ver, başlıkları **kalın** yaz, her biri için tek cümlelik neden ekle. Spoiler verme.`

let ollamaStatus: { url: string; ok: boolean; at: number } | null = null

async function ollamaAvailable(url: string) {
  if (ollamaStatus && ollamaStatus.url === url && Date.now() - ollamaStatus.at < 60_000) return ollamaStatus.ok
  try {
    const ctrl = new AbortController()
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 1200)
    const res = await fetch(`${url.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/tags`, { signal: ctrl.signal })
    window.clearTimeout(t)
    ollamaStatus = { url, ok: res.ok, at: Date.now() }
  } catch {
    ollamaStatus = { url, ok: false, at: Date.now() }
  }
  return ollamaStatus.ok
}

function renderInline(text: string) {
  const parts = text.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)/g)
  return parts.map((p, i) => (p.startsWith('**') && p.endsWith('**') ? <strong key={i} className="font-semibold text-foreground">{p.slice(2, -2)}</strong> : <span key={i}>{p}</span>))
}

export function RichText({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = []
  let list: string[] = []
  const flush = () => {
    if (!list.length) return
    out.push(
      <ul key={`l${out.length}`} className="my-1 flex flex-col gap-1.5 pl-1">
        {list.map((l, i) => (
          <li key={i} className="flex gap-2">
            <span className="mt-2 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary" />
            <span>{renderInline(l)}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>,
    )
    list = []
  }
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const m = line.match(/^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)])\s+(.*)$/)
    if (m) list.push(m[1])
    else {
      flush()
      if (line.trim()) out.push(<p key={i}>{renderInline(line.replace(/^#+\s*/, ''))}</p>)
    }
  })
  flush()
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">{out}</div>
}

export function AiAssistant() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Msg[]>([])
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    scroller.current?.scrollTo({ top: scroller.current.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }, [messages])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && setOpen(false)
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [open])

  async function send(text: string) {
    const content = text.trim()
    if (!content || busy) return
    const history: Msg[] = [...messages, { role: 'user', content }]
    setMessages([...history, { role: 'assistant', content: '' }])
    setInput('')
    setBusy(true)
    const ctrl = new AbortController()
    abort.current = ctrl
    const prefs = getPrefs()
    const append = (chunk: string, provider?: string) =>
      setMessages((list) => {
        const next = [...list]
        const last = next[next.length - 1]
        next[next.length - 1] = { ...last, content: last.content + chunk, provider: provider ?? last.provider }
        return next
      })

    try {
      let usedLocal = false
      if (prefs.aiProvider !== 'gemini' && (await ollamaAvailable(prefs.ollamaUrl))) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${prefs.ollamaUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/chat`, {
            method: 'POST',
            signal: ctrl.signal,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ model: prefs.ollamaModel, stream: true, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYSTEM }, ...history.map(({ role, content }) => ({ role, content }))] }),
          })
          if (res.ok && res.body) {
            usedLocal = true
            const reader = res.body.getReader()
            const dec = new TextDecoder()
            let buf = ''
            append('', `Ollama · ${prefs.ollamaModel}`)
            while (true) {
              const { value, done } = await reader.read()
              if (done) break
              buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true })
              const lines = buf.split('\n')
              buf = lines.pop() ?? ''
              for (const l of lines) {
                if (!l.trim()) continue
                try {
                  const t = JSON.parse(l).message?.content
                  if (t) append(t)
                } catch {}
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          if ((e as Error).name === 'AbortError') throw e
        }
      }
      if (!usedLocal) {
        if (prefs.aiProvider === 'ollama') append('', 'Ollama erişilemedi → bulut')
        const res = await fetch('/api/ai', {
          method: 'POST',
          signal: ctrl.signal,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ messages: history.map(({ role, content }) => ({ role, content })), provider: prefs.aiProvider }),
        })
        const provider = res.headers.get('X-AI-Provider')
        append('', provider === 'gemini' ? 'Gemini' : provider === 'ollama' ? 'Ollama (sunucu)' : 'Hata')
        if (!res.body) throw new Error(await res.text())
        const reader = res.body.getReader()
        const dec = new TextDecoder()
        while (true) {
          const { value, done } = await reader.read()
          if (done) break
          append(dec.decode(value, { stream: true }))
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as Error).name !== 'AbortError') append('\nBir hata oluştu, lütfen tekrar dene.')
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
      abort.current = null
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <motion.button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        aria-label={open ? 'Asistanı kapat' : 'Sytheris AI asistanını aç'}
        aria-expanded={open}
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.06 }}
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }}
        className="fixed bottom-24 left-4 z-[60] grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-primary/80 text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_10px_40px_-8px_var(--primary)] backdrop-blur-xl transition-colors hover:bg-primary md:bottom-6 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:size-14"
      >
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.span key={open ? 'x' : 's'} initial={{ rotate: -90, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ rotate: 0, opacity: 1 }} exit={{ rotate: 90, opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}>
            {open ? <X className="size-5" /> : <Sparkles className="size-5 md:size-6" />}
          </motion.span>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </motion.button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.section
            role="dialog"
            aria-label="Sytheris AI"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.97 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 28, stiffness: 320 }}
            className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-40 top-20 z-[60] flex origin-bottom-left flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-white/40 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-3xl dark:bg-black/40 md:inset-x-auto md:bottom-24 md:right-6 md:top-auto md:h-[min(640px,75vh)] md:w-[420px] md:origin-bottom-right"
          >
            <header className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 bg-white/10 dark:bg-black/20">
              <span className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-lg">
                <Bot className="size-5" />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  Sytheris <span className="accent-serif">AI</span>
                </p>
                <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <Cpu className="size-3" /> Ollama (yerel) + Gemini yedekli
                </p>
              </div>
              {messages.length > 0 && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setMessages([])} aria-label="Sohbeti temizle" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-black/10 hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-white/10">
                  <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </header>

            <div ref={scroller} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4" aria-live="polite">
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex h-full flex-col justify-end gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                      Ne izlesem <span className="accent-serif">bugün?</span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Ruh haline, sevdiğin animelere ya da türlere göre öneri iste.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
                      <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => send(s)} className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/20 px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm backdrop-blur-sm transition hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/20 dark:hover:bg-black/40">
                        {s}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                  {messages.map((m, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1', m.role === 'user' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start')}>
                      {m.role === 'assistant' && m.provider && <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{m.provider}</span>}
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          'max-w-[88%] rounded-3xl px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-sm',
                          m.role === 'user' ? 'rounded-br-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'rounded-bl-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/30 text-foreground/90 backdrop-blur-md dark:bg-black/40',
                        )}
                      >
                        {m.role === 'assistant' ? m.content ? <RichText text={m.content} /> : <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" /> : m.content}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                send(input)
              }}
              className="border-t border-white/10 p-3 bg-white/10 dark:bg-black/20"
            >
              <div className="flex items-end gap-2 rounded-3xl border border-white/20 bg-white/20 p-1.5 pl-4 backdrop-blur-md transition focus-within:border-primary/50 focus-within:bg-white/30 dark:bg-black/20 dark:focus-within:bg-black/40">
                <textarea
                  value={input}
                  onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                      if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return
                      e.preventDefault()
                      send(input)
                    }
                  }}
                  rows={1}
                  placeholder="Bir şey sor…"
                  aria-label="Mesaj"
                  className="max-h-32 min-h-10 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent py-2.5 text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
                />
                {busy ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => abort.current?.abort()} aria-label="Durdur" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background">
                    <Square className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button type="submit" disabled={!input.trim()} aria-label="Gönder" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground transition disabled:opacity-40">
                    <ArrowUp className="size-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.section>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { Star } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { usePreview } from './preview-provider'

export function AnimeCard({ media, className, badge, priority }: { media: MediaCard; className?: string; badge?: string; priority?: boolean }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement>(null)
  const preview = usePreview()
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  return (
    <Link
      ref={ref}
      href={`/anime/${media.id}`}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType === 'mouse' && ref.current && preview?.show(media, ref.current)}
      onPointerLeave={() => preview?.cancelShow()}
      onFocus={() => preview?.hide()}
      className={cn('group/card flex flex-col gap-3 outline-none', className)}
    >
      <div
        className="relative aspect-[2/3] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-muted shadow-sm ring-1 ring-border transition duration-500 group-hover/card:-translate-y-1 group-hover/card:shadow-xl group-focus-visible/card:ring-2 group-focus-visible/card:ring-primary"
        style={{ backgroundColor: media.coverImage.color ?? undefined }}
      >
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'}
          alt={title}
          loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}
          decoding="async"
          className="size-full object-cover transition duration-700 group-hover/card:scale-105"
        />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim/50 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 transition group-hover/card:opacity-100" />
        {media.averageScore ? (
          <span className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-scrim/70 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-on-scrim backdrop-blur-md">
            <Star className="size-3 fill-primary text-primary" />
            {media.averageScore}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {badge && (
          <span className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 rounded-full bg-primary px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary-foreground">{badge}</span>
        )}
        {media.nextAiringEpisode && !badge && (
          <span className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 rounded-full bg-scrim/70 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-on-scrim backdrop-blur-md">Bölüm {media.nextAiringEpisode.episode}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-0.5">
        <p className="line-clamp-2 text-[15px] font-medium leading-snug transition-colors group-hover/card:text-ink">{title}</p>
        <p className="font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{[media.seasonYear, formatTr(media.format)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</p>
      </div>
    </Link>
  )
}

// DOSYA: components\anime\detail-backdrop.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { BackdropImage } from '@/components/media/backdrop-image'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

export function DetailBackdrop({ media }: { media: MediaCard }) {
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)
  const id = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setOn(true), 3000)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, playing])

  const show = Boolean(id) && on && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !failed && !isTrailerBroken(id)

  return (
    <>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        <BackdropImage media={media} priority />
        {show && id && <YTTrailer ref={yt} videoId={id} start={5} onPlaying={() => setPlaying(true)} onError={() => setFailed(true)} />}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/75 to-scrim/20" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-page to-transparent" />
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      </div>
      {playing && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPrefs({ trailerSound: !prefs.trailerSound })}
          aria-label={prefs.trailerSound ? 'Fragman sesini kapat' : 'Fragman sesini aç'}
          className="absolute right-4 top-6 z-10 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-foreground/25 bg-scrim/30 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-scrim/60 sm:right-10"
        >
          {prefs.trailerSound ? <Volume2 className="size-5" /> : <VolumeX className="size-5" />}
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'

export function ExpandableText({ text, lines = 5, className }: { text: string; lines?: number; className?: string }) {

  if (!text) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">Açıklama bulunmuyor.</p>
  const long = text.length > 420
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div className={cn('whitespace-pre-line text-pretty leading-relaxed text-foreground/80', !open && long && 'line-clamp-[var(--l)]')} style={{ ['--l' as string]: lines }}>
        {text}
      </div>
      {long && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} className="mt-3 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-ink hover:underline">
          {open ? 'Daha az göster' : 'Devamını oku'}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { toggleFavorite } from '@/app/actions/favorites'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function FavoriteButton({ animeId, initial, loggedIn, className }: { animeId: number; initial: boolean; loggedIn: boolean; className?: string }) {
  const [fav, setFav] = useState(initial)
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const router = useRouter()
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={fav}
      disabled={pending}
      onClick={() => {
        if (!loggedIn) {
          toast('Favorilere eklemek için giriş yap', { action: { label: 'Giriş yap', onClick: () => router.push('/giris') } })
          return
        }
        setFav((v) => !v)
        start(async () => {
          const res = await toggleFavorite(animeId)
          if (!res.ok) {
            setFav((v) => !v)
            toast.error('İşlem başarısız oldu')
          } else toast.success(res.favorite ? 'Favorilere eklendi' : 'Favorilerden çıkarıldı')
        })
      }}
      className={cn(
        'flex h-13 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-5 font-medium backdrop-blur transition',
        fav ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'border-foreground/25 hover:bg-foreground/10',
        className,
      )}
    >
      <Heart className={cn('size-4 transition', fav && 'scale-110 fill-current')} />
      {fav ? 'Favorilerde' : 'Favorilere ekle'}
    </button>
  )
}

export function PersonHero({
  image,
  label,
  head,
  tail,
  sub,
  children,
}: {
  image?: string | null
  label: string
  head: string
  tail: string
  sub?: string | null
  children?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        {image && (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={image || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 size-full scale-125 object-cover opacity-40 blur-3xl" />
        )}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/80 to-scrim/40" />

      </div>
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] items-end gap-8 px-4 pb-14 pt-16 sm:px-6 md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[280px_1fr] lg:gap-14 lg:px-10 lg:pt-24">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={image || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="mx-auto aspect-[3/4] w-44 rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10 sm:w-56 md:mx-0 md:w-full" />
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">

            </h1>
            {sub && <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-foreground/50">{sub}</p>}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{children}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: components\anime\preview-provider.tsx
// ==========================================
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { ChevronDown, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

type Active = { media: MediaCard; rect: DOMRect }
type Ctx = { show: (media: MediaCard, el: HTMLElement) => void; hide: () => void; cancelShow: () => void }

const PreviewCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

export function PreviewProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<Active | null>(null)
  const showTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const pathname = usePathname()

  const clear = () => {
    if (showTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(showTimer.current)
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
  }

  const show = useCallback((media: MediaCard, el: HTMLElement) => {
    if (window.innerWidth < 768) return
    clear()
    showTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setActive({ media, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect() }), 520)
  }, [])

  const cancelShow = useCallback(() => {
    if (showTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(showTimer.current)
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setActive(null), 140)
  }, [])

  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    clear()
    setActive(null)
  }, [])

  const keep = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setActive(null)
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return
    const onScroll = () => setActive(null)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true, once: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [active])

  return (
    <PreviewCtx.Provider value={{ show, hide, cancelShow }}>
      {children}
      <PreviewLayer active={active} onEnter={keep} onLeave={hide} />
    </PreviewCtx.Provider>
  )
}

export function usePreview() {
  return useContext(PreviewCtx)
}

function PreviewLayer({ active, onEnter, onLeave }: { active: Active | null; onEnter: () => void; onLeave: () => void }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])
  if (!mounted) return null
  return createPortal(
    <AnimatePresence>{active && <PreviewCard key={active.media.id} active={active} onEnter={onEnter} onLeave={onLeave} />}</AnimatePresence>,
    document.body,
  )
}

function PreviewCard({ active, onEnter, onLeave }: { active: Active; onEnter: () => void; onLeave: () => void }) {
  const { media, rect } = active
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false)
  const [startTrailer, setStartTrailer] = useState(false)
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const canTrailer = Boolean(trailerId) && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !failed && !isTrailerBroken(trailerId)

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setStartTrailer(true), 350)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, playing])

  const width = Math.min(Math.max(rect.width * 1.75, 340), 420)
  const vw = window.innerWidth
  const left = Math.min(Math.max(rect.left + rect.width / 2 - width / 2, 16), vw - width - 16)
  const mediaH = (width * 9) / 16
  const top = Math.max(rect.top + rect.height * 0.32 - mediaH / 2, 76)
  const originX = ((rect.left + rect.width / 2 - left) / width) * 100

  const image = media.bannerImage || media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.72 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, transition: { duration: 0.16 } }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 360, damping: 30 }}
      onMouseEnter={onEnter}
      onMouseLeave={onLeave}
      style={{ position: 'fixed', left, top, width, transformOrigin: `${originX}% 30%` }}
      className="z-[80] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-[0_30px_80px_-20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)]"
    >
      <Link href={`/anime/${media.id}`} className="relative block aspect-video overflow-hidden bg-scrim" aria-label={`${title} detayları`} onClick={onLeave}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img src={image || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
        {canTrailer && startTrailer && trailerId && (
          <YTTrailer ref={yt} videoId={trailerId} start={4} onPlaying={() => setPlaying(true)} onError={() => setFailed(true)} />
        )}
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-2/3 bg-gradient-to-t from-popover via-popover/40 to-transparent" />
        <p className="absolute bottom-3 left-4 right-14 line-clamp-2 text-lg font-semibold leading-tight text-foreground drop-shadow">{title}</p>
      </Link>
      {playing && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPrefs({ trailerSound: !prefs.trailerSound })}
          aria-label={prefs.trailerSound ? 'Sesi kapat' : 'Sesi aç'}
          className="absolute right-3 top-[calc(var(--h)-3rem)] grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-on-scrim/30 bg-scrim/40 text-on-scrim backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-scrim/70"
          style={{ ['--h' as string]: `${mediaH}px` }}
        >
          {prefs.trailerSound ? <Volume2 className="size-4" /> : <VolumeX className="size-4" />}
        </button>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/anime/${media.id}`}
            onClick={onLeave}
            className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background transition hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground"
            aria-label={`${title} izle`}
          >
            <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4 fill-current" />
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/anime/${media.id}`}
            onClick={onLeave}
            className="ml-auto grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border transition hover:border-foreground"
            aria-label="Daha fazla bilgi"
          >
            <ChevronDown className="size-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-sm">
          {media.averageScore ? <span className="font-semibold text-ink">%{media.averageScore} eşleşme</span> : null}
          {media.seasonYear && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{media.seasonYear}</span>}
          {media.format && <span className="rounded border border-border px-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{formatTr(media.format)}</span>}
          {media.episodes ? <span className="text-muted-foreground">{media.episodes} bölüm</span> : null}
        </div>
        {media.genres && media.genres.length > 0 && (
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-sm">
            {media.genres.slice(0, 3).map((g, i) => (
              <span key={g} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {i > 0 && <span className="size-1 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/50" />}
                {genreTr(g)}
              </span>
            ))}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

// DOSYA: components\anime\scroll-row.tsx
// ==========================================
'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

export function ScrollRow({ children, className, label }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; label: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState({ start: true, end: false })

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const update = () => setEdges({ start: el.scrollLeft < 8, end: el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth >= el.scrollWidth - 8 })
    update()
    el.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true })
    window.addEventListener('resize', update)
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', update)
      window.removeEventListener('resize', update)
    }
  }, [])

  const scroll = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (el) el.scrollBy({ left: dir * el.clientWidth * 0.85, behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  return (
    <div className="group/row relative">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="region"
        aria-label={label}
        tabIndex={0}
        className={cn(
          'scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-px-4 gap-4 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-4 pt-2 sm:-mx-6 sm:scroll-px-6 sm:px-6 lg:-mx-10 lg:scroll-px-10 lg:px-10',
          className,
        )}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
      {(['start', 'end'] as const).map((side) => (
        <button
          key={side}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => scroll(side === 'start' ? -1 : 1)}
          aria-label={side === 'start' ? 'Geri kaydır' : 'İleri kaydır'}
          className={cn(
            'absolute top-[38%] z-10 hidden size-12 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-popover/90 shadow-xl backdrop-blur transition md:grid',
            side === 'start' ? '-left-2 lg:left-2' : '-right-2 lg:right-2',
            edges[side] ? 'pointer-events-none opacity-0' : 'opacity-0 group-hover/row:opacity-100 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:opacity-100',
          )}
        >
          {side === 'start' ? <ChevronLeft className="size-5" /> : <ChevronRight className="size-5" />}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

// DOSYA: components\anime\trailer-button.tsx
