===== DOSYA: .fix-backup\2026-11-05T14-28-34-587Z\lib\session.ts =====
import 'server-only'
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual, createHash } from 'crypto'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __sySecret?: string }

function secret() {
  if (process.env.SESSION_SECRET) return process.env.SESSION_SECRET
  if (process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD) return createHash('sha256').update(`sytheris:${process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}`).digest('hex')
  if (!g.__sySecret) g.__sySecret = randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
  return g.__sySecret
}

function b64(input: string) {
  return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64url')
}

export function sign(payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const body = b64(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const sig = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  return `${body}.${sig}`
}

export function verify<T = Record<string, unknown>>(token?: string | null): T | null {
  if (!token) return null
  const [body, sig] = token.split('.')
  if (!body || !sig) return null
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  const a = Buffer.from(sig)
  const b = Buffer.from(expected)
  if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, 'base64url').toString()) as T & { exp?: number }
    if (data.exp && Date.now() > data.exp) return null
    return data
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'sy_session'
export const ADMIN_COOKIE = 'sy_admin'

export const cookieOptions = (maxAgeSeconds: number) =>
  ({
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    sameSite: 'none' as const,
    path: '/',
    maxAge: maxAgeSeconds,
  })

export async function getSessionUserId() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ uid: string }>(store.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value)
  return data?.uid ?? null
}

export async function isAdmin() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ admin: boolean }>(store.get(ADMIN_COOKIE)?.value)
  return Boolean(data?.admin)
}

export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  const ha = createHash('sha256').update(a).digest()
  const hb = createHash('sha256').update(b).digest()
  return timingSafeEqual(ha, hb)
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { username } = await params
  const user = await getUserByUsername(username)
  if (!user) return { title: 'Profil bulunamadı' }
  return {

  }
}

export default async function PublicProfile({ params }: Props) {

  const [user, viewer] = await Promise.all([getUserByUsername(username), getCurrentUser()])
  if (!user || user.banned) notFound()
  const favs = await getManyAnime(user.favorites.slice(0, 8))
  return (
    <ProfileView
      user={toPublic(user)}
      isOwner={viewer?.id === user.id}
      favorites={favs.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, title: pickTitle(m.title), cover: m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || null }))}
    />
  )
}

          title={current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}
          episodeLabel={`${title} · Bölüm ${current.number}`}
          storageKey={current.id}
          prevHref={prev ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${prev.number}` : null}
          nextHref={next ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${next.number}` : null}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="label-mono text-ink">Bölüm {current.number}</p>
          <h1 className="text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
            {title} <span className="accent-serif">{current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Captions className="size-4" />
            {subtitleSrc ? `${current.subtitleLang.toUpperCase()} altyazı mevcut — C tuşuyla aç/kapat` : 'Bu bölümde altyazı yok'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Kısayollar: Boşluk / K oynat · J / L 10 sn · F tam ekran · M sessiz</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <aside className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:pt-10">
        <p className="label-mono text-muted-foreground">Bölümler ({episodes.length})</p>
        <ul className="flex max-h-[70vh] flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {episodes.map((e) => {
            const active = e.id === current.id
            return (
              <li key={e.id}>
                <Link
                  href={`/anime/${animeId}/izle/${e.number}`}
                  aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
                  className={cn('flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-2 transition', active ? 'border-primary bg-accent' : 'border-border bg-card hover:border-primary/50')}
                >
                  <span className="relative grid aspect-video w-28 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={e.thumbnail || media?.bannerImage || media?.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
                    {active && (
                      <span className="relative grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                        <Play className="ml-0.5 size-3.5 fill-current" />
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-ink">Bölüm {e.number}</span>
                    <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{e.title || `${e.number}. bölüm`}</span>
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}

import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'
import { getAnimeMeta } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, splitTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { loadGoogleFont } from '@/lib/og'

export const alt = 'Anime detayları — SYTHERIS'
export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 }
export const contentType = 'image/png'

export default async function OG({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const [media, bold, serif] = await Promise.all([getAnimeMeta(Number(id)), loadGoogleFont('Bricolage Grotesque', 700), loadGoogleFont('Instrument Serif', 400, 'italic')])
  const fonts = [
    ...(bold ? [{ name: 'Bricolage', data: bold, weight: 700 as const, style: 'normal' as const }] : []),
    ...(serif ? [{ name: 'Instrument', data: serif, weight: 400 as const, style: 'italic' as const }] : []),
  ]
  const title = media ? pickTitle(media.title) : 'SYTHERIS'
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const bg = media?.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${media.trailer.id}/hqdefault.jpg` : media?.bannerImage || media?.coverImage.extraLarge
  const accent = media?.coverImage.color || '#10d27f'
  const fontSize = title.length > 40 ? 58 : title.length > 22 ? 72 : 92

  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', position: 'relative', background: '#07100c', fontFamily: 'Bricolage', color: '#f4f7f5' }}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        {bg && <img src={bg} alt="" width={1200} height={630} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', opacity: 0.5 }} />}
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'flex', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #07100c 0%, rgba(7,16,12,0.92) 50%, rgba(7,16,12,0.4) 100%)' }} />
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 56, padding: '0 72px', width: '100%' }}>
          {media?.coverImage.extraLarge && (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img src={media.coverImage.extraLarge} alt="" width={320} height={460} style={{ borderRadius: 28, objectFit: 'cover', boxShadow: `0 30px 80px ${accent}66` }} />
          )}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, fontSize: 20, letterSpacing: 6, color: '#10d27f' }}>
              <div style={{ width: 40, height: 2, background: '#10d27f' }} />
              {[media?.seasonYear, formatTr(media?.format)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', fontSize, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: -2, lineHeight: 1.02, marginTop: 18, gap: 18 }}>
              {head && <span>{head}</span>}
              <span style={{ fontFamily: 'Instrument', fontStyle: 'italic', fontWeight: 400, color: '#10d27f' }}>{tail}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginTop: 32, fontSize: 22 }}>
              {media?.averageScore ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', background: '#10d27f', color: '#07100c', borderRadius: 999, padding: '8px 20px', fontWeight: 700 }}>{media.averageScore}%</div> : null}
              {(media?.genres ?? []).slice(0, 3).map((g) => (
                <div key={g} style={{ display: 'flex', border: '1px solid rgba(244,247,245,0.3)', borderRadius: 999, padding: '8px 20px' }}>
                  {genreTr(g)}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', marginTop: 48, fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: -1 }}>SYTHERIS</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size, fonts: fonts.length ? fonts : undefined },
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'

import { listEpisodes } from '@/lib/site'

import { TrailerButton } from '@/components/anime/trailer-button'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const media = await getAnime(Number(id))
  if (!media) return { title: 'Anime bulunamadı' }
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const description = stripHtml(media.description).slice(0, 180)
  return {
    title,
    description,
    openGraph: { title: `${title} — SYTHERIS`, description, type: 'video.tv_show' },
    twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image', title: `${title} — SYTHERIS`, description },
  }
}

export default async function AnimePage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const animeId = Number(id)
  if (!Number.isInteger(animeId)) notFound()
  const [media, episodes, user] = await Promise.all([getAnime(animeId), listEpisodes(animeId).catch(() => []), getCurrentUser()])
  if (!media) notFound()

  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const studio = media.studios?.nodes.find((s) => s.isAnimationStudio) ?? media.studios?.nodes[0]
  const recs = (media.recommendations?.nodes ?? []).map((n) => n.mediaRecommendation).filter((m): m is MediaCard => Boolean(m))
  const relations = (media.relations?.edges ?? []).filter((e) => e.node.type === 'ANIME')
  
  // PUAN DAĞILIMI DÜZELTMESİ (Sıfır olanları filtrele ve max değeri güvenli hesapla)
  const scoreDist = media.stats?.scoreDistribution?.filter((s) => s.amount > 0) ?? []
  const maxScore = Math.max(1, ...scoreDist.map((s) => s.amount))
  
  const streaming = (media.externalLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l.type === 'STREAMING')
  const rankTop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'RATED')
  const rankPop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'POPULAR')

  const info: [string, string | null | undefined][] = [
    ['Format', formatTr(media.format)],
    ['Bölüm', media.episodes ? `${media.episodes}` : media.nextAiringEpisode ? `${media.nextAiringEpisode.episode - 1}+` : null],
    ['Süre', media.duration ? `${media.duration} dk` : null],
    ['Durum', statusTr(media.status)],
    ['Başlangıç', fuzzyDate(media.startDate)],
    ['Bitiş', fuzzyDate(media.endDate)],
    ['Sezon', media.season ? `${seasonTr(media.season)} ${media.seasonYear ?? ''}` : null],
    ['Stüdyo', studio?.name],
    ['Kaynak', media.source ? media.source.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase() : null],
    ['Japonca', media.title.native],
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-20 pb-10">
      <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground">
        <DetailBackdrop media={media} />
        <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] items-end gap-8 px-4 pb-20 pt-16 sm:px-6 md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[300px_1fr] lg:gap-14 lg:px-10 lg:pb-28 lg:pt-28">
          <div className="relative mx-auto w-44 sm:w-56 md:mx-0 md:w-full">
            <div className="absolute -inset-6 -z-10 rounded-[2.5rem] opacity-60 blur-3xl" style={{ background: media.coverImage.color ?? 'var(--primary)' }} />
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img src={media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={title} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
            <p className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
              <span className="h-px w-10 bg-primary" />
              {[formatTr(media.format), media.seasonYear].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
              {media.status === 'RELEASING' && <span className="rounded-full bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-primary-foreground">Yayında</span>}
            </p>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-balance text-4xl font-bold leading-[0.95] tracking-[-0.04em] sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl">
                {head} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic tracking-[-0.01em] text-primary">{tail}</span>
              </h1>
              {media.title.native && <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-foreground/50">{media.title.native}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              {media.averageScore ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
                  <Star className="size-4 fill-current" />
                  {media.averageScore}%
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {media.episodes ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/75">
                  <Tv className="size-4" /> {media.episodes} bölüm
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {media.duration ? (

                  <Clock className="size-4" /> {media.duration} dk
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {media.genres?.map((g) => (
                <Link key={g} href={`/ara?genre=${encodeURIComponent(g)}`} className="rounded-full border border-foreground/20 px-3 py-1 text-sm text-foreground/85 backdrop-blur transition hover:border-primary hover:text-primary">
                  {genreTr(g)}

              <p className="w-fit rounded-2xl border border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-foreground backdrop-blur">

              </p>
            )}

                  <Play className="size-4 fill-current" />
                  {episodes[0].number}. bölümü izle
                </Link>
              ) : null}
              {trailerId && <TrailerButton videoId={trailerId} title={title} poster={media.bannerImage} />}
              <FavoriteButton animeId={media.id} initial={Boolean(user?.favorites.includes(media.id))} loggedIn={Boolean(user)} />

                    <span key={t.id} className="rounded-full bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                    {l.site}

            ))}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'
import { searchAnime } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { genreTr } from '@/lib/format'
import { AnimeCard } from '@/components/anime/anime-card'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { SearchFilters } from '@/components/search/search-filters'

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Keşfet', description: 'Tüm anime kataloğunda tür, yıl, sezon ve formata göre ara.' }

type SP = Promise<Record<string, string | undefined>>

export default async function SearchPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: SP }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const page = Math.max(1, Number(sp.page) || 1)
  const result = await searchAnime({
    q: sp.q,
    genre: sp.genre,
    year: sp.year ? Number(sp.year) : undefined,
    season: sp.season,
    format: sp.format,
    status: sp.status,
    sort: sp.sort,
    page,
  })
  const link = (p: number) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(sp).filter(([, v]) => v) as [string, string][])
    next.set('page', String(p))
    return `/ara?${next.toString()}`
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-10 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 lg:pt-14">
      <SectionHeading as="h1" eyebrow="Katalog" title={sp.genre ? genreTr(sp.genre) : 'Tüm animeleri'} accent={sp.genre ? 'animeleri' : 'keşfet'} description="Binlerce anime arasında ara, filtrele ve yeni favorini bul." />
      <Suspense>
        <SearchFilters />
      </Suspense>
      <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">
        {result.pageInfo.total > 0 ? `${result.pageInfo.total.toLocaleString('tr-TR')}+ sonuç · sayfa ${page}` : 'Sonuç yok'}
      </p>
      {result.media.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6">
          {result.media.map((m, i) => (
            <li key={m.id}>
              <AnimeCard media={m} priority={i < 6} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border py-24 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-semibold">
            Hiçbir şey <span className="accent-serif">bulunamadı</span>
          </p>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Filtreleri gevşetmeyi ya da farklı bir arama yapmayı dene.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <nav className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3" aria-label="Sayfalama">
        {page > 1 && (
          <Link href={link(page - 1)} className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-6 transition hover:border-primary">
            <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Önceki
          </Link>
        )}
        {result.pageInfo.hasNextPage && (
          <Link href={link(page + 1)} className="flex h-12 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 font-medium text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110">
            Sonraki <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
          </Link>
        )}
      </nav>
    </div>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: app\(site)\error.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'

export default function ErrorPage({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/log', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ message: error.message || 'Sayfa hatası', stack: `${error.stack ?? ''}\ndigest: ${error.digest ?? '-'}`, path: location.pathname }),
    }).catch(() => {})
  }, [error])

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-xl flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-32 text-center">
      <p className="label-mono text-ink">Beklenmeyen hata</p>
      <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
        Bir şeyler <span className="accent-serif">ters gitti</span>
      </h1>
      <p className="leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Hata kaydedildi ve yöneticiye iletildi. Sayfayı yeniden denemek ister misin?</p>
      <button type="button" onClick={reset} className="mt-2 flex h-12 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 font-medium text-primary-foreground">
        <RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Tekrar dene
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: app\(site)\karakter\[id]\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { getCharacter } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { compact, fuzzyDate, pickTitle, roleTr, splitTitle, stripHtml } from '@/lib/format'
import { ExpandableText } from '@/components/anime/expandable-text'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { PersonHero } from '@/components/anime/person-hero'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const c = await getCharacter(Number(id))
  if (!c) return { title: 'Karakter bulunamadı' }
  return { title: c.name.full, description: stripHtml(c.description).slice(0, 160), openGraph: { images: c.image.large ? [c.image.large] : [] } }
}

const GENDER: Record<string, string> = { Male: 'Erkek', Female: 'Kadın', 'Non-binary': 'Non-binary' }

export default async function CharacterPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const c = await getCharacter(Number(id))
  if (!c) notFound()
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(c.name.full)
  const vaMap = new Map<number, { id: number; name: { full: string }; image: { large?: string | null }; languageV2?: string }>()
  c.media.edges.forEach((e) => e.voiceActors.forEach((v) => vaMap.set(v.id, v)))
  const voiceActors = [...vaMap.values()].slice(0, 8)
  const facts: [string, string | null | undefined][] = [
    ['Cinsiyet', c.gender ? (GENDER[c.gender] ?? c.gender) : null],
    ['Yaş', c.age],
    ['Doğum günü', fuzzyDate(c.dateOfBirth)],
    ['Kan grubu', c.bloodType],
    ['Japonca', c.name.native],
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-16 pb-10">
      <PersonHero image={c.image.large} label="Karakter" head={head} tail={tail} sub={c.name.native ?? c.name.alternative?.join(' · ')}>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-sm text-primary-foreground">
          <Heart className="size-4 fill-current" /> {compact(c.favourites)} favori
        </span>
        {facts
          .filter(([, v]) => v)
          .map(([k, v]) => (
            <span key={k} className="rounded-full border border-foreground/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/85">
              <span className="text-foreground/50">{k}:</span> {v}
            </span>
          ))}
      </PersonHero>

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <section className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-5">
          <SectionHeading eyebrow="Biyografi" title="Karakter" accent="hakkında" />
          <ExpandableText text={stripHtml(c.description)} lines={8} />
        </section>

        {voiceActors.length > 0 && (
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <SectionHeading eyebrow="Ses" title="Seslendiren" accent="sanatçılar" />
            <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8">
              {voiceActors.map((v) => (
                <li key={v.id}>
                  <Link href={`/seslendirmen/${v.id}`} className="group flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={v.image.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="aspect-[3/4] w-full rounded-2xl object-cover ring-1 ring-border transition group-hover:-translate-y-1" />
                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{v.name.full}</span>
                    <span className="-mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{v.languageV2}</span>
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        )}

        <section className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <SectionHeading eyebrow="Filmografi" title="Yer aldığı" accent="animeler" />
          <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
            {c.media.edges.map((e) => (
              <li key={e.node.id}>
                <Link href={`/anime/${e.node.id}`} className="group flex flex-col gap-2">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={e.node.coverImage.extraLarge || e.node.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-2xl object-cover ring-1 ring-border transition group-hover:-translate-y-1 group-hover:shadow-xl" />
                  <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-ink">{roleTr(e.characterRole)}</span>
                  <span className="line-clamp-2 text-sm font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{pickTitle(e.node.title)}</span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: app\(site)\karsilastir\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { getCompare } from '@/lib/anilist'
import type { MediaDetail } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { compact, formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, seasonTr, statusTr } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { ComparePicker } from '@/components/compare/compare-picker'

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Karşılaştır', description: 'İki animeyi puan, popülerlik ve detaylarına göre yan yana karşılaştır.' }

type SP = Promise<{ a?: string; b?: string }>

function Bar({ a, b, label, fmt = (n: number) => String(n) }: { a?: number | null; b?: number | null; label: string; fmt?: (n: number) => string }) {
  const av = a ?? 0
  const bv = b ?? 0
  const max = Math.max(av, bv, 1)
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-center gap-3 sm:gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
        <span className={cn('font-mono text-sm tabular-nums', av >= bv && av > 0 && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{a != null ? fmt(av) : '—'}</span>
        <div className="h-2.5 w-full max-w-60 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <div className="ml-auto h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(av / max) * 100}%`, opacity: av >= bv ? 1 : 0.45 }} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <span className="label-mono w-24 text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground sm:w-32">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="h-2.5 w-full max-w-60 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(bv / max) * 100}%`, opacity: bv >= av ? 1 : 0.45 }} />
        </div>
        <span className={cn('font-mono text-sm tabular-nums', bv >= av && bv > 0 && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{b != null ? fmt(bv) : '—'}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Side({ m, align }: { m?: MediaDetail; align: 'left' | 'right' }) {
  if (!m) return <div className="grid aspect-[2/3] w-full max-w-56 place-items-center rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border text-sm text-muted-foreground">Anime seç</div>
  return (
    <Link href={`/anime/${m.id}`} className={cn('group flex flex-col gap-3', align === 'right' ? 'items-start' : 'items-end text-right')}>
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full max-w-56 rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-xl transition group-hover:-translate-y-1" />
      <p className="text-lg font-semibold leading-tight group-hover:text-ink sm:text-xl">{pickTitle(m.title)}</p>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{[m.seasonYear, formatTr(m.format), statusTr(m.status)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</p>
    </Link>
  )
}

export default async function ComparePage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: SP }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const ids = [sp.a, sp.b].map(Number).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0)
  const list = await getCompare(ids)
  const a = list.find((m) => m.id === Number(sp.a))
  const b = list.find((m) => m.id === Number(sp.b))
  const completed = (m?: MediaDetail) => m?.stats?.statusDistribution?.find((s) => s.status === 'COMPLETED')?.amount ?? null

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1200px] flex-col gap-10 px-4 pb-10 pt-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10 lg:pt-14">
      <SectionHeading as="h1" eyebrow="Kafa kafaya" title="İki animeyi" accent="karşılaştır" description="İki yapımı seç; puan, popülerlik, bölüm sayısı ve daha fazlasını yan yana gör." />
      <ComparePicker a={a ? { id: a.id, title: pickTitle(a.title) } : null} b={b ? { id: b.id, title: pickTitle(b.title) } : null} />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] items-start gap-4 sm:gap-10">
        <Side m={a} align="left" />
        <span className="mt-24 font-serif text-4xl italic text-ink sm:text-6xl">vs</span>
        <Side m={b} align="right" />
      </div>
      {a && b && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-[2rem] border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-10">
          <Bar label="Ortalama puan" a={a.averageScore} b={b.averageScore} fmt={(n) => `${n}%`} />
          <Bar label="Popülerlik" a={a.popularity} b={b.popularity} fmt={compact} />
          <Bar label="Favori" a={a.favourites} b={b.favourites} fmt={compact} />
          <Bar label="Tamamlayan" a={completed(a)} b={completed(b)} fmt={compact} />
          <Bar label="Bölüm" a={a.episodes} b={b.episodes} />
          <Bar label="Süre (dk)" a={a.duration} b={b.duration} />
          <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] gap-3 border-t border-border pt-6 text-sm sm:gap-6">
            {(
              [
                ['Stüdyo', a.studios?.nodes[0]?.name, b.studios?.nodes[0]?.name],
                ['Sezon', a.season ? `${seasonTr(a.season)} ${a.seasonYear}` : null, b.season ? `${seasonTr(b.season)} ${b.seasonYear}` : null],
                ['Türler', a.genres?.slice(0, 3).map(genreTr).join(', '), b.genres?.slice(0, 3).map(genreTr).join(', ')],
              ] as const
            ).map(([k, x, y]) => (
              <div key={k} className="contents">
                <span className="text-right">{x ?? '—'}</span>
                <span className="label-mono w-24 text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground sm:w-32">{k}</span>
                <span>{y ?? '—'}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: app\(site)\seslendirmen\[id]\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { getStaff } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { compact, fuzzyDate, pickTitle, roleTr, splitTitle, stripHtml } from '@/lib/format'
import { ExpandableText } from '@/components/anime/expandable-text'
import { SectionHeading } from '@/components/anime/section-heading'
import { PersonHero } from '@/components/anime/person-hero'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id } = await params
  const s = await getStaff(Number(id))
  if (!s) return { title: 'Kişi bulunamadı' }
  return { title: `${s.name.full} — Seslendirmen`, description: stripHtml(s.description).slice(0, 160), openGraph: { images: s.image.large ? [s.image.large] : [] } }
}

export default async function StaffPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const s = await getStaff(Number(id))
  if (!s) notFound()
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(s.name.full)
  const roles = s.characterMedia.edges.flatMap((e) => e.characters.map((c) => ({ character: c, media: e.node, role: e.characterRole })))
  const seen = new Set<number>()
  const uniqueRoles = roles.filter((r) => (seen.has(r.character.id) ? false : (seen.add(r.character.id), true)))
  const facts: [string, string | null | undefined][] = [
    ['Meslek', s.primaryOccupations?.join(', ')],
    ['Dil', s.languageV2],
    ['Doğum', fuzzyDate(s.dateOfBirth)],
    ['Yaş', s.age ? String(s.age) : null],
    ['Memleket', s.homeTown],
    ['Aktif', s.yearsActive?.length ? `${s.yearsActive[0]}–${s.yearsActive[1] ?? 'günümüz'}` : null],
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-16 pb-10">
      <PersonHero image={s.image.large} label="Seslendirmen" head={head} tail={tail} sub={s.name.native}>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-sm text-primary-foreground">
          <Heart className="size-4 fill-current" /> {compact(s.favourites)} favori
        </span>
        {facts
          .filter(([, v]) => v)
          .map(([k, v]) => (
            <span key={k} className="rounded-full border border-foreground/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/85">
              <span className="text-foreground/50">{k}:</span> {v}
            </span>
          ))}
      </PersonHero>

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1440px] flex-col gap-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        {s.description && (
          <section className="flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-5">
            <SectionHeading eyebrow="Biyografi" title="Sanatçı" accent="hakkında" />
            <ExpandableText text={stripHtml(s.description)} lines={8} />
          </section>
        )}
        <section className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <SectionHeading eyebrow={`${uniqueRoles.length} rol`} title="Seslendirdiği" accent="karakterler" />
          <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {uniqueRoles.map((r) => (
              <li key={`${r.character.id}-${r.media.id}`} className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card">
                <Link href={`/karakter/${r.character.id}`} className="group flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 p-2 transition hover:bg-muted">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={r.character.image.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="h-20 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block truncate font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{r.character.name.full}</span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{roleTr(r.role)}</span>
                  </span>
                </Link>
                <Link href={`/anime/${r.media.id}`} className="group flex w-2/5 min-w-0 items-center justify-end gap-3 border-l border-border p-2 text-right transition hover:bg-muted">
                  <span className="line-clamp-2 text-xs font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{pickTitle(r.media.title)}</span>
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={r.media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="h-20 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: app\actions\favorites.ts =====
'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { getCurrentUser, saveUser } from '@/lib/users'

export async function toggleFavorite(animeId: number) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const, reason: 'auth' as const }
  if (!Number.isInteger(animeId) || animeId <= 0) return { ok: false as const, reason: 'invalid' as const }
  const has = user.favorites.includes(animeId)
  user.favorites = has ? user.favorites.filter((id) => id !== animeId) : [animeId, ...user.favorites].slice(0, 60)
  await saveUser(user)
  revalidatePath(`/u/${user.username}`)
  return { ok: true as const, favorite: !has }
}


===== DOSYA: app\actions\profile.ts =====
'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { THEME_IDS } from '@/lib/themes'
import { changeUsername, getCurrentUser, saveUser, type ProfileLink, type ProfileSong } from '@/lib/users'

export type ProfileInput = {
  displayName: string
  username: string
  bio: string
  location: string
  avatar: string
  background: string
  backgroundDim: number
  accent: string
  links: ProfileLink[]
  song: ProfileSong
  favorites: number[]
  effects: { tilt: boolean; typewriter: boolean; glow: boolean }
}

const LINK_TYPES = new Set(['discord', 'github', 'instagram', 'x', 'youtube', 'spotify', 'twitch', 'tiktok', 'steam', 'website'])

function safeUrl(u: string) {
  if (!u) return ''
  try {
    const url = new URL(u.trim())
    return url.protocol === 'https:' || url.protocol === 'http:' ? url.toString() : ''
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

export async function updateProfile(input: ProfileInput) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Oturum bulunamadı. Lütfen tekrar giriş yap.' }
  try {
    if (input.username && input.username !== user.username) await changeUsername(user, input.username)
    user.displayName = (input.displayName || user.displayName).trim().slice(0, 40)
    user.bio = (input.bio || '').slice(0, 300)
    user.location = (input.location || '').slice(0, 60)
    user.avatar = safeUrl(input.avatar) || user.avatar
    user.background = safeUrl(input.background) || null
    user.backgroundDim = Math.min(90, Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(input.backgroundDim) || 0)))
    user.accent = THEME_IDS.includes(input.accent as never) ? input.accent : 'green'
    user.links = (input.links || [])
      .filter((l) => LINK_TYPES.has(l.type))
      .map((l) => ({ type: l.type, url: l.type === 'discord' && !l.url.startsWith('http') ? l.url.slice(0, 40) : safeUrl(l.url) }))
      .filter((l) => l.url)
      .slice(0, 8)
    user.song = input.song && safeUrl(input.song.url) ? { title: input.song.title.slice(0, 100), artist: input.song.artist.slice(0, 100), url: safeUrl(input.song.url), cover: input.song.cover ? safeUrl(input.song.cover) : null } : null
    user.favorites = (input.favorites || []).filter((n) => Number.isInteger(n)).slice(0, 60)
    user.effects = { tilt: Boolean(input.effects?.tilt), typewriter: Boolean(input.effects?.typewriter), glow: Boolean(input.effects?.glow) }
    await saveUser(user)
    revalidatePath(`/u/${user.username}`)
    revalidatePath('/profil')
    return { ok: true as const, username: user.username }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

===== DOSYA: app\admin\actions.ts =====
'use server'

import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { ADMIN_COOKIE, cookieOptions, isAdmin, safeEqual, sign } from '@/lib/session'
import { addEpisode, clearLogs, deleteEpisode, logEvent, saveSettings, type SiteSettings } from '@/lib/site'
import { storeHealth } from '@/lib/store'
import { getUser, saveUser } from '@/lib/users'

const attempts = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()

async function guard() {
  if (!(await isAdmin())) throw new Error('Yetkisiz işlem')
}

export async function adminLogin(_: unknown, formData: FormData) {
  const h = await headers()
  const ip = h.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'local'
  const now = Date.now()
  const a = attempts.get(ip)
  if (a && now - a.at < 15 * 60_000 && a.n >= 6) return { error: 'Çok fazla hatalı deneme. 15 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }
  const expected = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD
  if (!expected) return { error: 'ADMIN_PASSWORD ortam değişkeni tanımlı değil. Vercel proje ayarlarından (Vars) ekleyin.' }
  const password = String(formData.get('password') ?? '')
  if (!password || !safeEqual(password, expected)) {
    attempts.set(ip, a && now - a.at < 15 * 60_000 ? { n: a.n + 1, at: a.at } : { n: 1, at: now })
    await logEvent({ level: 'warn', source: 'server', message: `Hatalı admin girişi denemesi (${ip})`, path: '/admin' })
    return { error: 'Şifre hatalı.' }
  }
  attempts.delete(ip)
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(ADMIN_COOKIE, sign({ admin: true, exp: Date.now() + 12 * 3600_000 }), cookieOptions(12 * 3600))
  revalidatePath('/admin')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function adminLogout() {
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(ADMIN_COOKIE, '', cookieOptions(0))
  revalidatePath('/admin')
}

export async function saveSiteSettings(patch: Partial<SiteSettings>) {
  await guard()
  const next = await saveSettings(patch)
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
  return next
}

export async function addEpisodeAction(input: {
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  animeCover?: string | null
  number: number
  title: string
  videoUrl: string
  subtitleUrl?: string
  subtitleText?: string
  subtitleLang: string
  thumbnail?: string
}) {
  await guard()
  const isUrl = (u?: string) => {
    if (!u) return false
    try {
      const p = new URL(u).protocol
      return p === 'https:' || p === 'http:'
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.animeId) || input.animeId <= 0) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Anime seçmelisin.' }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.number) || input.number <= 0 || input.number > 5000) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Geçerli bir bölüm numarası gir.' }
  if (!isUrl(input.videoUrl)) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Geçerli bir video (MP4) bağlantısı gir.' }
  if (input.subtitleUrl && !isUrl(input.subtitleUrl)) return { ok: false as const, error: 'Altyazı bağlantısı geçersiz.' }
  const ep = await addEpisode({
    animeId: input.animeId,
    animeTitle: input.animeTitle.slice(0, 200),
    animeCover: input.animeCover ?? null,
    number: input.number,
    title: input.title.slice(0, 200),
    videoUrl: input.videoUrl,
    subtitleUrl: input.subtitleUrl || null,
    subtitleText: input.subtitleText ? input.subtitleText.slice(0, 500_000) : null,
    subtitleLang: (input.subtitleLang || 'tr').slice(0, 5),
    thumbnail: isUrl(input.thumbnail) ? input.thumbnail : null,
  })
  revalidatePath(`/anime/${input.animeId}`)
  revalidatePath('/')
  return { ok: true as const, id: ep.id }
}

export async function deleteEpisodeAction(animeId: number, id: string) {
  await guard()
  await deleteEpisode(animeId, id)
  revalidatePath(`/anime/${animeId}`)
  revalidatePath('/admin')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function clearLogsAction() {
  await guard()
  await clearLogs()
  revalidatePath('/admin')
}

export async function setUserBanned(id: string, banned: boolean) {
  await guard()
  const u = await getUser(id)
  if (!u) return { ok: false }
  u.banned = banned
  await saveUser(u)
  revalidatePath('/admin')
  return { ok: true }
}

export async function purgeCache() {
  await guard()
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
  return { ok: true, at: Date.now() }
}

export async function testIntegration(name: 'anilist' | 'gemini' | 'store' | 'ollama' | 'animethemes') {
  await guard()
  const started = Date.now()
  try {
    if (name === 'store') {
      const h = await storeHealth()
      return { ok: h.ok, ms: h.ms, detail: h.ok ? (process.env.DATABASE_URL ? 'Postgres bağlantısı başarılı' : 'Geçici bellek deposu (kalıcı değil)') : h.error }
    }
    if (name === 'anilist') {
      const res = await fetch('https://graphql.anilist.co', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: '{ SiteStatistics { anime(perPage:1) { nodes { count } } } }' }), cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status} · limit ${res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining') ?? '?'} kaldı` }
    }
    if (name === 'animethemes') {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.animethemes.moe/anime?page[size]=1', { cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Sytheris/1.0 (+https://sytheris.vercel.app)', Accept: 'application/json' } })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    if (name === 'gemini') {
      const key = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
      if (!key) return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'GEMINI_API_KEY tanımlı değil' }
      const res = await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=1', { headers: { 'x-goog-api-key': key }, cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: res.ok ? 'API anahtarı geçerli' : `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    if (name === 'ollama') {
      if (!process.env.OLLAMA_URL) return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'OLLAMA_URL tanımlı değil (yerel Ollama tarayıcıdan denenir)' }
      const res = await fetch(`${process.env.OLLAMA_URL.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/tags`, { cache: 'no-store' })
      return { ok: res.ok, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: `HTTP ${res.status}` }
    }
    return { ok: false, ms: 0, detail: 'Bilinmeyen entegrasyon' }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, ms: Date.now() - started, detail: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {tab === 'genel' && (
          <>

              <Stat label="Durum" value={settings.maintenance ? 'Bakım' : 'Yayında'} tone={settings.maintenance ? 'warn' : 'ok'} hint={settings.announcement ? 'Duyuru aktif' : 'Duyuru yok'} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-6">
                <p className="mb-4 font-semibold">Son eklenen bölümler</p>
                {catalog.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Henüz video eklenmedi.{' '}
                    <Link className="text-ink underline" href="/admin?tab=videolar">
                      İlk bölümü ekle
                    </Link>

                ) : (

                {logs.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Kayıtlı hata yok. Her şey yolunda.</p>
                ) : (
                  <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {logs.slice(0, 5).map((l) => (
                      <li key={l.id} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                        <span className={cn('mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', l.level === 'error' ? 'bg-destructive' : 'bg-primary')} />

                        <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{new Date(l.at).toLocaleTimeString('tr-TR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {tab === 'videolar' && <EpisodeManager catalog={episodesByAnime} />}
        {tab === 'bakim' && <SettingsForm initial={settings} />}
        {tab === 'entegrasyonlar' && (
          <IntegrationPanel
            origin={origin}
            groups={ENV_GROUPS.map((g) => ({ ...g, vars: g.vars.map((v) => ({ ...v, set: Boolean(process.env[v.key]) })) }))}
            providers={providerStatus()}
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'hatalar' && <LogsPanel logs={logs} />}
        {tab === 'kullanicilar' && <UsersTable users={users.map(toPublic)} />}
        {tab === 'teknik' && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
              <Stat label="Node.js" value={process.version} />
              <Stat label="Ortam" value={process.env.VERCEL_ENV ?? process.env.NODE_ENV ?? '—'} hint={process.env.VERCEL_REGION ? `Bölge: ${process.env.VERCEL_REGION}` : 'Yerel'} />
              <Stat label="Çalışma süresi" value={`${Math.floor(process.uptime() / 60)} dk`} hint="Bu sunucu örneği" />
              <Stat label="Bellek" value={`${Math.round(mem.rss / 1048576)} MB`} hint={`Heap ${Math.round(mem.heapUsed / 1048576)} MB`} />
            </div>
            <dl className="divide-y divide-border rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card px-6 font-mono text-sm">
              {[
                ['Commit', process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA?.slice(0, 7) ?? 'yerel'],
                ['Dal', process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF ?? '—'],
                ['Depo', `${storeBackend()} · ${health.ok ? 'sağlıklı' : 'hata'} · ${health.ms}ms`],
                ['Alan adı', host],
                ['Önbellek', 'AniList 30 dk · takvim 30 dk · arama 15 dk'],
                ['Güvenlik başlıkları', 'nosniff · HSTS · Referrer-Policy · Permissions-Policy'],
              ].map(([k, v]) => (
                <div key={k} className="flex justify-between gap-4 py-3">
                  <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
                  <dd className="truncate text-right">{v}</dd>
                </div>
              ))}
            </dl>
            <TechActions />
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\ai\route.ts =====
import { getSettings, logEvent } from '@/lib/site'

export const maxDuration = 60

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Sen "Sytheris AI"sın: Sytheris anime keşif platformunun Türkçe konuşan asistanısın.
- Her zaman Türkçe, samimi ama net yanıt ver. Emoji kullanma.
- Anime önerirken 3-5 başlık ver; her biri için tek cümlelik neden ve tür bilgisini ekle. Başlıkları **kalın** yaz.
- Spoiler verme; kullanıcı açıkça isterse önce uyar.
- Bilmediğin bir şeyi uydurma. Kısa paragraflar ve madde işaretleri kullan.`

type Msg = { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }

async function geminiStream(messages: Msg[]) {
  const key = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || process.env.GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
  if (!key) throw new Error('GEMINI_API_KEY tanımlı değil')
  const models = [process.env.GEMINI_MODEL, 'gemini-flash-latest', 'gemini-2.5-flash'].filter(Boolean) as string[]
  let lastError = ''
  for (const model of models) {
    const res = await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': key },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: SYSTEM_PROMPT }] },
        contents: messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user', parts: [{ text: m.content }] })),
        generationConfig: { temperature: 0.8, maxOutputTokens: 1200 },
      }),
    })
    if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
      lastError = `Gemini ${res.status}: ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 200)}`
      continue
    }
    const reader = res.body.getReader()
    const decoder = new TextDecoder()
    const encoder = new TextEncoder()
    return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
      async start(controller) {
        let buffer = ''
        try {
          while (true) {
            const { value, done } = await reader.read()
            if (done) break
            buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
            const lines = buffer.split('\n')
            buffer = lines.pop() ?? ''
            for (const line of lines) {
              if (!line.startsWith('data:')) continue
              try {
                const json = JSON.parse(line.slice(5))
                const text = json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map((p: { text?: string }) => p.text ?? '').join('') ?? ''
                if (text) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(text))
              } catch {}
            }
          }
        } finally {
          controller.close()
        }
      },
    })
  }
  throw new Error(lastError || 'Gemini yanıt vermedi')
}

async function ollamaStream(messages: Msg[]) {
  const base = process.env.OLLAMA_URL
  if (!base) throw new Error('OLLAMA_URL tanımlı değil')
  const res = await fetch(`${base.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/chat`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.2',
      stream: true,
      messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYSTEM_PROMPT }, ...messages],
    }),
  })
  if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new Error(`Ollama ${res.status}`)
  const reader = res.body.getReader()
  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    async start(controller) {
      let buffer = ''
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { value, done } = await reader.read()
          if (done) break
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
          const lines = buffer.split('\n')
          buffer = lines.pop() ?? ''
          for (const line of lines) {
            if (!line.trim()) continue
            try {
              const text = JSON.parse(line).message?.content
              if (text) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(text))
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      } finally {
        controller.close()
      }
    },
  })
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const settings = await getSettings()
  if (!settings.aiEnabled) return new Response('Yapay zekâ asistanı yönetici tarafından kapatıldı.', { status: 503 })

  let body: { messages?: Msg[]; provider?: 'auto' | 'gemini' | 'ollama' }
  try {
    body = await request.json()
  } catch {
    return new Response('Geçersiz istek', { status: 400 })
  }
  const messages = (body.messages ?? [])
    .filter((m) => (m.role === 'user' || m.role === 'assistant') && typeof m.content === 'string')
    .slice(-12)
    .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content.slice(0, 4000) }))
  if (!messages.length) return new Response('Mesaj yok', { status: 400 })

  const order: ('gemini' | 'ollama')[] = body.provider === 'ollama' ? ['ollama', 'gemini'] : ['gemini', 'ollama']
  const errors: string[] = []
  for (const p of order) {
    try {
      const stream = p === 'gemini' ? await geminiStream(messages) : await ollamaStream(messages)
      return new Response(stream, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'X-AI-Provider': p },
      })
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push((e as Error).message)
    }
  }
  await logEvent({ level: 'warn', source: 'server', message: `AI sağlayıcıları başarısız: ${errors.join(' | ')}`, path: '/api/ai' })
  return new Response(
    'Şu an hiçbir yapay zekâ sağlayıcısına ulaşılamıyor. Yerel Ollama çalışıyorsa Ayarlar > Yapay zekâ bölümünden adresini kontrol et ya da yöneticiden GEMINI_API_KEY eklemesini iste.',
    { status: 503, headers: { 'X-AI-Errors': encodeURIComponent(errors.join(' | ')) } },
  )
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\auth\email\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { SESSION_COOKIE, cookieOptions, sign } from '@/lib/session'
import { getSettings } from '@/lib/site'
import { loginEmail, registerEmail } from '@/lib/users'

const attempts = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'local'
  const now = Date.now()
  const a = attempts.get(ip)
  if (a && now - a.at < 10 * 60_000 && a.n >= 10) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Çok fazla deneme. 10 dakika sonra tekrar dene.' }, { status: 429 })
  attempts.set(ip, a && now - a.at < 10 * 60_000 ? { n: a.n + 1, at: a.at } : { n: 1, at: now })

  let body: { mode?: string; email?: string; password?: string; name?: string }
  try {
    body = await request.json()
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Geçersiz istek' }, { status: 400 })
  }
  const email = String(body.email ?? '').trim()
  const password = String(body.password ?? '')
  const name = String(body.name ?? '').trim().slice(0, 40)
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email) || email.length > 120) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Geçerli bir e-posta gir.' }, { status: 400 })
  if (password.length < 8 || password.length > 128) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Şifre en az 8 karakter olmalı.' }, { status: 400 })

  try {
    let user
    if (body.mode === 'register') {
      const settings = await getSettings()
      if (!settings.registrationsOpen) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Yeni kayıtlar şu an kapalı.' }, { status: 403 })
      user = await registerEmail(email, password, name)
    } else {
      user = await loginEmail(email, password)
    }
    const res = NextResponse.json({ ok: true, username: user.username })
    res.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE, sign({ uid: user.id, exp: Date.now() + 30 * 86400_000 }), cookieOptions(30 * 86400))
    attempts.delete(ip)
    return res
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: (e as Error).message }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

===== DOSYA: app\api\auth\[provider]\callback\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { OAUTH, appOrigin, isProvider } from '@/lib/oauth'
import { SESSION_COOKIE, cookieOptions, sign, verify } from '@/lib/session'
import { logEvent } from '@/lib/site'
import { upsertOAuthUser } from '@/lib/users'

function popupPage(origin: string, ok: boolean, message = '') {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ type: 'sy-auth', ok, message })
  const html = `<!doctype html><html lang="tr"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>SYTHERIS</title><style>body{margin:0;display:grid;place-items:center;height:100vh;background:#0b0f0d;color:#f2f2f2;font-family:system-ui}</style></head><body><p>${ok ? 'Giriş başarılı, yönlendiriliyorsun…' : 'Giriş başarısız.'}</p><script>try{if(window.opener){window.opener.postMessage(${payload},${JSON.stringify(origin)});window.close()}else{location.replace(${JSON.stringify(ok ? `${origin}/profil` : `${origin}/giris?error=oauth`)})}}catch(e){location.replace(${JSON.stringify(`${origin}/profil`)})}</script></body></html>`
  return new NextResponse(html, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' } })
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ provider: string }> }) {
  const { provider } = await params
  const origin = appOrigin(request)
  const fail = (code: string, popup = false) => (popup ? popupPage(origin, false, code) : NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/giris?error=${code}`))
  if (!isProvider(provider)) return fail('provider')

  const stored = verify<{ state: string; provider: string; popup: boolean }>(request.cookies.get('sy_oauth')?.value)
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const code = url.searchParams.get('code')
  const state = url.searchParams.get('state')
  const popup = Boolean(stored?.popup)
  if (url.searchParams.get('error')) return fail('denied', popup)
  if (!stored || stored.provider !== provider || stored.state !== state || !code) return fail('state', popup)

  const cfg = OAUTH[provider]
  try {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: process.env[cfg.envId] as string,
      client_secret: process.env[cfg.envSecret] as string,
      grant_type: 'authorization_code',
      code,
      redirect_uri: `${origin}/api/auth/${provider}/callback`,
    })
    const tokenRes = await fetch(cfg.token, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', Accept: 'application/json' },
      body,
    })
    const token = (await tokenRes.json()) as { access_token?: string; error?: string; error_description?: string }
    if (!token.access_token) throw new Error(token.error_description || token.error || `token ${tokenRes.status}`)
    const profile = await cfg.profile(token.access_token)
    const user = await upsertOAuthUser({ provider, providerId: profile.id, name: profile.name, email: profile.email, avatar: profile.avatar })
    if (user.banned) return fail('banned', popup)

    const res = popup ? popupPage(origin, true) : NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/profil`)
    res.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE, sign({ uid: user.id, exp: Date.now() + 30 * 86400_000 }), cookieOptions(30 * 86400))
    res.cookies.set('sy_oauth', '', { ...cookieOptions(0) })
    return res
  } catch (e) {
    await logEvent({ level: 'error', source: 'server', message: `${cfg.label} OAuth hatası: ${(e as Error).message}`, path: `/api/auth/${provider}/callback` })
    return fail('oauth', popup)
  }
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\auth\[provider]\route.ts =====
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { OAUTH, appOrigin, isProvider } from '@/lib/oauth'
import { cookieOptions, sign } from '@/lib/session'

export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ provider: string }> }) {
  const { provider } = await params
  const origin = appOrigin(request)
  if (!isProvider(provider)) return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/giris?error=provider`)
  const cfg = OAUTH[provider]
  const clientId = process.env[cfg.envId]
  if (!clientId || !process.env[cfg.envSecret]) return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/giris?error=not_configured&provider=${provider}`)

  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const popup = url.searchParams.get('popup') === '1'
  const state = randomBytes(16).toString('hex')
  const redirectUri = `${origin}/api/auth/${provider}/callback`

  const auth = new URL(cfg.authorize)
  auth.searchParams.set('client_id', clientId)
  auth.searchParams.set('redirect_uri', redirectUri)
  auth.searchParams.set('response_type', 'code')
  auth.searchParams.set('scope', cfg.scope)
  auth.searchParams.set('state', state)
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cfg.extra ?? {})) auth.searchParams.set(k, v)

  const res = NextResponse.redirect(auth.toString())
  res.cookies.set('sy_oauth', sign({ state, provider, popup, exp: Date.now() + 10 * 60_000 }), cookieOptions(600))
  return res
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\log\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { logEvent } from '@/lib/site'

const hits = new Map<string, { n: number; at: number }>()

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() || 'local'
  const now = Date.now()
  const h = hits.get(ip)
  if (h && now - h.at < 60_000 && h.n > 20) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 429 })
  hits.set(ip, h && now - h.at < 60_000 ? { n: h.n + 1, at: h.at } : { n: 1, at: now })

  try {
    const body = (await request.json()) as { message?: string; stack?: string; path?: string }
    if (!body.message) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
    await logEvent({
      level: 'error',
      source: 'client',
      message: String(body.message),
      stack: body.stack ? String(body.stack) : undefined,
      path: body.path ? String(body.path).slice(0, 200) : undefined,
      userAgent: request.headers.get('user-agent')?.slice(0, 200) ?? undefined,
    })
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true })
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
  }
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\music\search\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

type AnimeTheme = {
  id: number
  slug: string
  type: string
  anime?: { name: string; images?: { facet: string; link: string }[] }
  song?: { title?: string; artists?: { name: string }[] }
  animethemeentries?: { videos?: { audio?: { link?: string } }[] }[]
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const q = (searchParams.get('q') || '').trim().slice(0, 80)
  const source = searchParams.get('source') === 'song' ? 'song' : 'anime'
  if (q.length < 2) return NextResponse.json({ results: [] })

  try {
    if (source === 'anime') {
      const url = new URL('https://api.animethemes.moe/search')
      url.searchParams.set('q', q)
      url.searchParams.set('fields[search]', 'animethemes')
      url.searchParams.set('include[animetheme]', 'animethemeentries.videos.audio,song.artists,anime.images')
      url.searchParams.set('page[limit]', '15')
      const res = await fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 86400 }, headers: { Accept: 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'Sytheris/1.0 (+https://sytheris.vercel.app)' } })
      const json = (await res.json()) as { search?: { animethemes?: AnimeTheme[] } }
      const results = (json.search?.animethemes ?? [])
        .map((t) => {
          const audio = t.animethemeentries?.flatMap((e) => e.videos ?? []).find((v) => v.audio?.link)?.audio?.link
          if (!audio) return null
          const cover = t.anime?.images?.find((i) => i.facet === 'Large Cover')?.link ?? t.anime?.images?.[0]?.link ?? null
          return {
            id: `at-${t.id}`,
            title: t.song?.title || t.slug,
            artist: t.song?.artists?.map((a) => a.name).join(', ') || 'Bilinmeyen sanatçı',
            url: audio,
            cover,
            source: 'animethemes' as const,
            anime: t.anime?.name ?? null,
            kind: t.slug,
          }
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
      return NextResponse.json({ results })
    }

    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&media=music&entity=song&limit=15`, {
      next: { revalidate: 86400 },
    })
    const json = (await res.json()) as {
      results?: { trackId: number; trackName: string; artistName: string; previewUrl?: string; artworkUrl100?: string; collectionName?: string }[]
    }
    const results = (json.results ?? [])
      .filter((r) => r.previewUrl)
      .map((r) => ({
        id: `it-${r.trackId}`,
        title: r.trackName,
        artist: r.artistName,
        url: r.previewUrl as string,
        cover: r.artworkUrl100?.replace('100x100bb', '400x400bb') ?? null,
        source: 'itunes' as const,
        anime: r.collectionName ?? null,
        kind: 'Önizleme',
      }))
    return NextResponse.json({ results })
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ results: [], error: (e as Error).message }, { status: 200 })
  }
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\profile\view\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { getUserByUsername, saveUser } from '@/lib/users'

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const { username } = (await request.json()) as { username?: string }
    if (!username) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
    const user = await getUserByUsername(String(username).slice(0, 30))
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 404 })
    user.views = (user.views || 0) + 1
    await saveUser(user)
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, views: user.views })
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 400 })
  }
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\search\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { quickSearch } from '@/lib/anilist'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const q = (new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('q') || '').trim().slice(0, 80)
  if (q.length < 2) return NextResponse.json({ results: [] })
  const results = await quickSearch(q)
  return NextResponse.json({ results }, { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'public, s-maxage=600, stale-while-revalidate=3600' } })
}


===== DOSYA: app\api\subtitle\upload\route.ts =====
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { kvSet } from '@/lib/store';
import { toVtt } from '@/lib/subtitles'; // Senin kendi çevirici fonksiyonun

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get('subtitle') as File;
    const episodeId = formData.get('episodeId') as string;
    const animeId = formData.get('animeId') as string;

    if (!file || !episodeId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ message: 'File or episode ID is missing.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const fileContent = await file.text();
    
    // Eğer senin lib/subtitles.ts dosyan varsa onu kullan, yoksa basitçe VTT'ye çevir
    const vttContent = toVtt ? toVtt(fileContent) : 'WEBVTT\n\n' + fileContent;

    const key = `subtitle:${animeId}:${episodeId}`;
    await kvSet(key, vttContent);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Subtitle saved successfully.' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Subtitle upload error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Internal server error.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

===== DOSYA: app\api\subtitle\[id]\route.ts =====
import { getEpisodeById, logEvent } from '@/lib/site'
import { toVtt } from '@/lib/subtitles'

export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const ep = await getEpisodeById(id)
  if (!ep) return new Response('Bulunamadı', { status: 404 })

  let raw = ep.subtitleText ?? ''
  if (!raw && ep.subtitleUrl) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(ep.subtitleUrl)
      if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && url.protocol !== 'http:') throw new Error('Geçersiz protokol')
      const res = await fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)
      raw = await res.text()
    } catch (e) {
      await logEvent({ 
        level: 'warn', 
        source: 'server', 
        message: `Altyazı alınamadı (${ep.animeTitle} #${ep.number}): ${(e as Error).message}`, 
        path: `/api/subtitle/${id}` 
      })
      return new Response('WEBVTT\n', { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/vtt; charset=utf-8' } })
    }
  }
  
  return new Response(toVtt(raw || ''), {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/vtt; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=300' },
  })
}

  const [settings, admin, h] = await Promise.all([getSettings(), isAdmin(), headers()])
  const pathname = h.get('x-pathname') ?? '/'
  const bypass = admin || pathname.startsWith('/admin') || pathname.startsWith('/api')
  const showMaintenance = settings.maintenance && !bypass

  return (

      lang="tr"
      data-theme="green"

      suppressHydrationWarning
      className={`${bricolage.variable} ${instrument.variable} ${jetbrains.variable} bg-background`}

          id="sy-boot-script"
          strategy="beforeInteractive"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: BOOT_SCRIPT }}
        />
        
        {/* 🚨 Service Worker Kaydı (PWA için gerekli) */}
        <Script
          id="sw-register"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
            __html: `
              if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
                window.addEventListener('load', function() {
                  navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js');
                });
              }
            `,
          }}
        />

        <AppProviders introEnabled={settings.introEnabled}>
          {showMaintenance ? <MaintenanceScreen settings={settings} /> : children}
        </AppProviders>
        
        {/* 🚨 Yüzen Animasyonlu Uygulama İndirme Butonu */}
        <FloatingInstall />

        {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && <Analytics />}
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}

export default async function OG() {
