===== DOSYA: components\anime\trailer-button.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Film, Loader2, Pause, Play, RotateCcw, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui-kit/modal'
import { YTTrailer, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

export function TrailerButton({ videoId, title, poster }: { videoId: string; title: string; poster?: string | null }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="flex h-13 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-foreground/25 px-5 font-medium backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-foreground/10"
      >
        <Film className="size-4" />
        Fragmanı izle
      </button>
      <Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title={`${title} fragmanı`} hideTitle className="dark bg-scrim sm:max-w-5xl">
        {open && <TrailerStage videoId={videoId} poster={poster} />}
      </Modal>
    </>
  )
}

function TrailerStage({ videoId, poster }: { videoId: string; poster?: string | null }) {
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const [state, setState] = useState<'loading' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'error'>('loading')
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-on-scrim">
      {poster && state !== 'playing' && state !== 'paused' && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={poster || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover opacity-40" />
      )}
      {state !== 'error' && (
        <YTTrailer
          ref={yt}
          videoId={videoId}
          muted={false}
          loop={false}
          onPlaying={() => {
            setState('playing')
            yt.current?.unMute()
          }}
          onEnded={() => setState('paused')}
          onError={() => setState('error')}
        />
      )}
      {state === 'loading' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
          <Loader2 className="size-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
        </div>
      )}
      {state === 'error' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold">Bu fragman gömülü oynatmaya izin vermiyor</p>
          <a
            href={`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground"
          >
            YouTube&apos;da aç <ExternalLink className="size-4" />
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
      {(state === 'playing' || state === 'paused') && (
        <>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={state === 'playing' ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
            className="absolute inset-0"
            onClick={() => {
              if (state === 'playing') {
                yt.current?.pause()
                setState('paused')
              } else {
                yt.current?.play()
                setState('playing')
              }
            }}
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-t from-scrim/90 to-transparent p-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={state === 'playing' ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
              onClick={() => {
                if (state === 'playing') {
                  yt.current?.pause()
                  setState('paused')
                } else {
                  yt.current?.play()
                  setState('playing')
                }
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
            >
              {state === 'playing' ? <Pause className="size-5" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-5" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Baştan başlat"
              onClick={() => {
                yt.current?.restart()
                setState('playing')
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'}
              onClick={() => {
                if (muted) yt.current?.unMute()
                else yt.current?.mute()
                setMuted(!muted)
              }}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-on-scrim/10 backdrop-blur transition hover:bg-on-scrim/20"
            >
              {muted ? <VolumeX className="size-4" /> : <Volume2 className="size-4" />}
            </button>
            <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-on-scrim/60">Resmî fragman</span>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\auth\login-panel.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, Mail } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { themeName } from '@/lib/themes'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useTheme } from '@/components/providers/theme-provider'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'
import { ScrambleText } from '@/components/shell/scramble-text'

type P = { id: 'discord' | 'google' | 'github'; label: string; configured: boolean }

const ERRORS: Record<string, string> = {
  not_configured: 'Bu giriş yöntemi henüz yönetici tarafından yapılandırılmadı.',
  denied: 'Giriş iptal edildi.',
  state: 'Oturum doğrulanamadı, lütfen tekrar dene.',
  oauth: 'Sağlayıcıdan yanıt alınamadı. Tekrar dene.',
  banned: 'Bu hesap askıya alınmış.',
  provider: 'Geçersiz giriş yöntemi.',
}

export function LoginPanel({ providers, error, errorProvider, registrationsOpen }: { providers: P[]; error?: string; errorProvider?: string; registrationsOpen: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { theme } = useTheme()
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'register'>('login')
  const [showEmail, setShowEmail] = useState(false)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false)
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', password: '' })
  const [err, setErr] = useState(error ? (ERRORS[error] ?? 'Bir hata oluştu.') : '')

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMsg = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.origin !== location.origin || e.data?.type !== 'sy-auth') return
      if (e.data.ok) {
        toast.success('Giriş yapıldı')
        router.replace('/profil')
        router.refresh()
      } else setErr(ERRORS[e.data.message] ?? 'Giriş başarısız oldu.')
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', onMsg)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg)
  }, [router])

  function oauth(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>, p: P) {
    if (!p.configured) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setErr(`${p.label} girişi henüz yapılandırılmadı. Yönetici panelinden ${p.id.toUpperCase()}_CLIENT_ID ve ${p.id.toUpperCase()}_CLIENT_SECRET eklenmeli.`)
      return
    }
    if (window.self !== window.top) {
      e.preventDefault()
      const w = 520
      const h = 720
      window.open(`/api/auth/${p.id}?popup=1`, 'sy-auth', `width=${w},height=${h},left=${(screen.width - w) / 2},top=${(screen.height - h) / 2}`)
    }
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setBusy(true)
    setErr('')
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/email', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode, ...form }),
      })
      const json = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error || 'Bir hata oluştu')
      toast.success(mode === 'register' ? 'Hesabın oluşturuldu' : 'Tekrar hoş geldin')
      router.replace('/profil')
      router.refresh()
    } catch (e) {
      setErr((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.97 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 24, delay: 0.1 }}
      className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/60 p-7 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl sm:p-9"
    >
      <div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
        <Link href="/" className="flex flex-col leading-none" aria-label="Ana sayfa">
          <span className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">SYTHERIS</span>
          <span className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="h-px w-5 bg-primary" />
            <ScrambleText text={themeName(theme)} className="font-mono text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-primary" />
          </span>
        </Link>
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Siteye dön
        </Link>
      </div>

      <h1 className="text-balance text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight">
        {mode === 'login' ? 'Tekrar' : 'Aramıza'} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic text-primary">{mode === 'login' ? 'hoş geldin' : 'katıl'}</span>
      </h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-pretty leading-relaxed text-foreground/60">Favorilerini kaydet, profilini kişiselleştir ve kendi müziğini ekle.</p>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {err && (
          <motion.p initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/15 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-foreground">
            {err}
            {errorProvider && error === 'not_configured' ? ` (${errorProvider})` : ''}
          </motion.p>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        {!showEmail ? (
          <motion.div key="oauth" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} className="mt-7 flex flex-col gap-3">
            {providers.map((p, i) => (
              <motion.a
                key={p.id}
                href={`/api/auth/${p.id}`}
                onClick={(e) => oauth(e, p)}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={{ delay: 0.2 + i * 0.06 }}
                aria-disabled={!p.configured}
                className={cn(
                  'group flex h-14 items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-5 font-medium transition hover:border-primary/60 hover:bg-foreground/10',
                  !p.configured && 'opacity-60',
                )}
              >
                <BrandIcon name={p.id} className="size-5 text-foreground" />
                <span className="flex-1">{p.label} ile devam et</span>
                {!p.configured && <span className="font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground/50">Kurulmadı</span>}
                <ArrowRight className="size-4 opacity-0 transition group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:opacity-100" />
              </motion.a>
            ))}
            <motion.button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowEmail(true)
                setErr('')
              }}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.38 }}
              className="group flex h-14 items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-primary px-5 font-medium text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110"
            >
              <Mail className="size-5" />
              <span className="flex-1 text-left">E-posta ile devam et</span>
              <ArrowRight className="size-4 transition group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
            </motion.button>
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <motion.form key="email" onSubmit={submit} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} className="mt-7 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-2xl bg-foreground/5 p-1" role="tablist">
              {(['login', 'register'] as const).map((m) => (
                <button key={m} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={mode === m} disabled={m === 'register' && !registrationsOpen} onClick={() => setMode(m)} className={cn('rounded-xl py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition disabled:opacity-40', mode === m ? 'bg-foreground text-background' : 'text-foreground/60')}>
                  {m === 'login' ? 'Giriş yap' : 'Kayıt ol'}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {mode === 'register' && (
              <input required value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Görünen ad" aria-label="Görünen ad" autoComplete="nickname" maxLength={40} className="h-13 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-4 outline-none transition focus:border-primary" />
            )}
            <input required type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} placeholder="E-posta" aria-label="E-posta" autoComplete="email" className="h-13 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-4 outline-none transition focus:border-primary" />
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                required
                type={showPw ? 'text' : 'password'}
                minLength={8}
                value={form.password}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Şifre (en az 8 karakter)"
                aria-label="Şifre"
                autoComplete={mode === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'}
                className="h-13 w-full rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-4 pr-12 outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
              />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowPw((v) => !v)} aria-label={showPw ? 'Şifreyi gizle' : 'Şifreyi göster'} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 grid size-8 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground">
                {showPw ? <EyeOff className="size-4" /> : <Eye className="size-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="mt-2 flex h-14 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-70">
              {busy && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
              {mode === 'login' ? 'Giriş yap' : 'Hesap oluştur'}
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowEmail(false)} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 text-sm text-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground">
              <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Diğer yöntemler
            </button>
          </motion.form>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <p className="mt-8 text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/45">
        Devam ederek Sytheris kullanım koşullarını kabul etmiş olursun. Bilgilerin yalnızca hesabını oluşturmak için kullanılır.
      </p>
    </motion.div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\compare\compare-picker.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState } from 'react'
import useSWR from 'swr'
import { Loader2, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { useDebounced } from '@/components/shell/command-palette'

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json())

export function AnimePicker({ label, value, onPick }: { label: string; value: { id: number; title: string } | null; onPick: (m: MediaCard | null) => void }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const dq = useDebounced(q.trim(), 250)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR<{ results: MediaCard[] }>(dq.length > 1 ? `/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(dq)}` : null, fetcher)
  if (value) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-12 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-full border border-primary/50 bg-accent pl-5 pr-2">
        <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{value.title}</span>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onPick(null)} aria-label={`${label} temizle`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full hover:bg-background">
          <X className="size-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
      <input
        value={q}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setQ(e.target.value)
          setOpen(true)
        }}
        onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
        onBlur={() => window.setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 150)}
        placeholder={label}
        aria-label={label}
        className="h-12 w-full rounded-full border border-border bg-card pl-11 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
      />
      {isLoading && <Loader2 className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin" />}
      {open && data?.results && data.results.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-border bg-popover p-1.5 shadow-2xl">
          {data.results.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onClick={() => {
                  onPick(m)
                  setQ('')
                  setOpen(false)
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-2 text-left transition hover:bg-muted"
              >
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-12 w-9 rounded-md object-cover" />
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{pickTitle(m.title)}</span>
                  <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{m.seasonYear}</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ComparePicker({ a, b }: { a: { id: number; title: string } | null; b: { id: number; title: string } | null }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const params = useSearchParams()
  const set = (key: 'a' | 'b', m: MediaCard | null) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
    if (m) next.set(key, String(m.id))
    else next.delete(key)
    router.push(`/karsilastir?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false })
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <AnimePicker label="Birinci anime" value={a} onPick={(m) => set('a', m)} />
      <AnimePicker label="İkinci anime" value={b} onPick={(m) => set('b', m)} />
    </div>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: components\home\hero.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowRight, Info, Pause, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, splitTitle, stripHtml } from '@/lib/format'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BackdropImage } from '@/components/media/backdrop-image'
import { YTTrailer, isTrailerBroken, type YTHandle } from '@/components/media/yt-trailer'

const SLIDE_MS = 9000

export function Hero({ items }: { items: MediaCard[] }) {
  const slides = items.slice(0, 5)
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false)
  const [trailerOn, setTrailerOn] = useState(false)
  const [trailerPlaying, setTrailerPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({})
  const yt = useRef<YTHandle>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()
  const media = slides[index]

  const go = useCallback(
    (i: number) => {
      setIndex((i + slides.length) % slides.length)
      setTrailerOn(false)
      setTrailerPlaying(false)
    },
    [slides.length],
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion') || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) setPaused(true)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!media) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setTrailerOn(true), 2600)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [media])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trailerPlaying) return
    if (prefs.trailerSound) yt.current?.unMute()
    else yt.current?.mute()
  }, [prefs.trailerSound, trailerPlaying])

  if (!media) return null
  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const showTrailer = Boolean(trailerId) && trailerOn && prefs.autoplayTrailers && !failed[media.id] && !isTrailerBroken(trailerId)
  const barStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    animation: `hero-progress ${SLIDE_MS}ms linear forwards`,
    animationPlayState: paused || trailerPlaying ? 'paused' : 'running',
  }
  const onBarEnd = () => go(index + 1)

  return (
    <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground" aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Öne çıkan animeler">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          <motion.div
            key={media.id}
            className="absolute inset-0"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.08 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ opacity: { duration: 0.9 }, scale: { duration: 8, ease: 'linear' } }}
          >
            <BackdropImage media={media} priority={index === 0} />
            {showTrailer && trailerId && (
              <YTTrailer
                ref={yt}
                videoId={trailerId}
                start={6}
                loop={false}
                onPlaying={() => setTrailerPlaying(true)}
                onEnded={() => go(index + 1)}
                onError={() => {
                  setFailed((f) => ({ ...f, [media.id]: true }))
                  setTrailerPlaying(false)
                }}
              />
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim via-scrim/70 to-transparent lg:via-scrim/40" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-page to-transparent" />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-32 bg-gradient-to-b from-scrim/60 to-transparent" />
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      </div>

      <div className="mx-auto grid min-h-[min(86svh,860px)] max-w-[1440px] grid-cols-1 items-end gap-10 px-4 pb-14 pt-24 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.25fr_1fr] lg:items-center lg:px-10 lg:pb-20">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={media.id}
            initial="hidden"
            animate="show"
            exit="exit"
            variants={{ show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.07 } }, exit: { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.2 } } }}
            className="flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6"
          >
            <motion.p variants={fade} className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
              <span className="h-px w-10 bg-primary" />
              Öne çıkan <span className="text-foreground/40">/</span> <span className="text-foreground/70">0{index + 1}</span>
            </motion.p>
            <motion.h1 variants={fade} className="text-balance text-5xl font-bold leading-[0.95] tracking-[-0.04em] sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-[84px]">
              {head} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic tracking-[-0.01em] text-primary">{tail}</span>
            </motion.h1>
            <motion.div variants={fade} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {[media.seasonYear, formatTr(media.format), media.episodes ? `${media.episodes} bölüm` : null].filter(Boolean).map((t) => (

        </AnimatePresence>

        <div className="hidden flex-col gap-2 justify-self-end lg:flex lg:w-full lg:max-w-md">

            <p className="label-mono text-foreground/60">Şu an trend</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}
              aria-label={paused ? 'Otomatik geçişi başlat' : 'Otomatik geçişi durdur'}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground"

              {paused ? <Play className="size-3" /> : <Pause className="size-3" />}0{index + 1} / 0{slides.length}
            </button>
          </div>
          <ol className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {slides.map((s, i) => {
              const active = i === index
              return (
                <li key={s.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => go(i)}
                    aria-current={active}
                    className={cn(
                      'group relative flex w-full items-center gap-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border p-2.5 pr-4 text-left backdrop-blur-md transition',
                      active ? 'border-primary/50 bg-foreground/10' : 'border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/30 hover:bg-foreground/5',
                    )}
                  >
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={s.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="h-16 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className={cn('block truncate font-medium', active ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-foreground/75')}>{pickTitle(s.title)}</span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-foreground/50">{[s.seasonYear, formatTr(s.format)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className={cn('font-mono text-xs', active ? 'text-primary' : 'text-foreground/40')}>0{i + 1}</span>
                    {active && <span key={index} className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 w-full origin-left bg-primary" style={barStyle} onAnimationEnd={onBarEnd} />}
                  </button>
                </li>
              )
            })}
          </ol>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 lg:hidden" role="tablist" aria-label="Slaytlar">
          {slides.map((s, i) => (
            <button key={s.id} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={i === index} aria-label={`${i + 1}. slayt`} onClick={() => go(i)} className="relative h-1 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-foreground/20">
              {i < index && <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-primary" />}
              {i === index && <span key={index} className="absolute inset-0 origin-left bg-primary" style={barStyle} onAnimationEnd={onBarEnd} />}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

const fade = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 24, filter: 'blur(8px)' },
  show: { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)', transition: { duration: 0.7, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] as const } },
}

===== DOSYA: components\media\backdrop-image.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/**
 * Picks the sharpest landscape artwork available: the trailer's 1280x720 YouTube
 * thumbnail first, then the AniList banner, then a blurred cover as a last resort.
 */
export function backdropCandidates(media: MediaCard) {
  const list: { src: string; kind: 'yt' | 'banner' | 'cover' }[] = []
  if (media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' && media.trailer.id) list.push({ src: `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${media.trailer.id}/maxresdefault.jpg`, kind: 'yt' })
  if (media.bannerImage) list.push({ src: media.bannerImage, kind: 'banner' })
  const cover = media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large
  if (cover) list.push({ src: cover, kind: 'cover' })
  return list
}

export function BackdropImage({ media, className, priority }: { media: MediaCard; className?: string; priority?: boolean }) {
  const candidates = backdropCandidates(media)
  const [i, setI] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => setI(0), [media.id])
  const current = candidates[i]
  if (!current) return <div className={cn('absolute inset-0 bg-scrim', className)} />
  const isCover = current.kind === 'cover'
  return (
    <>
      {isCover && (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={current.src || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" aria-hidden="true" className={cn('absolute inset-0 size-full scale-110 object-cover blur-2xl', className)} />
      )}
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img
        key={current.src}
        src={current.src || '/placeholder.svg'}
        alt=""
        aria-hidden="true"
        fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'}
        decoding="async"
        onLoad={(e) => {
          if (current.kind === 'yt' && e.currentTarget.naturalWidth <= 320) setI((n) => n + 1)
        }}
        onError={() => setI((n) => n + 1)}
        className={cn('absolute inset-0 size-full', isCover ? 'object-contain object-right py-10' : 'object-cover', className)}
      />
    </>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\media\yt-trailer.tsx =====
'use client'

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const broken = new Set<string>()
function loadBroken() {
  try {
    for (const id of JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sy-yt-broken') || '[]')) broken.add(id)
  } catch {}
}
function markBroken(id: string) {
  broken.add(id)
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem('sy-yt-broken', JSON.stringify([...broken]))
  } catch {}
}
export function isTrailerBroken(id?: string | null) {
  if (!id) return true
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && broken.size === 0) loadBroken()
  return broken.has(id)
}

export type YTHandle = {
  mute: () => void
  unMute: () => void
  play: () => void
  pause: () => void
  restart: () => void
}

type Props = {
  videoId: string
  muted?: boolean
  start?: number
  fit?: 'cover' | 'crop'
  className?: string
  onPlaying?: () => void
  onError?: () => void
  onEnded?: () => void
  loop?: boolean
}

/**
 * Chrome-less YouTube trailer. Uses the IFrame postMessage protocol directly so we can
 * hide the iframe until the video is actually playing (no YouTube UI flashes) and detect
 * embed-blocked videos to fall back gracefully.
 */
export const YTTrailer = forwardRef<YTHandle, Props>(function YTTrailer(
  { videoId, muted = true, start = 0, fit = 'cover', className, onPlaying, onError, onEnded, loop = true },
  ref,
) {
  const frame = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null)
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState('')
  const visibleRef = useRef(false)
  const cbs = useRef({ onPlaying, onError, onEnded })
  cbs.current = { onPlaying, onError, onEnded }

  useEffect(() => setOrigin(window.location.origin), [])

  const command = (func: string, args: unknown[] = []) => {
    frame.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'command', func, args }), '*')
  }

  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    mute: () => command('mute'),
    unMute: () => {
      command('unMute')
      command('setVolume', [70])
    },
    play: () => command('playVideo'),
    pause: () => command('pauseVideo'),
    restart: () => {
      command('seekTo', [start, true])
      command('playVideo')
    },
  }))

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!origin) return
    let alive = true
    let listening = 0
    const ping = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (!frame.current?.contentWindow || listening > 40) return
      listening++
      frame.current.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'listening', id: videoId, channel: 'widget' }), '*')
    }, 250)
    const giveUp = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (alive && !visibleRef.current) cbs.current.onError?.()
    }, 9000)

    const onMessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.source !== frame.current?.contentWindow) return
      if (typeof e.data !== 'string') return
      let data: { event?: string; info?: { playerState?: number } | number }
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(e.data)
      } catch {
        return
      }
      listening = 99
      if (data.event === 'onReady') {
        if (muted) command('mute')
        command('playVideo')
      }
      const state =
        data.event === 'onStateChange' ? (data.info as number) : data.event === 'infoDelivery' && typeof data.info === 'object' ? data.info?.playerState : undefined
      if (state === 1 && !visibleRef.current) {
        visibleRef.current = true
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (!alive) return
          setVisible(true)
          cbs.current.onPlaying?.()
        }, 350)
      }
      if (state === 0) cbs.current.onEnded?.()
      if (data.event === 'onError') {
        markBroken(videoId)
        cbs.current.onError?.()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('message', onMessage)
    return () => {
      alive = false
      window.clearInterval(ping)
      window.clearTimeout(giveUp)
      window.removeEventListener('message', onMessage)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [origin, videoId])

  if (!origin) return null

  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    autoplay: '1',
    mute: '1',
    controls: '0',
    disablekb: '1',
    fs: '0',
    iv_load_policy: '3',
    modestbranding: '1',
    playsinline: '1',
    rel: '0',
    showinfo: '0',
    enablejsapi: '1',
    cc_load_policy: '0',
    start: String(start),
    origin,
    widget_referrer: origin,
  })
  if (loop) {
    params.set('loop', '1')
    params.set('playlist', videoId)
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn('yt-wrap pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden', className)} aria-hidden="true">
      <iframe
        ref={frame}
        src={`https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${videoId}?${params.toString()}`}
        title="Fragman"
        allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"
        referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
        tabIndex={-1}
        className={cn(fit === 'cover' ? 'yt-cover' : 'yt-crop', 'transition-opacity duration-700', visible ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}
      />
    </div>
  )
})

export function MusicButton() {

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setPanelOpen(true)}
      aria-label={playing ? `Çalıyor: ${current?.title ?? ''}. Müzik panelini aç` : 'Müzik panelini aç'}
      className={cn(
        'flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3.5 transition',
        playing ? 'border-primary/40 bg-accent text-ink' : 'border-border bg-card/60 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
      )}
    >
      <Equalizer playing={playing} />
      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">Müzik</span>
    </button>
  )
}

'use client'

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { Music2, Pause, Play, SkipBack, SkipForward } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useMusic } from './music-provider'

export function MusicMiniPlayer({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const m = useMusic()
  // Sadece müzik ÇALARKEN (playing) ve panel açık değilken görünür.
  const visible = Boolean(m.current) && m.playing && !m.panelOpen

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {visible && m.current && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.96 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.96 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 26, stiffness: 300 }}
          className={cn(
            'fixed z-50 flex w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] max-w-xs items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/40 p-2 shadow-2xl shadow-black/10 backdrop-blur-3xl dark:border-white/10 dark:bg-black/40',
            className,
          )}
          role="region"
          aria-label="Müzik çalar"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => m.setPanelOpen(true)}
            className="relative size-11 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted"
            aria-label="Müzik panelini aç"
          >
            {m.current.cover ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img
                src={m.current.cover}
                alt=""
                className={cn('size-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700', m.playing && 'scale-110')}
              />
            ) : (
              <Music2 className="absolute inset-0 m-auto size-5 text-muted-foreground" />
            )}
          </button>

          <button type="button" onClick={() => m.setPanelOpen(true)} className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium leading-tight text-foreground">{m.current.title}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs leading-tight text-muted-foreground">{m.current.artist}</p>
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.prev}
              aria-label="Önceki parça"
              className="hidden size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-black/10 hover:text-foreground sm:grid dark:hover:bg-white/10"
            >
              <SkipBack className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.toggle}
              aria-label={m.playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
              className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md transition hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95"
            >
              {m.playing ? <Pause className="size-4" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={m.next}
              aria-label="Sonraki parça"
              className="hidden size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground transition hover:bg-black/10 hover:text-foreground sm:grid dark:hover:bg-white/10"
            >
              <SkipForward className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-0.5 bg-black/10 dark:bg-white/10">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-primary transition-[width] duration-300"
              style={{ width: m.duration ? `${Math.min(100, (m.progress / m.duration) * 100)}%` : '0%' }}
            />
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: components\music\music-panel.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import useSWR from 'swr'
import { Loader2, Music2, Pause, Play, Plus, Repeat, Search, Shuffle, SkipBack, SkipForward, Trash2, Volume1, Volume2, VolumeX, Check } from 'lucide-react'
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui-kit/modal'
import { useDebounced } from '@/components/shell/command-palette'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useMusic, type Track } from './music-provider'
import { Equalizer } from './music-button'

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json())
const SUGGESTIONS = ['Unravel', 'Gurenge', 'Blue Bird', 'Idol', 'Kick Back', 'Again', 'Silhouette', 'Shinzou wo Sasageyo']

export function fmtTime(s: number) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(s) || s < 0) return '0:00'
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
  return `${m}:${String(Math.floor(s % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

export function useMusicSearch(q: string, source: 'anime' | 'song') {
  const dq = useDebounced(q.trim(), 300)
  const { data, isLoading } = useSWR<{ results: Track[] }>(dq.length > 1 ? `/api/music/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(dq)}&source=${source}` : null, fetcher, {
    keepPreviousData: true,
  })
  return { results: dq.length > 1 ? (data?.results ?? []) : [], isLoading: isLoading && dq.length > 1 }
}

export function MusicSearch({ onPick, pickLabel = 'Ekle', pickedIds = [] }: { onPick: (t: Track) => void; pickLabel?: string; pickedIds?: string[] }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [source, setSource] = useState<'anime' | 'song'>('anime')
  const { results, isLoading } = useMusicSearch(q, source)
  const preview = useMusic()
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Şarkı veya anime adı yaz…"
          aria-label="Müzik ara"
          className="h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background pl-11 pr-10 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary"
        />
        {isLoading && <Loader2 className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-2xl bg-muted p-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Kaynak">
        {(
          [
            ['anime', 'Anime OP / ED'],
            ['song', 'Tüm şarkılar'],
          ] as const
        ).map(([id, label]) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            role="tab"
            type="button"
            aria-selected={source === id}
            onClick={() => setSource(id)}
            className={cn('rounded-xl py-2 text-xs font-medium transition', source === id ? 'bg-card shadow-sm' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground')}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {q.trim().length < 2 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
            <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => setQ(s)} className="rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink">
              {s}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : results.length === 0 && !isLoading ? (
        <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Sonuç bulunamadı. Diğer kaynağı dene.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {results.map((t) => {
            const picked = pickedIds.includes(t.id)
            const isCurrent = preview.current?.id === t.id && preview.playing
            return (
              <li key={t.id} className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-2 transition hover:bg-muted">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => (isCurrent ? preview.pause() : preview.play(t))}
                  className="relative size-12 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted"
                  aria-label={isCurrent ? `${t.title} duraklat` : `${t.title} dinle`}
                >
                  {t.cover ? (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    <img src={t.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
                  ) : (
                    <Music2 className="m-auto size-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                  )}
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-scrim/50 text-on-scrim opacity-0 transition group-hover:opacity-100">
                    {isCurrent ? <Pause className="size-4" /> : <Play className="size-4" />}
                  </span>
                </button>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{t.title}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {t.artist}
                    {t.anime ? ` · ${t.anime}` : ''}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {t.kind && <span className="hidden rounded-full bg-accent px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase text-ink sm:inline">{t.kind}</span>}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPick(t)}
                  disabled={picked}
                  aria-label={`${t.title} ${pickLabel}`}
                  className={cn(
                    'grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border transition',
                    picked ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink',
                  )}
                >
                  {picked ? <Check className="size-4" /> : <Plus className="size-4" />}
                </button>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function MusicPanel() {
  const m = useMusic()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'playlist' | 'search'>('playlist')
  const VolIcon = m.volume === 0 ? VolumeX : m.volume < 0.5 ? Volume1 : Volume2

  return (

          )}

              )}
            </div>

              <span>{fmtTime(m.duration)}</span>

                {m.playing ? <Pause className="size-6" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-6" />}
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={m.next} aria-label="Sonraki" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-muted">

              <Repeat className="size-4" />

              Şarkı ara
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {m.playlist.map((t, i) => {

              return (
                <li key={t.id} className={cn('group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-2 transition', active ? 'bg-accent' : 'hover:bg-muted')}>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => (active ? m.toggle() : m.play(t))} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-left">
                    <span className="w-5 text-center font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{active && m.playing ? <Equalizer playing className="mx-auto h-3 text-ink" /> : i + 1}</span>
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={t.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-10 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className={cn('block truncate text-sm font-medium', active && 'text-ink')}>{t.title}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.artist}</span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => m.remove(t.id)} aria-label={`${t.title} kaldır`} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground opacity-100 transition hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100">
                    <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              )
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
        <p className="text-center font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground">Kaynaklar: AnimeThemes · Apple Music önizleme</p>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\music\music-provider.tsx =====
'use client'

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'

export type Track = {
  id: string
  title: string
  artist: string
  url: string
  cover?: string | null
  source: 'animethemes' | 'itunes'
  anime?: string | null
  kind?: string | null
}

type Ctx = {
  playlist: Track[]
  current: Track | null
  playing: boolean
  progress: number
  duration: number
  volume: number
  shuffle: boolean
  repeat: boolean
  panelOpen: boolean
  setPanelOpen: (v: boolean) => void
  play: (t?: Track) => void
  pause: () => void
  toggle: () => void
  next: () => void
  prev: () => void
  seek: (t: number) => void
  setVolume: (v: number) => void
  add: (t: Track) => void
  remove: (id: string) => void
  setShuffle: (v: boolean) => void
  setRepeat: (v: boolean) => void
}

const MusicCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

export function MusicProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null)
  const [playlist, setPlaylist] = useState<Track[]>([])
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [volume, setVolumeState] = useState(0.6)
  const [shuffle, setShuffle] = useState(false)
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState(false)
  const [panelOpen, setPanelOpen] = useState(false)
  const stateRef = useRef({ playlist, currentId, shuffle, repeat })
  stateRef.current = { playlist, currentId, shuffle, repeat }

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sy-playlist') || '[]') as Track[]
      setPlaylist(saved)
      const v = Number(localStorage.getItem('sy-volume'))
      if (!Number.isNaN(v) && v > 0) setVolumeState(v)
    } catch {}
    const audio = new Audio()
    audio.preload = 'metadata'
    audioRef.current = audio
    const onTime = () => setProgress(audio.currentTime)
    const onMeta = () => setDuration(audio.duration || 0)
    const onPlay = () => setPlaying(true)
    const onPause = () => setPlaying(false)
    const onEnded = () => {
      if (stateRef.current.repeat) {
        audio.currentTime = 0
        audio.play().catch(() => {})
      } else nextRef.current()
    }
    const onError = () => {
      setPlaying(false)
      toast.error('Bu parça çalınamadı', { description: 'Tarayıcın bu ses formatını desteklemiyor olabilir.' })
    }
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    audio.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    audio.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    audio.addEventListener('ended', onEnded)
    audio.addEventListener('error', onError)
    const onExternal = () => audio.pause()
    window.addEventListener('sy:pause-music', onExternal)
    return () => {
      audio.pause()
      audio.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      audio.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      audio.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      audio.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      audio.removeEventListener('ended', onEnded)
      audio.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      window.removeEventListener('sy:pause-music', onExternal)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.volume = volume
    localStorage.setItem('sy-volume', String(volume))
  }, [volume])

  const persist = (list: Track[]) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('sy-playlist', JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, 100)))
    } catch {}
  }

  const load = useCallback((t: Track) => {
    const audio = audioRef.current
    if (!audio) return
    if (audio.src !== t.url) {
      audio.src = t.url
      setProgress(0)
      setDuration(0)
    }
    setCurrentId(t.id)
    audio.play().catch(() => setPlaying(false))
  }, [])

  const add = useCallback((t: Track) => {
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      if (list.some((x) => x.id === t.id)) return list
      const next = [...list, t]
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const play = useCallback(
    (t?: Track) => {
      const audio = audioRef.current
      if (!audio) return
      if (t) {
        add(t)
        load(t)
        return
      }
      const { playlist: list, currentId: cid } = stateRef.current
      const cur = list.find((x) => x.id === cid) ?? list[0]
      if (cur) load(cur)
      else setPanelOpen(true)
    },
    [add, load],
  )

  const pause = useCallback(() => audioRef.current?.pause(), [])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    const audio = audioRef.current
    if (!audio) return
    if (audio.paused) play()
    else audio.pause()
  }, [play])

  const step = useCallback(
    (dir: 1 | -1) => {
      const { playlist: list, currentId: cid, shuffle: sh } = stateRef.current
      if (!list.length) return
      const i = list.findIndex((x) => x.id === cid)
      let n = sh && list.length > 1 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length) : i + dir
      if (sh && n === i) n = (n + 1) % list.length
      n = (n + list.length) % list.length
      load(list[n])
    },
    [load],
  )
  const nextRef = useRef(() => {})
  nextRef.current = () => step(1)

  const remove = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setPlaylist((list) => {
      const next = list.filter((x) => x.id !== id)
      persist(next)
      return next
    })
    if (stateRef.current.currentId === id) {
      audioRef.current?.pause()
      setCurrentId(null)
    }
  }, [])

  const value = useMemo<Ctx>(
    () => ({
      playlist,
      current: playlist.find((x) => x.id === currentId) ?? null,
      playing,
      progress,
      duration,
      volume,
      shuffle,
      repeat,
      panelOpen,
      setPanelOpen,
      play,
      pause,
      toggle,
      next: () => step(1),
      prev: () => {
        const audio = audioRef.current
        if (audio && audio.currentTime > 4) audio.currentTime = 0
        else step(-1)
      },
      seek: (t) => {
        if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.currentTime = t
      },
      setVolume: setVolumeState,
      add,
      remove,
      setShuffle,
      setRepeat,
    }),
    [playlist, currentId, playing, progress, duration, volume, shuffle, repeat, panelOpen, play, pause, toggle, step, add, remove],
  )

  return <MusicCtx.Provider value={value}>{children}</MusicCtx.Provider>
}

export function useMusic() {
  const ctx = useContext(MusicCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useMusic must be used within MusicProvider')
  return ctx
}


===== DOSYA: components\player\video-player.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Captions,
  CaptionsOff,
  Check,
  Loader2,
  Maximize,
  Minimize,
  Pause,
  PictureInPicture2,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  RotateCw,
  Settings,
  SkipBack,
  SkipForward,
  Volume1,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs, type Prefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { fmtTime } from '@/components/music/music-panel'

type Props = {
  src: string
  subtitleSrc?: string | null
  subtitleLang: string
  poster?: string | null
  title: string
  episodeLabel: string
  storageKey: string
  nextHref?: string | null
  prevHref?: string | null
}

const SPEEDS = [0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2]
const SUB_SIZES: Record<Prefs['subtitleSize'], string> = { sm: '1.9cqw', md: '2.4cqw', lg: '3cqw', xl: '3.7cqw' }

export function VideoPlayer({ src, subtitleSrc, subtitleLang, poster, title, episodeLabel, storageKey, nextHref, prevHref }: Props) {
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const trackEl = useRef<HTMLTrackElement>(null)
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()

  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [time, setTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [buffered, setBuffered] = useState(0)
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(1)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [controls, setControls] = useState(true)
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false)
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1)
  const [subsOn, setSubsOn] = useState(true)
  const [cue, setCue] = useState('')
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ x: number; t: number } | null>(null)
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false)
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pipSupported, setPipSupported] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => setPipSupported(Boolean(document.pictureInPictureEnabled)), [])

  const poke = useCallback(() => {
    setControls(true)
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!video.current?.paused) setControls(false)
    }, 2600)
  }, [])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    if (v.paused) v.play().catch(() => {})
    else v.pause()
  }, [])

  const seekBy = useCallback((s: number) => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    v.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(v.duration || 0, v.currentTime + s))
    setFlash(s > 0 ? `+${s}s` : `${s}s`)
    window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 500)
  }, [])

  const toggleFullscreen = useCallback(() => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) wrap.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
    else document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    const saved = Number(localStorage.getItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`))
    const onMeta = () => {
      setDuration(v.duration)
      if (saved && saved < v.duration - 15) v.currentTime = saved
      const tt = v.textTracks[0]
      if (tt) tt.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    let lastSave = 0
    const onTime = () => {
      setTime(v.currentTime)
      if (v.buffered.length) setBuffered(v.buffered.end(v.buffered.length - 1))
      if (Date.now() - lastSave > 4000) {
        lastSave = Date.now()
        localStorage.setItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`, String(Math.floor(v.currentTime)))
      }
    }
    const onPlay = () => {
      setPlaying(true)
      setEnded(false)
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    }
    const onPause = () => setPlaying(false)
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true)
    const onCanPlay = () => setWaiting(false)
    const onVolume = () => {
      setVolume(v.volume)
      setMuted(v.muted)
    }
    const onEnded = () => {
      setEnded(true)
      localStorage.removeItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`)
    }
    const onError = () => {
      setWaiting(false)
      setError('Video yüklenemedi. Bağlantı geçersiz olabilir ya da kaynak erişime kapalı.')
    }
    v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    v.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('progress', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    v.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    v.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
    v.addEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
    v.addEventListener('ended', onEnded)
    v.addEventListener('error', onError)
    const onFs = () => setFullscreen(Boolean(document.fullscreenElement))
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)
    return () => {
      v.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      v.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('progress', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      v.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
      v.removeEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
      v.removeEventListener('ended', onEnded)
      v.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)
    }
  }, [storageKey])

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = trackEl.current
    if (!t) return
    const onCue = () => {
      const active = t.track.activeCues
      if (!active || active.length === 0) return setCue('')
      setCue(
        Array.from(active)
          .map((c) => (c as VTTCue).text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ''))
          .join('\n'),
      )
    }
    const onLoad = () => {
      t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    t.addEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
    t.addEventListener('load', onLoad)
    t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    return () => {
      t.removeEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
      t.removeEventListener('load', onLoad)
    }
  }, [subtitleSrc])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return
      const v = video.current
      if (!v) return
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase()
      if (k === ' ' || k === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault()
        toggle()
      } else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'l') seekBy(k === 'l' ? 10 : 5)
      else if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'j') seekBy(k === 'j' ? -10 : -5)
      else if (k === 'arrowup') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.min(1, v.volume + 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'arrowdown') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.max(0, v.volume - 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'm') v.muted = !v.muted
      else if (k === 'f') toggleFullscreen()
      else if (k === 'c') setSubsOn((s) => !s)
      else return
      poke()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [toggle, seekBy, toggleFullscreen, poke])

  const VolIcon = muted || volume === 0 ? VolumeX : volume < 0.5 ? Volume1 : Volume2
  const pct = duration ? (time / duration) * 100 : 0
  const bufPct = duration ? (buffered / duration) * 100 : 0
  const showUi = controls || !playing || menu

  return (
    <div
      ref={wrap}
      onMouseMove={poke}
      onTouchStart={poke}
      onMouseLeave={() => playing && setControls(false)}
      className={cn('dark group/player relative aspect-video w-full select-none overflow-hidden bg-black text-foreground [container-type:inline-size]', fullscreen ? 'rounded-none' : 'rounded-3xl', !showUi && 'cursor-none')}
    >
      <video
        ref={video}
        src={src}
        poster={poster ?? undefined}
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        className="absolute inset-0 size-full"
        onClick={toggle}
        onDoubleClick={toggleFullscreen}
      >
        {subtitleSrc && <track ref={trackEl} kind="subtitles" src={subtitleSrc} srcLang={subtitleLang} label={subtitleLang.toUpperCase()} default />}
      </video>

      {subsOn && cue && (
        <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 flex justify-center px-[6%] transition-all duration-300', showUi ? 'bottom-[18%]' : 'bottom-[7%]')}>
          <p
            className={cn('whitespace-pre-line text-center font-semibold leading-snug text-on-scrim', prefs.subtitleBg ? 'rounded-lg bg-black/70 px-[0.6em] py-[0.25em]' : '[text-shadow:0_2px_4px_#000,0_0_2px_#000,0_0_8px_#000]')}
            style={{ fontSize: `max(13px, ${SUB_SIZES[prefs.subtitleSize]})` }}
          >
            {cue}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {waiting && !error && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
          <Loader2 className="size-12 animate-spin text-primary" />
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence>
        {flash && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-black/60 px-5 py-3 font-mono text-lg text-on-scrim backdrop-blur">{flash}</span>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {!playing && !waiting && !error && !ended && (
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label="Oynat" className="absolute inset-0 m-auto grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_60px_var(--primary)] transition hover:scale-105">
          <Play className="ml-1 size-8 fill-current" />
        </button>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-black/80 p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-on-scrim">Oynatma hatası</p>
          <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-on-scrim/70">{error}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => location.reload()} className="mt-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
            Tekrar dene
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {ended && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-black/75 p-6 text-center backdrop-blur-sm">
          <p className="label-mono text-primary">Bölüm bitti</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current?.play()} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-on-scrim/30 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm text-on-scrim">
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Tekrar izle
            </button>
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
                Sonraki bölüm <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/70 to-transparent p-4 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:p-6', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}>
        <p className="label-mono text-[10px] text-primary">{episodeLabel}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-on-scrim sm:text-lg">{title}</p>
      </div>

      <div className={cn('absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/40 to-transparent px-3 pb-3 pt-14 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:px-5 sm:pb-4', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'pointer-events-none opacity-0')}>
        <div
          className="group/seek relative mb-2 flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center"
          onMouseMove={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            const x = Math.min(Math.max(e.clientX - r.left, 0), r.width)
            setHover({ x, t: (x / r.width) * duration })
          }}
          onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
          onClick={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (video.current) video.current.currentTime = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * duration
          }}
          role="slider"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label="İlerleme"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={Math.round(duration)}
          aria-valuenow={Math.round(time)}
          aria-valuetext={`${fmtTime(time)} / ${fmtTime(duration)}`}
        >
          <div className="relative h-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-on-scrim/20 transition-all group-hover/seek:h-1.5">
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-on-scrim/35" style={{ width: `${bufPct}%` }} />
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-primary" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="absolute size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 scale-0 rounded-full bg-primary shadow transition group-hover/seek:scale-100" style={{ left: `${pct}%` }} />
          {hover && (
            <span className="absolute -top-8 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-md bg-black/80 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-on-scrim" style={{ left: hover.x }}>
              {fmtTime(hover.t)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-on-scrim sm:gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
            {playing ? <Pause className="size-5 fill-current" /> : <Play className="size-5 fill-current" />}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(-10)} aria-label="10 saniye geri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(10)} aria-label="10 saniye ileri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <div className="group/vol flex items-center">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current && (video.current.muted = !video.current.muted)} aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              <VolIcon className="size-5" />
            </button>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={1}
              step={0.02}
              value={muted ? 0 : volume}
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (!video.current) return
                video.current.volume = Number(e.target.value)
                video.current.muted = Number(e.target.value) === 0
              }}
              aria-label="Ses seviyesi"
              className="w-0 accent-[var(--primary)] opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 group-hover/vol:w-20 group-hover/vol:opacity-100 focus:w-20 focus:opacity-100"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="ml-1 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-on-scrim/80 sm:text-xs">
            {fmtTime(time)} / {fmtTime(duration)}
          </span>

          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1">
            {prevHref && (
              <Link href={prevHref} aria-label="Önceki bölüm" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
                <SkipBack className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} aria-label="Sonraki bölüm" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {subtitleSrc && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSubsOn((s) => !s)} aria-pressed={subsOn} aria-label="Altyazı" className={cn('grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10', subsOn && 'text-primary')}>
                {subsOn ? <Captions className="size-5" /> : <CaptionsOff className="size-5" />}
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="relative">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} aria-label="Oynatıcı ayarları" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <Settings className={cn('size-5 transition-transform duration-500', menu && 'rotate-90')} />
              </button>
              <AnimatePresence>
                {menu && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    className="absolute bottom-12 right-0 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-on-scrim/10 bg-black/90 p-3 text-sm text-on-scrim backdrop-blur-xl"
                  >
                    <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Hız</p>
                    <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                      {SPEEDS.map((s) => (
                        <button
                          key={s}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSpeed(s)
                            if (video.current) video.current.playbackRate = s
                          }}
                          className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs transition', speed === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}
                        >
                          {s}x
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    {subtitleSrc && (
                      <>
                        <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Altyazı boyutu</p>
                        <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                          {(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((s) => (
                            <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleSize: s })} className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs uppercase transition', prefs.subtitleSize === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}>
                              {s}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleBg: !prefs.subtitleBg })} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-2 transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                          Altyazı arka planı
                          {prefs.subtitleBg && <Check className="size-4 text-primary" />}
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
            {pipSupported && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (document.pictureInPictureElement) document.exitPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                  else video.current?.requestPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                }}
                aria-label="Resim içinde resim"
                className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid"
              >
                <PictureInPicture2 className="size-4" />
              </button>
            )}
            <button type="button" onClick={toggleFullscreen} aria-label={fullscreen ? 'Tam ekrandan çık' : 'Tam ekran'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              {fullscreen ? <Minimize className="size-5" /> : <Maximize className="size-5" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== DOSYA: components\profile\profile-editor.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Loader2, Music2, Plus, Save, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { updateProfile, type ProfileInput } from '@/app/actions/profile'
import type { PublicUser } from '@/lib/users'
import { THEMES } from '@/lib/themes'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'
import { MusicSearch } from '@/components/music/music-panel'
import { Card, Toggle } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { Avatar } from '@/components/shell/user-menu'

const LINK_TYPES = [
  ['discord', 'Discord'],
  ['github', 'GitHub'],
  ['instagram', 'Instagram'],
  ['x', 'X'],
  ['youtube', 'YouTube'],
  ['spotify', 'Spotify'],
  ['twitch', 'Twitch'],
  ['tiktok', 'TikTok'],
  ['steam', 'Steam'],
  ['website', 'Web sitesi'],
] as const

const input = 'h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

export function ProfileEditor({ user, favorites }: { user: PublicUser; favorites: { id: number; title: string; cover: string | null }[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [songPicker, setSongPicker] = useState(false)
  const [favs, setFavs] = useState(favorites)
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProfileInput>({
    displayName: user.displayName,
    username: user.username,
    bio: user.bio,
    location: user.location,
    avatar: user.avatar ?? '',
    background: user.background ?? '',
    backgroundDim: user.backgroundDim,
    accent: user.accent,
    links: user.links,
    song: user.song,
    favorites: user.favorites,
    effects: user.effects,
  })
  const set = <K extends keyof ProfileInput>(k: K, v: ProfileInput[K]) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }))

  function save() {
    start(async () => {
      const res = await updateProfile({ ...form, favorites: favs.map((f) => f.id) })
      if (!res.ok) toast.error(res.error)
      else {
        toast.success('Profil kaydedildi', { action: { label: 'Görüntüle', onClick: () => router.push(`/u/${res.username}`) } })
        router.refresh()
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <Card title="Kimlik" accent="bilgileri">
          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Görünen ad</span>
              <input className={input} value={form.displayName} maxLength={40} onChange={(e) => set('displayName', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Kullanıcı adı</span>
              <div className="flex items-center rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background pl-4 focus-within:border-primary">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">/u/</span>
                <input className="h-12 flex-1 bg-transparent pr-4 text-sm outline-none" value={form.username} maxLength={20} onChange={(e) => set('username', e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, ''))} />
              </div>
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm sm:col-span-2">
              <span className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                Biyografi <span className="font-mono text-xs">{form.bio.length}/300</span>
              </span>
