export function currentSeason(date = new Date()) {
  const m = date.getMonth()
  const year = date.getFullYear()
  if (m <= 2) return { season: 'WINTER', year }
  if (m <= 5) return { season: 'SPRING', year }
  if (m <= 8) return { season: 'SUMMER', year }
  return { season: 'FALL', year }
}

export function timeUntil(seconds: number) {
  const d = Math.floor(seconds / 86400)
  const h = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600)
  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
  if (d > 0) return `${d}g ${h}s`
  if (h > 0) return `${h}s ${m}dk`
  return `${m}dk`
}

export function fuzzyDate(d?: { year?: number | null; month?: number | null; day?: number | null } | null) {
  if (!d || !d.year) return null
  const months = ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara']
  return [d.day, d.month ? months[d.month - 1] : null, d.year].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
}

export function compact(n?: number | null) {
  if (n == null) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n)
}


===== DOSYA: lib\oauth.ts =====
import 'server-only'

export type OAuthProvider = 'discord' | 'google' | 'github'

type Profile = { id: string; name: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }

type Config = {
  label: string
  envId: string
  envSecret: string
  authorize: string
  token: string
  scope: string
  extra?: Record<string, string>
  profile: (accessToken: string) => Promise<Profile>
}

export const OAUTH: Record<OAuthProvider, Config> = {
  discord: {
    label: 'Discord',
    envId: 'DISCORD_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize',
    token: 'https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token',
    scope: 'identify email',
    extra: { prompt: 'none' },
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://discord.com/api/users/@me', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Discord profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { id: string; username: string; global_name?: string | null; avatar?: string | null; email?: string | null }
      const ext = u.avatar?.startsWith('a_') ? 'gif' : 'png'
      return {
        id: u.id,
        name: u.global_name || u.username,
        email: u.email,
        avatar: u.avatar ? `https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/${u.id}/${u.avatar}.${ext}?size=512` : null,
      }
    },
  },
  google: {
    label: 'Google',
    envId: 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth',
    token: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    scope: 'openid email profile',
    extra: { prompt: 'select_account' },
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Google profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { sub: string; name?: string; email?: string; picture?: string }
      return { id: u.sub, name: u.name || u.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Kullanıcı', email: u.email, avatar: u.picture?.replace('=s96-c', '=s512-c') }
    },
  },
  github: {
    label: 'GitHub',
    envId: 'GITHUB_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize',
    token: 'https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token',
    scope: 'read:user user:email',
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/user', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'User-Agent': 'sytheris' } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GitHub profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { id: number; login: string; name?: string | null; avatar_url?: string; email?: string | null }
      return { id: String(u.id), name: u.name || u.login, email: u.email, avatar: u.avatar_url }
    },
  },
}

export function isProvider(p: string): p is OAuthProvider {
  return p === 'discord' || p === 'google' || p === 'github'
}

export function providerStatus() {
  return (Object.keys(OAUTH) as OAuthProvider[]).map((id) => ({
    id,
    label: OAUTH[id].label,
    configured: Boolean(process.env[OAUTH[id].envId] && process.env[OAUTH[id].envSecret]),
  }))
}

export function appOrigin(request: Request) {
  if (process.env.APP_URL) return process.env.APP_URL.replace(/\/$/, '')
  const h = request.headers
  const host = h.get('x-forwarded-host') || h.get('host')
  const proto = h.get('x-forwarded-proto') || (host?.startsWith('localhost') ? 'http' : 'https')
  return host ? `${proto}://${host}` : new URL(request.url).origin
}


===== DOSYA: lib\og.ts =====
export async function loadGoogleFont(family: string, weight: number, style: 'normal' | 'italic' = 'normal') {
  try {
    const css = await (
      await fetch(`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${family.replace(/ /g, '+')}:${style === 'italic' ? 'ital,' : ''}wght@${style === 'italic' ? '1,' : ''}${weight}`, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Sytheris OG)' },
      })
    ).text()
    const url = css.match(/src: url\(([^)]+)\) format\('(?:truetype|opentype)'\)/)?.[1]
    if (!url) return null
    return await (await fetch(url)).arrayBuffer()
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}


===== DOSYA: lib\prefs.ts =====
'use client'

import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

export type Prefs = {
  autoplayTrailers: boolean
  trailerSound: boolean
  reduceMotion: boolean
  intro: boolean
  subtitleSize: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
  subtitleBg: boolean
  aiProvider: 'auto' | 'ollama' | 'gemini'
  ollamaUrl: string
  ollamaModel: string
}

export const DEFAULT_PREFS: Prefs = {
  autoplayTrailers: true,
  trailerSound: false,
  reduceMotion: false,
  intro: true,
  subtitleSize: 'md',
  subtitleBg: true,
  aiProvider: 'auto',
  ollamaUrl: 'http://localhost:11434',
  ollamaModel: 'llama3.2',
}

const KEY = 'sy-prefs'
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
let cache: Prefs | null = null

function read(): Prefs {
  if (cache) return cache
  try {
    cache = { ...DEFAULT_PREFS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '{}') }
  } catch {
    cache = DEFAULT_PREFS
  }
  return cache as Prefs
}

export function setPrefs(patch: Partial<Prefs>) {
  cache = { ...read(), ...patch }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cache))
    if ('reduceMotion' in patch) {
      localStorage.setItem('sy-reduce-motion', patch.reduceMotion ? '1' : '0')
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('reduce-motion', Boolean(patch.reduceMotion))
    }
    if ('intro' in patch) localStorage.setItem('sy-intro', patch.intro ? '1' : '0')
  } catch {}
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

export function getPrefs() {
  return typeof window === 'undefined' ? DEFAULT_PREFS : read()
}

export function usePrefs(): Prefs {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    (cb) => {
      listeners.add(cb)
      return () => listeners.delete(cb)
    },
    read,
    () => DEFAULT_PREFS,
  )
}


===== DOSYA: lib\session.ts =====
import 'server-only'
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual, createHash } from 'crypto'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __sySecret?: string }

function secret() {
  if (process.env.SESSION_SECRET) return process.env.SESSION_SECRET
  if (process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD) return createHash('sha256').update(`sytheris:${process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}`).digest('hex')
  if (!g.__sySecret) g.__sySecret = randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
  return g.__sySecret
}

function b64(input: string) {
  return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64url')
}

export function sign(payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const body = b64(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const sig = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  return `${body}.${sig}`
}

export function verify<T = Record<string, unknown>>(token?: string | null): T | null {
  if (!token) return null
  const [body, sig] = token.split('.')
  if (!body || !sig) return null
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  const a = Buffer.from(sig)
  const b = Buffer.from(expected)
  if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, 'base64url').toString()) as T & { exp?: number }
    if (data.exp && Date.now() > data.exp) return null
    return data
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'sy_session'
export const ADMIN_COOKIE = 'sy_admin'

export const cookieOptions = (maxAgeSeconds: number) =>
  ({
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    sameSite: 'none' as const,
    path: '/',
    maxAge: maxAgeSeconds,
  })

export async function getSessionUserId() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ uid: string }>(store.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value)
  return data?.uid ?? null
}

export async function isAdmin() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ admin: boolean }>(store.get(ADMIN_COOKIE)?.value)
  return Boolean(data?.admin)
}

export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  const ha = createHash('sha256').update(a).digest()
  const hb = createHash('sha256').update(b).digest()
  return timingSafeEqual(ha, hb)
}

export type Episode = {
  id: string
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  animeCover?: string | null
  number: number
  title: string
  videoUrl: string
  subtitleUrl?: string | null
  subtitleText?: string | null
  subtitleLang: string
  thumbnail?: string | null
  createdAt: number
}

export async function listEpisodes(animeId: number) {
  const list = (await kvGet<Episode[]>(`episodes:${animeId}`)) ?? []
  return list.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number)
}

export async function getEpisode(animeId: number, number: number) {
  const list = await listEpisodes(animeId)
  return list.find((e) => e.number === number) ?? null
}

export async function getEpisodeById(id: string) {
  const index = (await kvGet<Record<string, number>>('episode-index')) ?? {}
  const animeId = index[id]
  if (!animeId) return null
  const list = await listEpisodes(animeId)
  return list.find((e) => e.id === id) ?? null
}

export async function addEpisode(input: Omit<Episode, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) {
  const list = await listEpisodes(input.animeId)
  const existing = list.findIndex((e) => e.number === input.number)
  const ep: Episode = { ...input, id: existing >= 0 ? list[existing].id : randomBytes(8).toString('hex'), createdAt: Date.now() }
  if (existing >= 0) list[existing] = ep
  else list.push(ep)
  await kvSet(`episodes:${input.animeId}`, list)
  const index = (await kvGet<Record<string, number>>('episode-index')) ?? {}
  index[ep.id] = ep.animeId
  await kvSet('episode-index', index)
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  catalog[input.animeId] = { title: input.animeTitle, cover: input.animeCover, count: list.length, updatedAt: Date.now() }
  await kvSet('episode-catalog', catalog)
  return ep
}

export async function deleteEpisode(animeId: number, id: string) {
  const list = (await listEpisodes(animeId)).filter((e) => e.id !== id)
  if (list.length) await kvSet(`episodes:${animeId}`, list)
  else await kvDel(`episodes:${animeId}`)
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  if (list.length) catalog[animeId] = { ...catalog[animeId], count: list.length, updatedAt: Date.now() }
  else delete catalog[animeId]
  await kvSet('episode-catalog', catalog)
}

export async function getEpisodeCatalog() {
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  return Object.entries(catalog)
    .map(([id, v]) => ({ animeId: Number(id), ...v }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt)
}

===== DOSYA: lib\store.ts =====
import 'server-only'
import { neon } from '@neondatabase/serverless'
import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

/**
 * Minimal key/value store. Uses Postgres (Neon) when DATABASE_URL is present,
 * otherwise falls back to a JSON file in the OS temp dir so the app keeps working
 * in development and previews without a database.
 */

type Row = { key: string; value: unknown }

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __syStore?: Map<string, unknown>; __syStoreReady?: Promise<void>; __syTable?: Promise<void> }

const FILE = path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || '/tmp', 'sytheris-store.json')

export function storeBackend(): 'postgres' | 'memory' {
  return process.env.DATABASE_URL ? 'postgres' : 'memory'
}

function sql() {
  return neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL as string)
}

async function ensureTable() {
  if (!g.__syTable) {
    g.__syTable = (async () => {
      const q = sql()
      await q`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sytheris_kv (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value JSONB NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())`
    })().catch((e) => {
      g.__syTable = undefined
      throw e
    })
  }
  return g.__syTable
}

async function memory() {
  if (!g.__syStore) {
    g.__syStore = new Map()
    g.__syStoreReady = fs
      .readFile(FILE, 'utf8')
      .then((raw) => {
        const obj = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) g.__syStore!.set(k, v)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }
  await g.__syStoreReady
  return g.__syStore
}

let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
function scheduleFlush(map: Map<string, unknown>) {
  if (flushTimer) clearTimeout(flushTimer)
  flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    fs.writeFile(FILE, JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(map))).catch(() => {})
  }, 150)
}

export async function kvGet<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const rows = (await sql()`SELECT value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = ${key}`) as { value: T }[]
    return rows[0]?.value ?? null
  }
  const m = await memory()
  return (m.get(key) as T) ?? null
}

export async function kvSet<T>(key: string, value: T) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await sql()`INSERT INTO sytheris_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES (${key}, ${JSON.stringify(value)}::jsonb, now())
      ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()`
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.set(key, value)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvDel(key: string) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await sql()`DELETE FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = ${key}`
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.delete(key)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvList<T>(prefix: string, limit = 500): Promise<{ key: string; value: T }[]> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const like = prefix.replace(/[%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`) + '%'
    const rows = (await sql()`SELECT key, value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key LIKE ${like} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ${limit}`) as Row[]
    return rows as { key: string; value: T }[]
  }
  const m = await memory()
  const out: { key: string; value: T }[] = []
  for (const [key, value] of m) if (key.startsWith(prefix)) out.push({ key, value: value as T })
  return out.reverse().slice(0, limit)
}

export async function storeHealth() {
  const started = Date.now()
  try {
    if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
      await ensureTable()
      await sql()`SELECT 1`
    } else {
      await memory()
    }
    return { ok: true, ms: Date.now() - started }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, ms: Date.now() - started, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}


===== DOSYA: lib\subtitles.ts =====
function assTime(t: string) {
  const [h, m, s] = t.trim().split(':')
  const [sec, cs = '0'] = s.split('.')
  return `${h.padStart(2, '0')}:${m.padStart(2, '0')}:${sec.padStart(2, '0')}.${cs.padEnd(3, '0').slice(0, 3)}`
}

function assToVtt(input: string) {
  const lines = input.split(/\r?\n/)
  let format: string[] = []
  const cues: string[] = []
  let inEvents = false
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (/^\[events\]/i.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = true
      continue
    }
    if (/^\[.*\]$/.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = false
      continue
    }
    if (!inEvents) continue
    if (line.startsWith('Format:')) format = line.slice(7).split(',').map((f) => f.trim().toLowerCase())
    if (line.startsWith('Dialogue:')) {
      const parts = line.slice(9).split(',')
      const textIndex = format.indexOf('text')
      const start = parts[format.indexOf('start')]
      const end = parts[format.indexOf('end')]
      if (!start || !end || textIndex < 0) continue
      const text = parts
        .slice(textIndex)
        .join(',')
        .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\N/gi, '\n')
        .trim()
      if (text) cues.push(`${assTime(start)} --> ${assTime(end)}\n${text}`)
    }
  }
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${cues.join('\n\n')}\n`
}

export function toVtt(input: string) {
  const text = input.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()
  if (text.startsWith('WEBVTT')) return text + '\n'
  if (/^\[script info\]/i.test(text) || text.includes('Dialogue:')) return assToVtt(text)
  const body = text
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
    .replace(/(\d{1,2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${body}\n`
}

===== DOSYA: lib\users.ts =====
import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes, scrypt as _scrypt, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'
import { promisify } from 'util'
import { kvGet, kvList, kvSet } from './store'
import { getSessionUserId } from './session'

const scrypt = promisify(_scrypt) as (pw: string, salt: string, len: number) => Promise<Buffer>

export type Provider = 'discord' | 'google' | 'github' | 'email'

export type ProfileLink = { type: string; url: string }
export type ProfileSong = { title: string; artist: string; url: string; cover?: string | null } | null

export type User = {
  id: string
  username: string
  displayName: string
  email?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  provider: Provider
  providerId: string
  createdAt: number
  bio: string
  location: string
  background?: string | null
  backgroundDim: number
  accent: string
  links: ProfileLink[]
  song: ProfileSong
  favorites: number[]
  views: number
  effects: { tilt: boolean; typewriter: boolean; glow: boolean }
  banned?: boolean
}

export type PublicUser = Omit<User, 'email' | 'providerId'>

export function toPublic(u: User): PublicUser {
  const { email: _e, providerId: _p, ...rest } = u
  return rest
}

function slugify(s: string) {
  return (
    s
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFKD')
      .replace(/[ıİ]/g, 'i')
      .replace(/[şŞ]/g, 's')
      .replace(/[ğĞ]/g, 'g')
      .replace(/[üÜ]/g, 'u')
      .replace(/[öÖ]/g, 'o')
      .replace(/[çÇ]/g, 'c')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 20) || 'kullanici'
  )
}

export const RESERVED = new Set(['admin', 'api', 'giris', 'profil', 'sytheris', 'root', 'moderator', 'support'])

export async function uniqueUsername(base: string) {
  let name = slugify(base)
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) name = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 999)}`
  let candidate = name
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${candidate}`)
    if (!taken) return candidate
    candidate = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 9999)}`
  }
  return `${name}${randomBytes(3).toString('hex')}`
}

function newUser(p: { provider: Provider; providerId: string; name: string; username: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }): User {
  return {
    id: randomBytes(12).toString('hex'),
    username: p.username,
    displayName: p.name.slice(0, 40),
    email: p.email ?? null,
    avatar: p.avatar ?? null,
    provider: p.provider,
    providerId: p.providerId,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    bio: 'Sytheris üzerinde anime keşfediyorum.',
    location: '',
    background: null,
    backgroundDim: 55,
    accent: 'green',
    links: [],
    song: null,
    favorites: [],
    views: 0,
    effects: { tilt: true, typewriter: true, glow: true },
  }
}

export async function getUser(id: string) {
  return kvGet<User>(`user:${id}`)
}

export async function saveUser(u: User) {
  await kvSet(`user:${u.id}`, u)
}

export async function getUserByUsername(username: string) {
  const id = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${username.toLowerCase()}`)
  return id ? getUser(id) : null
}

export async function getCurrentUser() {
  try {
    const uid = await getSessionUserId()
    if (!uid) return null
    const u = await getUser(uid)
    if (!u || u.banned) return null
    return u
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function upsertOAuthUser(p: { provider: Exclude<Provider, 'email'>; providerId: string; name: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }) {
  const linkKey = `oauth:${p.provider}:${p.providerId}`
  const existingId = await kvGet<string>(linkKey)
  if (existingId) {
    const u = await getUser(existingId)
    if (u) {
      u.avatar = u.avatar && !u.avatar.includes('cdn.discordapp') && !u.avatar.includes('googleusercontent') && !u.avatar.includes('githubusercontent') ? u.avatar : (p.avatar ?? u.avatar)
      await saveUser(u)
      return u
    }
  }
  const username = await uniqueUsername(p.name)
  const u = newUser({ ...p, username })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await kvSet(linkKey, u.id)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

async function hash(password: string) {
  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex')
  const key = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  return `${salt}:${key.toString('hex')}`
}

async function check(password: string, stored: string) {
  const [salt, key] = stored.split(':')
  if (!salt || !key) return false
  const derived = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  const a = Buffer.from(key, 'hex')
  return a.length === derived.length && timingSafeEqual(a, derived)
}

export async function registerEmail(email: string, password: string, name: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (await kvGet(`email:${normalized}`)) throw new Error('Bu e-posta ile zaten bir hesap var.')
  const username = await uniqueUsername(name || normalized.split('@')[0])
  const u = newUser({ provider: 'email', providerId: normalized, name: name || username, username, email: normalized })
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, { id: u.id, hash: await hash(password) })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function loginEmail(email: string, password: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const rec = await kvGet<{ id: string; hash: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (!rec || !(await check(password, rec.hash))) throw new Error('E-posta veya şifre hatalı.')
  const u = await getUser(rec.id)
  if (!u) throw new Error('Hesap bulunamadı.')
  if (u.banned) throw new Error('Bu hesap askıya alınmış.')
  return u
}

export async function changeUsername(u: User, next: string) {
  const name = slugify(next)
  if (name.length < 3) throw new Error('Kullanıcı adı en az 3 karakter olmalı.')
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı ayrılmış.')
  if (name === u.username) return u
  const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${name}`)
  if (taken && taken !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı alınmış.')
  await kvSet(`uname:${name}`, u.id)
  const { kvDel } = await import('./store')
  await kvDel(`uname:${u.username}`)
  u.username = name
  return u
}

export async function listUsers() {
  const rows = await kvList<User>('user:', 500)
  return rows.map((r) => r.value).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: lib\anilist.ts
// ==========================================
import 'server-only'
import type { MediaCard, MediaDetail } from './anilist-types'
import { currentSeason } from './format'

const ENDPOINT = 'https://graphql.anilist.co'

export async function anilist<T>(query: string, variables: Record<string, unknown> = {}, revalidate = 1800): Promise<T | null> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
        next: { revalidate },
      })
      if (res.status === 429 && attempt === 0) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200))
        continue
      }
      const json = await res.json()
      if (json.errors && !json.data) {
        console.error('[anilist]', json.errors?.[0]?.message)
        return null
      }
      return json.data as T
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[anilist] fetch failed', (e as Error).message)
      if (attempt === 0) continue
      return null
    }
  }
  return null
}

export const CARD = `
  id
  title { romaji english native userPreferred }
  coverImage { extraLarge large color }
  bannerImage
  format
  season
  seasonYear
  episodes
  duration
  averageScore
  popularity
  genres
  status
  trailer { id site }
  nextAiringEpisode { episode airingAt timeUntilAiring }
`

export async function getHomeData() {
  const { season, year } = currentSeason()
  const query = `
    query ($season: MediaSeason, $year: Int) {
      hero: Page(perPage: 6) { media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} description(asHtml: false) } }
      top: Page(perPage: 10) { media(type: ANIME, sort: [TRENDING_DESC, POPULARITY_DESC], isAdult: false, status_in: [RELEASING, FINISHED]) { ${CARD} } }
      seasonal: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, season: $season, seasonYear: $year, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      allTime: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, sort: SCORE_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      popular: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      upcoming: Page(perPage: 18) { media(type: ANIME, status: NOT_YET_RELEASED, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, isAdult: false) { ${CARD} } }
      pick: Page(perPage: 1, page: 2) { media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC, isAdult: false, format_in: [TV, ONA, MOVIE]) { ${CARD} description(asHtml: false) } }
    }`
  type R = Record<'hero' | 'top' | 'seasonal' | 'allTime' | 'popular' | 'upcoming' | 'pick', { media: MediaCard[] }>
  const data = await anilist<R>(query, { season, year }, 1800)
  return {
    season,
    year,
    hero: data?.hero.media ?? [],
    top: data?.top.media ?? [],
    seasonal: data?.seasonal.media ?? [],
    allTime: data?.allTime.media ?? [],
    popular: data?.popular.media ?? [],
    upcoming: data?.upcoming.media ?? [],
    pick: data?.pick.media?.[0] ?? null,
  }
}

export async function getIntroCovers() {
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { media: { coverImage: { extraLarge?: string; large?: string } }[] } }>(
    `query { Page(perPage: 36) { media(type: ANIME, sort: TRENDING_DESC, isAdult: false) { coverImage { extraLarge large } } } }`,
    {},
    86400,
  )
  return (data?.Page.media ?? []).map((m) => m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || '').filter(Boolean)
}

export async function getAnime(id: number) {
  const query = `
    query ($id: Int) {
      Media(id: $id, type: ANIME) {
        ${CARD}
        description(asHtml: false)
        synonyms source meanScore favourites isAdult countryOfOrigin hashtag
        startDate { year month day }
        endDate { year month day }
        studios { nodes { id name isAnimationStudio } }
        tags { id name rank isMediaSpoiler }
        characters(sort: [ROLE, RELEVANCE], perPage: 18) {
          edges { role node { id name { full native } image { large } }
            voiceActors(language: JAPANESE, sort: RELEVANCE) { id name { full native } image { large } languageV2 } }
        }
        staff(perPage: 10, sort: RELEVANCE) { edges { role node { id name { full } image { large } } } }
        relations { edges { relationType node { ${CARD} type } } }
        recommendations(perPage: 12, sort: RATING_DESC) { nodes { mediaRecommendation { ${CARD} } } }
        stats { scoreDistribution { score amount } statusDistribution { status amount } }
        externalLinks { id site url type color icon }
        rankings { id rank type allTime context year season }
      }
    }`
  const data = await anilist<{ Media: MediaDetail }>(query, { id }, 3600)
  return data?.Media ?? null
}

export type SearchParams = {
  q?: string
  genre?: string
  year?: number
  season?: string
  format?: string
  status?: string
  sort?: string
  page?: number
}

export async function searchAnime(p: SearchParams) {
  const query = `
    query ($page: Int, $search: String, $genre: String, $year: Int, $season: MediaSeason, $format: MediaFormat, $status: MediaStatus, $sort: [MediaSort]) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: 24) {
        pageInfo { hasNextPage total currentPage }
        media(type: ANIME, isAdult: false, search: $search, genre: $genre, seasonYear: $year, season: $season, format: $format, status: $status, sort: $sort) { ${CARD} }
      }
    }`
  const sort = p.sort || (p.q ? 'SEARCH_MATCH' : 'POPULARITY_DESC')
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean; total: number; currentPage: number }; media: MediaCard[] } }>(
    query,
    {
      page: p.page || 1,
      search: p.q || undefined,
      genre: p.genre || undefined,
      year: p.year || undefined,
      season: p.season || undefined,
      format: p.format || undefined,
      status: p.status || undefined,
      sort: [sort],
    },
    900,
  )
  return data?.Page ?? { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, total: 0, currentPage: 1 }, media: [] }
}

export async function quickSearch(q: string) {
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { media: MediaCard[] } }>(
    `query ($q: String) { Page(perPage: 8) { media(type: ANIME, search: $q, isAdult: false, sort: SEARCH_MATCH) { ${CARD} } } }`,
    { q },
    600,
  )
  return data?.Page.media ?? []
}

export type ScheduleItem = { id: number; episode: number; airingAt: number; media: MediaCard }

export async function getSchedule() {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
  const start = now - (now % 86400) - 3 * 3600
  const end = start + 7 * 86400
  const query = `
    query ($start: Int, $end: Int, $page: Int) {
      Page(page: $page, perPage: 50) {
        pageInfo { hasNextPage }
        airingSchedules(airingAt_greater: $start, airingAt_lesser: $end, sort: TIME) { id episode airingAt media { ${CARD} isAdult } }
      }
    }`
  const all: ScheduleItem[] = []
  for (let page = 1; page <= 4; page++) {
    const data = await anilist<{ Page: { pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean }; airingSchedules: (ScheduleItem & { media: MediaCard & { isAdult?: boolean } })[] } }>(
      query,
      { start, end, page },
      1800,
    )
    if (!data) break
    all.push(...data.Page.airingSchedules.filter((s) => !s.media.isAdult))
    if (!data.Page.pageInfo.hasNextPage) break
  }
  return all
}

export async function getRandomPool(genre?: string) {
  const page = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { media: (MediaCard & { description?: string })[] } }>(
    `query ($page: Int, $genre: String) { Page(page: $page, perPage: 50) { media(type: ANIME, isAdult: false, genre: $genre, sort: POPULARITY_DESC, averageScore_greater: 60) { ${CARD} description(asHtml:false) } } }`,
    { page, genre: genre || undefined },
    3600,
  )
  return data?.Page.media ?? []
}

export async function getManyAnime(ids: number[]) {
  if (!ids.length) return []
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { media: MediaCard[] } }>(
    `query ($ids: [Int]) { Page(perPage: 50) { media(id_in: $ids, type: ANIME) { ${CARD} } } }`,
    { ids },
    3600,
  )
  const media = data?.Page.media ?? []
  return ids.map((id) => media.find((m) => m.id === id)).filter(Boolean) as MediaCard[]
}

export async function getCompare(ids: number[]) {
  if (!ids.length) return []
  const data = await anilist<{ Page: { media: MediaDetail[] } }>(
    `query ($ids: [Int]) { Page(perPage: 2) { media(id_in: $ids, type: ANIME) { ${CARD} meanScore favourites source
      studios(isMain: true) { nodes { id name isAnimationStudio } }
      startDate { year month day }
      rankings { id rank type allTime context year season }
      stats { statusDistribution { status amount } } } } }`,
    { ids },
    3600,
  )
  const media = data?.Page.media ?? []
  return ids.map((id) => media.find((m) => m.id === id)).filter(Boolean) as MediaDetail[]
}


// ==========================================
// DOSYA: lib\format.ts
// ==========================================
import type { MediaTitle } from './anilist-types'

export function pickTitle(t?: MediaTitle | null) {
  if (!t) return 'Bilinmeyen'
  return t.english || t.romaji || t.userPreferred || t.native || 'Bilinmeyen'
}

export function splitTitle(title: string) {
  const words = title.trim().split(/\s+/)
  if (words.length < 2) return { head: '', tail: title }
  const tail = words.pop() as string
  return { head: words.join(' '), tail }
}

export function stripHtml(html?: string | null) {
  if (!html) return ''
  return html
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
    .replace(/~!([\s\S]*?)!~/g, '$1')
    .replace(/__(.*?)__/g, '$1')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#039;|&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&mdash;/g, '—')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim()
}

export function currentSeason(date = new Date()) {
  const m = date.getMonth()
  const year = date.getFullYear()
  if (m <= 2) return { season: 'WINTER', year }
  if (m <= 5) return { season: 'SPRING', year }
  if (m <= 8) return { season: 'SUMMER', year }
  return { season: 'FALL', year }
}

export function timeUntil(seconds: number) {
  const d = Math.floor(seconds / 86400)
  const h = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600)
  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
  if (d > 0) return `${d}g ${h}s`
  if (h > 0) return `${h}s ${m}dk`
  return `${m}dk`
}

export function fuzzyDate(d?: { year?: number | null; month?: number | null; day?: number | null } | null) {
  if (!d || !d.year) return null
  const months = ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara']
  return [d.day, d.month ? months[d.month - 1] : null, d.year].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
}

export function compact(n?: number | null) {
  if (n == null) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n)
}

import 'server-only'

export type OAuthProvider = 'discord' | 'google' | 'github'

type Profile = { id: string; name: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }

type Config = {
  label: string
  envId: string
  envSecret: string
  authorize: string
  token: string
  scope: string
  extra?: Record<string, string>
  profile: (accessToken: string) => Promise<Profile>
}

export const OAUTH: Record<OAuthProvider, Config> = {
  discord: {
    label: 'Discord',
    envId: 'DISCORD_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize',
    token: 'https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token',
    scope: 'identify email',
    extra: { prompt: 'none' },
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://discord.com/api/users/@me', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Discord profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { id: string; username: string; global_name?: string | null; avatar?: string | null; email?: string | null }
      const ext = u.avatar?.startsWith('a_') ? 'gif' : 'png'
      return {
        id: u.id,
        name: u.global_name || u.username,
        email: u.email,
        avatar: u.avatar ? `https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/${u.id}/${u.avatar}.${ext}?size=512` : null,
      }
    },
  },
  google: {
    label: 'Google',
    envId: 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth',
    token: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
    scope: 'openid email profile',
    extra: { prompt: 'select_account' },
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Google profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { sub: string; name?: string; email?: string; picture?: string }
      return { id: u.sub, name: u.name || u.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Kullanıcı', email: u.email, avatar: u.picture?.replace('=s96-c', '=s512-c') }
    },
  },
  github: {
    label: 'GitHub',
    envId: 'GITHUB_CLIENT_ID',
    envSecret: 'GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET',
    authorize: 'https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize',
    token: 'https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token',
    scope: 'read:user user:email',
    async profile(token) {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/user', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'User-Agent': 'sytheris' } })
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GitHub profil hatası ${res.status}`)
      const u = (await res.json()) as { id: number; login: string; name?: string | null; avatar_url?: string; email?: string | null }
      return { id: String(u.id), name: u.name || u.login, email: u.email, avatar: u.avatar_url }
    },
  },
}

export function isProvider(p: string): p is OAuthProvider {
  return p === 'discord' || p === 'google' || p === 'github'
}

export function providerStatus() {
  return (Object.keys(OAUTH) as OAuthProvider[]).map((id) => ({
    id,
    label: OAUTH[id].label,
    configured: Boolean(process.env[OAUTH[id].envId] && process.env[OAUTH[id].envSecret]),
  }))
}

export function appOrigin(request: Request) {
  if (process.env.APP_URL) return process.env.APP_URL.replace(/\/$/, '')
  const h = request.headers
  const host = h.get('x-forwarded-host') || h.get('host')
  const proto = h.get('x-forwarded-proto') || (host?.startsWith('localhost') ? 'http' : 'https')
  return host ? `${proto}://${host}` : new URL(request.url).origin
}

export async function loadGoogleFont(family: string, weight: number, style: 'normal' | 'italic' = 'normal') {
  try {
    const css = await (
      await fetch(`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=${family.replace(/ /g, '+')}:${style === 'italic' ? 'ital,' : ''}wght@${style === 'italic' ? '1,' : ''}${weight}`, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Sytheris OG)' },
      })
    ).text()
    const url = css.match(/src: url\(([^)]+)\) format\('(?:truetype|opentype)'\)/)?.[1]
    if (!url) return null
    return await (await fetch(url)).arrayBuffer()
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

// DOSYA: lib\prefs.ts

'use client'

import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'

export type Prefs = {
  autoplayTrailers: boolean
  trailerSound: boolean
  reduceMotion: boolean
  intro: boolean
  subtitleSize: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
  subtitleBg: boolean
  aiProvider: 'auto' | 'ollama' | 'gemini'
  ollamaUrl: string
  ollamaModel: string
}

export const DEFAULT_PREFS: Prefs = {
  autoplayTrailers: true,
  trailerSound: false,
  reduceMotion: false,
  intro: true,
  subtitleSize: 'md',
  subtitleBg: true,
  aiProvider: 'auto',
  ollamaUrl: 'http://localhost:11434',
  ollamaModel: 'llama3.2',
}

const KEY = 'sy-prefs'
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
let cache: Prefs | null = null

function read(): Prefs {
  if (cache) return cache
  try {
    cache = { ...DEFAULT_PREFS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '{}') }
  } catch {
    cache = DEFAULT_PREFS
  }
  return cache as Prefs
}

export function setPrefs(patch: Partial<Prefs>) {
  cache = { ...read(), ...patch }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cache))
    if ('reduceMotion' in patch) {
      localStorage.setItem('sy-reduce-motion', patch.reduceMotion ? '1' : '0')
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('reduce-motion', Boolean(patch.reduceMotion))
    }
    if ('intro' in patch) localStorage.setItem('sy-intro', patch.intro ? '1' : '0')
  } catch {}
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

export function getPrefs() {
  return typeof window === 'undefined' ? DEFAULT_PREFS : read()
}

export function usePrefs(): Prefs {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    (cb) => {
      listeners.add(cb)
      return () => listeners.delete(cb)
    },
    read,
    () => DEFAULT_PREFS,
  )
}

// DOSYA: lib\session.ts
// ==========================================
import 'server-only'
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual, createHash } from 'crypto'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __sySecret?: string }

function secret() {
  if (process.env.SESSION_SECRET) return process.env.SESSION_SECRET
  if (process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD) return createHash('sha256').update(`sytheris:${process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}`).digest('hex')
  if (!g.__sySecret) g.__sySecret = randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
  return g.__sySecret
}

function b64(input: string) {
  return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64url')
}

export function sign(payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const body = b64(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const sig = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  return `${body}.${sig}`
}

export function verify<T = Record<string, unknown>>(token?: string | null): T | null {
  if (!token) return null
  const [body, sig] = token.split('.')
  if (!body || !sig) return null
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret()).update(body).digest('base64url')
  const a = Buffer.from(sig)
  const b = Buffer.from(expected)
  if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) return null
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, 'base64url').toString()) as T & { exp?: number }
    if (data.exp && Date.now() > data.exp) return null
    return data
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'sy_session'
export const ADMIN_COOKIE = 'sy_admin'

const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'

export const cookieOptions = (maxAgeSeconds: number) =>
  ({
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: isProd,
    sameSite: 'lax' as const,
    path: '/',
    maxAge: maxAgeSeconds,
  })

export async function getSessionUserId() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ uid: string }>(store.get(SESSION_COOKIE)?.value)
  return data?.uid ?? null
}

export async function isAdmin() {
  const store = await cookies()
  const data = verify<{ admin: boolean }>(store.get(ADMIN_COOKIE)?.value)
  return Boolean(data?.admin)
}

export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  const ha = createHash('sha256').update(a).digest()
  const hb = createHash('sha256').update(b).digest()
  return timingSafeEqual(ha, hb)
}

  maintenanceTitle: 'Kısa bir moladayız',

  maintenanceEta: '',

/* ---------- Episodes ---------- */
export type Episode = {
  id: string
  animeId: number
  animeTitle: string
  animeCover?: string | null
  number: number
  title: string
  videoUrl: string
  magnetUrl?: string | null // <-- BURAYA EKLENDİ
  subtitleUrl?: string | null
  subtitleText?: string | null
  subtitleLang: string
  thumbnail?: string | null
  createdAt: number
}

export async function listEpisodes(animeId: number) {
  const list = (await kvGet<Episode[]>(`episodes:${animeId}`)) ?? []
  return list.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number)
}

export async function getEpisode(animeId: number, number: number) {
  const list = await listEpisodes(animeId)
  return list.find((e) => e.number === number) ?? null
}

export async function getEpisodeById(id: string) {
  const index = (await kvGet<Record<string, number>>('episode-index')) ?? {}
  const animeId = index[id]
  if (!animeId) return null
  const list = await listEpisodes(animeId)
  return list.find((e) => e.id === id) ?? null
}

export async function addEpisode(input: Omit<Episode, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) {
  const list = await listEpisodes(input.animeId)
  const existing = list.findIndex((e) => e.number === input.number)
  const ep: Episode = { ...input, id: existing >= 0 ? list[existing].id : randomBytes(8).toString('hex'), createdAt: Date.now() }
  if (existing >= 0) list[existing] = ep
  else list.push(ep)
  await kvSet(`episodes:${input.animeId}`, list)
  const index = (await kvGet<Record<string, number>>('episode-index')) ?? {}
  index[ep.id] = ep.animeId
  await kvSet('episode-index', index)
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  catalog[input.animeId] = { title: input.animeTitle, cover: input.animeCover, count: list.length, updatedAt: Date.now() }
  await kvSet('episode-catalog', catalog)
  return ep
}

export async function deleteEpisode(animeId: number, id: string) {
  const list = (await listEpisodes(animeId)).filter((e) => e.id !== id)
  if (list.length) await kvSet(`episodes:${animeId}`, list)
  else await kvDel(`episodes:${animeId}`)
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  if (list.length) catalog[animeId] = { ...catalog[animeId], count: list.length, updatedAt: Date.now() }
  else delete catalog[animeId]
  await kvSet('episode-catalog', catalog)
}

export async function getEpisodeCatalog() {
  const catalog = (await kvGet<Record<string, { title: string; cover?: string | null; count: number; updatedAt: number }>>('episode-catalog')) ?? {}
  return Object.entries(catalog)
    .map(([id, v]) => ({ animeId: Number(id), ...v }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt)
}

/* ---------- Error logs ---------- */
export type LogEntry = {
  id: string
  level: 'error' | 'warn' | 'info'
  source: 'client' | 'server'
  message: string
  stack?: string
  path?: string
  userAgent?: string
  at: number
}

export async function logEvent(entry: Omit<LogEntry, 'id' | 'at'>) {
  try {
    const list = (await kvGet<LogEntry[]>('logs')) ?? []
    list.unshift({ ...entry, message: entry.message.slice(0, 600), stack: entry.stack?.slice(0, 2000), id: randomBytes(6).toString('hex'), at: Date.now() })
    await kvSet('logs', list.slice(0, 200))
  } catch {
    /* logging must never throw */
  }
}

export async function getLogs() {
  return (await kvGet<LogEntry[]>('logs')) ?? []
}

export async function clearLogs() {
  await kvSet('logs', [])
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: lib\store.ts
// ==========================================
import 'server-only'
import { Pool } from 'pg'
import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

type Row = { key: string; value: unknown }

const g = globalThis as unknown as { __syStore?: Map<string, unknown>; __syStoreReady?: Promise<void>; __syTable?: Promise<void> }

const FILE = path.join(process.env.TMPDIR || '/tmp', 'sytheris-store.json')

export function storeBackend(): 'postgres' | 'memory' {
  return process.env.DATABASE_URL ? 'postgres' : 'memory'
}

// Standart PostgreSQL bağlantı havuzu (Supabase ile tam uyumlu)
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
})

async function ensureTable() {
  if (!g.__syTable) {
    g.__syTable = (async () => {
      await pool.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sytheris_kv (
          key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, 
          value JSONB NOT NULL, 
          updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
        )
      `)
    })().catch((e) => {
      g.__syTable = undefined
      throw e
    })
  }
  return g.__syTable
}

async function memory() {
  if (!g.__syStore) {
    g.__syStore = new Map()
    g.__syStoreReady = fs
      .readFile(FILE, 'utf8')
      .then((raw) => {
        const obj = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) g.__syStore!.set(k, v)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }
  await g.__syStoreReady
  return g.__syStore
}

let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
function scheduleFlush(map: Map<string, unknown>) {
  if (flushTimer) clearTimeout(flushTimer)
  flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    fs.writeFile(FILE, JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(map))).catch(() => {})
  }, 150)
}

export async function kvGet<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const res = await pool.query('SELECT value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = $1', [key])
    return res.rows[0]?.value ?? null
  }
  const m = await memory()
  return (m.get(key) as T) ?? null
}

export async function kvSet<T>(key: string, value: T) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO sytheris_kv (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, now())
       ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()`,
      [key, JSON.stringify(value)]
    )
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.set(key, value)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvDel(key: string) {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key = $1', [key])
    return
  }
  const m = await memory()
  m.delete(key)
  scheduleFlush(m)
}

export async function kvList<T>(prefix: string, limit = 500): Promise<{ key: string; value: T }[]> {
  if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
    await ensureTable()
    const like = prefix.replace(/[%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`) + '%'
    const res = await pool.query(
      'SELECT key, value FROM sytheris_kv WHERE key LIKE $1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT $2',
      [like, limit]
    )
    return res.rows as { key: string; value: T }[]
  }
  const m = await memory()
  const out: { key: string; value: T }[] = []
  for (const [key, value] of m) if (key.startsWith(prefix)) out.push({ key, value: value as T })
  return out.reverse().slice(0, limit)
}

export async function storeHealth() {
  const started = Date.now()
  try {
    if (storeBackend() === 'postgres') {
      await ensureTable()
      await pool.query('SELECT 1')
    } else {
      await memory()
    }
    return { ok: true, ms: Date.now() - started }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, ms: Date.now() - started, error: (e as Error).message }
  }
}

// ==========================================
// DOSYA: lib\subtitles.ts
// ==========================================
function assTime(t: string) {
  const [h, m, s] = t.trim().split(':')
  const [sec, cs = '0'] = s.split('.')
  return `${h.padStart(2, '0')}:${m.padStart(2, '0')}:${sec.padStart(2, '0')}.${cs.padEnd(3, '0').slice(0, 3)}`
}

function assToVtt(input: string) {
  const lines = input.split(/\r?\n/)
  let format: string[] = []
  const cues: string[] = []
  let inEvents = false
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (/^\[events\]/i.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = true
      continue
    }
    if (/^\[.*\]$/.test(line.trim())) {
      inEvents = false
      continue
    }
    if (!inEvents) continue
    if (line.startsWith('Format:')) format = line.slice(7).split(',').map((f) => f.trim().toLowerCase())
    if (line.startsWith('Dialogue:')) {
      const parts = line.slice(9).split(',')
      const textIndex = format.indexOf('text')
      const start = parts[format.indexOf('start')]
      const end = parts[format.indexOf('end')]
      if (!start || !end || textIndex < 0) continue
      const text = parts
        .slice(textIndex)
        .join(',')
        .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\N/gi, '\n')
        .trim()
      if (text) cues.push(`${assTime(start)} --> ${assTime(end)}\n${text}`)
    }
  }
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${cues.join('\n\n')}\n`
}

export function toVtt(input: string) {
  const text = input.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()
  if (text.startsWith('WEBVTT')) return text + '\n'
  if (/^\[script info\]/i.test(text) || text.includes('Dialogue:')) return assToVtt(text)
  const body = text
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
    .replace(/(\d{1,2}:\d{2}),(\d{3})/g, '$1.$2')
  return `WEBVTT\n\n${body}\n`
}

// DOSYA: lib\users.ts
// ==========================================
import 'server-only'
import { randomBytes, scrypt as _scrypt, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'
import { promisify } from 'util'
import { kvGet, kvList, kvSet } from './store'
import { getSessionUserId } from './session'

const scrypt = promisify(_scrypt) as (pw: string, salt: string, len: number) => Promise<Buffer>

export type Provider = 'discord' | 'google' | 'github' | 'email'

export type ProfileLink = { type: string; url: string }
export type ProfileSong = { title: string; artist: string; url: string; cover?: string | null } | null

export type User = {
  id: string
  username: string
  displayName: string
  email?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  provider: Provider
  providerId: string
  createdAt: number
  bio: string
  location: string
  background?: string | null
  backgroundDim: number
  accent: string
  links: ProfileLink[]
  song: ProfileSong
  favorites: number[]
  views: number
  effects: { tilt: boolean; typewriter: boolean; glow: boolean }
  banned?: boolean
}

export type PublicUser = Omit<User, 'email' | 'providerId'>

export function toPublic(u: User): PublicUser {
  const { email: _e, providerId: _p, ...rest } = u
  return rest
}

function slugify(s: string) {
  return (
    s
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFKD')
      .replace(/[ıİ]/g, 'i')
      .replace(/[şŞ]/g, 's')
      .replace(/[ğĞ]/g, 'g')
      .replace(/[üÜ]/g, 'u')
      .replace(/[öÖ]/g, 'o')
      .replace(/[çÇ]/g, 'c')
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 20) || 'kullanici'
  )
}

export const RESERVED = new Set(['admin', 'api', 'giris', 'profil', 'sytheris', 'root', 'moderator', 'support'])

export async function uniqueUsername(base: string) {
  let name = slugify(base)
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) name = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 999)}`
  let candidate = name
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${candidate}`)
    if (!taken) return candidate
    candidate = `${name}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 9999)}`
  }
  return `${name}${randomBytes(3).toString('hex')}`
}

function newUser(p: { provider: Provider; providerId: string; name: string; username: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }): User {
  return {
    id: randomBytes(12).toString('hex'),
    username: p.username,
    displayName: p.name.slice(0, 40),
    email: p.email ?? null,
    avatar: p.avatar ?? null,
    provider: p.provider,
    providerId: p.providerId,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    bio: 'Sytheris üzerinde anime keşfediyorum.',
    location: '',
    background: null,
    backgroundDim: 55,
    accent: 'green',
    links: [],
    song: null,
    favorites: [],
    views: 0,
    effects: { tilt: true, typewriter: true, glow: true },
  }
}

export async function getUser(id: string) {
  return kvGet<User>(`user:${id}`)
}

export async function saveUser(u: User) {
  await kvSet(`user:${u.id}`, u)
}

export async function getUserByUsername(username: string) {
  const id = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${username.toLowerCase()}`)
  return id ? getUser(id) : null
}

export async function getCurrentUser() {
  try {
    const uid = await getSessionUserId()
    if (!uid) return null
    const u = await getUser(uid)
    if (!u || u.banned) return null
    return u
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function upsertOAuthUser(p: { provider: Exclude<Provider, 'email'>; providerId: string; name: string; email?: string | null; avatar?: string | null }) {
  const linkKey = `oauth:${p.provider}:${p.providerId}`
  const existingId = await kvGet<string>(linkKey)
  if (existingId) {
    const u = await getUser(existingId)
    if (u) {
      u.avatar = u.avatar && !u.avatar.includes('cdn.discordapp') && !u.avatar.includes('googleusercontent') && !u.avatar.includes('githubusercontent') ? u.avatar : (p.avatar ?? u.avatar)
      await saveUser(u)
      return u
    }
  }
  const username = await uniqueUsername(p.name)
  const u = newUser({ ...p, username })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await kvSet(linkKey, u.id)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

async function hash(password: string) {
  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex')
  const key = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  return `${salt}:${key.toString('hex')}`
}

async function check(password: string, stored: string) {
  const [salt, key] = stored.split(':')
  if (!salt || !key) return false
  const derived = await scrypt(password, salt, 64)
  const a = Buffer.from(key, 'hex')
  return a.length === derived.length && timingSafeEqual(a, derived)
}

export async function registerEmail(email: string, password: string, name: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (await kvGet(`email:${normalized}`)) throw new Error('Bu e-posta ile zaten bir hesap var.')
  const username = await uniqueUsername(name || normalized.split('@')[0])
  const u = newUser({ provider: 'email', providerId: normalized, name: name || username, username, email: normalized })
  await kvSet(`email:${normalized}`, { id: u.id, hash: await hash(password) })
  await kvSet(`uname:${username}`, u.id)
  await saveUser(u)
  return u
}

export async function loginEmail(email: string, password: string) {
  const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const rec = await kvGet<{ id: string; hash: string }>(`email:${normalized}`)
  if (!rec || !(await check(password, rec.hash))) throw new Error('E-posta veya şifre hatalı.')
  const u = await getUser(rec.id)
  if (!u) throw new Error('Hesap bulunamadı.')
  if (u.banned) throw new Error('Bu hesap askıya alınmış.')
  return u
}

export async function changeUsername(u: User, next: string) {
  const name = slugify(next)
  if (name.length < 3) throw new Error('Kullanıcı adı en az 3 karakter olmalı.')
  if (RESERVED.has(name)) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı ayrılmış.')
  if (name === u.username) return u
  const taken = await kvGet<string>(`uname:${name}`)
  if (taken && taken !== u.id) throw new Error('Bu kullanıcı adı alınmış.')
  await kvSet(`uname:${name}`, u.id)
  const { kvDel } = await import('./store')
  await kvDel(`uname:${u.username}`)
  u.username = name
  return u
}

export async function listUsers() {
  const rows = await kvList<User>('user:', 500)
  return rows.map((r) => r.value).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt)
}

===== DOSYA: app\(bare)\u\[username]\page.tsx =====
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { getManyAnime } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { getCurrentUser, getUserByUsername, toPublic } from '@/lib/users'
import { ProfileView } from '@/components/profile/profile-view'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ username: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { username } = await params
  const user = await getUserByUsername(username)
  if (!user) return { title: 'Profil bulunamadı' }
  return {
    title: `${user.displayName} (@${user.username})`,
    description: user.bio || `${user.displayName} Sytheris profili`,
    openGraph: { title: `${user.displayName} — SYTHERIS`, description: user.bio, images: user.avatar ? [user.avatar] : undefined, type: 'profile' },
    twitter: { card: 'summary', title: `${user.displayName} — SYTHERIS`, description: user.bio },
  }
}

export default async function PublicProfile({ params }: Props) {
  const { username } = await params
  const [user, viewer] = await Promise.all([getUserByUsername(username), getCurrentUser()])
  if (!user || user.banned) notFound()
  const favs = await getManyAnime(user.favorites.slice(0, 8))
  return (
    <ProfileView
      user={toPublic(user)}
      isOwner={viewer?.id === user.id}
      favorites={favs.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, title: pickTitle(m.title), cover: m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || null }))}
    />
  )
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { ArrowLeft, Captions, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { getAnimeMeta } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { listEpisodes } from '@/lib/site'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { VideoPlayer } from '@/components/player/video-player'

type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string; ep: string }> }

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { id, ep } = await params
  const media = await getAnimeMeta(Number(id))
  return { title: media ? `${pickTitle(media.title)} ${ep}. Bölüm izle` : 'Bölüm izle' }

export default async function WatchPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id, ep } = await params
  const animeId = Number(id)
  const number = Number(ep)
  const [media, episodes] = await Promise.all([getAnimeMeta(animeId), listEpisodes(animeId).catch(() => [])])
  const index = episodes.findIndex((e) => e.number === number)
  const current = episodes[index]
  const title = media ? pickTitle(media.title) : 'Anime'

  if (!current) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-xl flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-32 text-center">
        <p className="label-mono text-ink">Bölüm yok</p>
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Bu bölüm henüz <span className="accent-serif">eklenmedi</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Yöneticiler bölümü eklediğinde burada izleyebileceksin.</p>
        <Link href={`/anime/${animeId}`} className="mt-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 py-3 font-medium text-primary-foreground">
          Anime sayfasına dön
        </Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const prev = episodes[index - 1]
  const next = episodes[index + 1]
  const subtitleSrc = current.subtitleText || current.subtitleUrl ? `/api/subtitle/${current.id}` : null

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] gap-8 px-4 pb-10 pt-6 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px] lg:px-10">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-5">
        <Link href={`/anime/${animeId}`} className="flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-foreground">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> {title}
        </Link>
        <VideoPlayer
          key={current.id}
          src={current.videoUrl}
          subtitleSrc={subtitleSrc}
          subtitleLang={current.subtitleLang}
          poster={current.thumbnail || media?.bannerImage}
          title={current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}
          episodeLabel={`${title} · Bölüm ${current.number}`}
          storageKey={current.id}
          prevHref={prev ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${prev.number}` : null}
          nextHref={next ? `/anime/${animeId}/izle/${next.number}` : null}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="label-mono text-ink">Bölüm {current.number}</p>
          <h1 className="text-balance text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl">
            {title} <span className="accent-serif">{current.title || `${current.number}. bölüm`}</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Captions className="size-4" />
            {subtitleSrc ? `${current.subtitleLang.toUpperCase()} altyazı mevcut — C tuşuyla aç/kapat` : 'Bu bölümde altyazı yok'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Kısayollar: Boşluk / K oynat · J / L 10 sn · F tam ekran · M sessiz</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <aside className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:pt-10">
        <p className="label-mono text-muted-foreground">Bölümler ({episodes.length})</p>
        <ul className="flex max-h-[70vh] flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {episodes.map((e) => {
            const active = e.id === current.id
            return (
              <li key={e.id}>
                <Link
                  href={`/anime/${animeId}/izle/${e.number}`}
                  aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
                  className={cn('flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-2 transition', active ? 'border-primary bg-accent' : 'border-border bg-card hover:border-primary/50')}
                >
                  <span className="relative grid aspect-video w-28 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-muted">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={e.thumbnail || media?.bannerImage || media?.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover" />
                    {active && (
                      <span className="relative grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
                        <Play className="ml-0.5 size-3.5 fill-current" />
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="label-mono text-[9px] text-ink">Bölüm {e.number}</span>
                    <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{e.title || `${e.number}. bölüm`}</span>
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: app\(site)\anime\[id]\opengraph-image.tsx =====
import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'
import { getAnimeMeta } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, splitTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { loadGoogleFont } from '@/lib/og'

export const alt = 'Anime detayları — SYTHERIS'
export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 }
export const contentType = 'image/png'

export default async function OG({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const [media, bold, serif] = await Promise.all([getAnimeMeta(Number(id)), loadGoogleFont('Bricolage Grotesque', 700), loadGoogleFont('Instrument Serif', 400, 'italic')])
  const fonts = [
    ...(bold ? [{ name: 'Bricolage', data: bold, weight: 700 as const, style: 'normal' as const }] : []),
    ...(serif ? [{ name: 'Instrument', data: serif, weight: 400 as const, style: 'italic' as const }] : []),
  ]
  const title = media ? pickTitle(media.title) : 'SYTHERIS'
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const bg = media?.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${media.trailer.id}/hqdefault.jpg` : media?.bannerImage || media?.coverImage.extraLarge
  const accent = media?.coverImage.color || '#10d27f'
  const fontSize = title.length > 40 ? 58 : title.length > 22 ? 72 : 92

  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', position: 'relative', background: '#07100c', fontFamily: 'Bricolage', color: '#f4f7f5' }}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        {bg && <img src={bg} alt="" width={1200} height={630} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', opacity: 0.5 }} />}
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'flex', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #07100c 0%, rgba(7,16,12,0.92) 50%, rgba(7,16,12,0.4) 100%)' }} />
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 56, padding: '0 72px', width: '100%' }}>
          {media?.coverImage.extraLarge && (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img src={media.coverImage.extraLarge} alt="" width={320} height={460} style={{ borderRadius: 28, objectFit: 'cover', boxShadow: `0 30px 80px ${accent}66` }} />
          )}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, fontSize: 20, letterSpacing: 6, color: '#10d27f' }}>
              <div style={{ width: 40, height: 2, background: '#10d27f' }} />
              {[media?.seasonYear, formatTr(media?.format)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', fontSize, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: -2, lineHeight: 1.02, marginTop: 18, gap: 18 }}>
              {head && <span>{head}</span>}
              <span style={{ fontFamily: 'Instrument', fontStyle: 'italic', fontWeight: 400, color: '#10d27f' }}>{tail}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginTop: 32, fontSize: 22 }}>
              {media?.averageScore ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', background: '#10d27f', color: '#07100c', borderRadius: 999, padding: '8px 20px', fontWeight: 700 }}>{media.averageScore}%</div> : null}
              {(media?.genres ?? []).slice(0, 3).map((g) => (
                <div key={g} style={{ display: 'flex', border: '1px solid rgba(244,247,245,0.3)', borderRadius: 999, padding: '8px 20px' }}>
                  {genreTr(g)}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', marginTop: 48, fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: -1 }}>SYTHERIS</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size, fonts: fonts.length ? fonts : undefined },
  )
}

export default async function AnimePage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const animeId = Number(id)
  if (!Number.isInteger(animeId)) notFound()
  const [media, episodes, user] = await Promise.all([getAnime(animeId), listEpisodes(animeId).catch(() => []), getCurrentUser()])
  if (!media) notFound()

  const title = pickTitle(media.title)
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)
  const trailerId = media.trailer?.site === 'youtube' ? media.trailer.id : null
  const studio = media.studios?.nodes.find((s) => s.isAnimationStudio) ?? media.studios?.nodes[0]
  const recs = (media.recommendations?.nodes ?? []).map((n) => n.mediaRecommendation).filter((m): m is MediaCard => Boolean(m))
  const relations = (media.relations?.edges ?? []).filter((e) => e.node.type === 'ANIME')
  const scoreDist = media.stats?.scoreDistribution ?? []
  const maxScore = Math.max(1, ...scoreDist.map((s) => s.amount))
  const streaming = (media.externalLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l.type === 'STREAMING')
  const rankTop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'RATED')
  const rankPop = media.rankings?.find((r) => r.allTime && r.type === 'POPULAR')

  const info: [string, string | null | undefined][] = [
    ['Format', formatTr(media.format)],
    ['Bölüm', media.episodes ? `${media.episodes}` : media.nextAiringEpisode ? `${media.nextAiringEpisode.episode - 1}+` : null],
    ['Süre', media.duration ? `${media.duration} dk` : null],
    ['Durum', statusTr(media.status)],
    ['Başlangıç', fuzzyDate(media.startDate)],
    ['Bitiş', fuzzyDate(media.endDate)],
    ['Sezon', media.season ? `${seasonTr(media.season)} ${media.seasonYear ?? ''}` : null],
    ['Stüdyo', studio?.name],
    ['Kaynak', media.source ? media.source.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase() : null],
    ['Japonca', media.title.native],
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-20 pb-10">
      <section className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-scrim text-foreground">
        <DetailBackdrop media={media} />
        <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[1440px] items-end gap-8 px-4 pb-20 pt-16 sm:px-6 md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[300px_1fr] lg:gap-14 lg:px-10 lg:pb-28 lg:pt-28">
          <div className="relative mx-auto w-44 sm:w-56 md:mx-0 md:w-full">
            <div className="absolute -inset-6 -z-10 rounded-[2.5rem] opacity-60 blur-3xl" style={{ background: media.coverImage.color ?? 'var(--primary)' }} />
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img src={media.coverImage.extraLarge || media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={title} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
            <p className="label-mono flex items-center gap-3 text-ink">
              <span className="h-px w-10 bg-primary" />
              {[formatTr(media.format), media.seasonYear].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
              {media.status === 'RELEASING' && <span className="rounded-full bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-primary-foreground">Yayında</span>}
            </p>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-balance text-4xl font-bold leading-[0.95] tracking-[-0.04em] sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl">
                {head} <span className="font-serif font-normal italic tracking-[-0.01em] text-primary">{tail}</span>
              </h1>
              {media.title.native && <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-foreground/50">{media.title.native}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              {media.averageScore ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
