        if (audio && audio.currentTime > 4) audio.currentTime = 0
        else step(-1)
      },
      seek: (t) => {
        if (audioRef.current) audioRef.current.currentTime = t
      },
      setVolume: setVolumeState,
      add,
      remove,
      setShuffle,
      setRepeat,
    }),
    [playlist, currentId, playing, progress, duration, volume, shuffle, repeat, panelOpen, play, pause, toggle, step, add, remove],
  )

  return <MusicCtx.Provider value={value}>{children}</MusicCtx.Provider>
}

export function useMusic() {
  const ctx = useContext(MusicCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useMusic must be used within MusicProvider')
  return ctx
}


===== DOSYA: components\player\video-player.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Captions,
  CaptionsOff,
  Check,
  Loader2,
  Maximize,
  Minimize,
  Pause,
  PictureInPicture2,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  RotateCw,
  Settings,
  SkipBack,
  SkipForward,
  Volume1,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { setPrefs, usePrefs, type Prefs } from '@/lib/prefs'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { fmtTime } from '@/components/music/music-panel'

type Props = {
  src: string
  subtitleSrc?: string | null
  subtitleLang: string
  poster?: string | null
  title: string
  episodeLabel: string
  storageKey: string
  nextHref?: string | null
  prevHref?: string | null
}

const SPEEDS = [0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2]
const SUB_SIZES: Record<Prefs['subtitleSize'], string> = { sm: '1.9cqw', md: '2.4cqw', lg: '3cqw', xl: '3.7cqw' }

export function VideoPlayer({ src, subtitleSrc, subtitleLang, poster, title, episodeLabel, storageKey, nextHref, prevHref }: Props) {
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const trackEl = useRef<HTMLTrackElement>(null)
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const prefs = usePrefs()

  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [time, setTime] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [buffered, setBuffered] = useState(0)
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(1)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [controls, setControls] = useState(true)
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState(false)
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1)
  const [subsOn, setSubsOn] = useState(true)
  const [cue, setCue] = useState('')
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<{ x: number; t: number } | null>(null)
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false)
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pipSupported, setPipSupported] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => setPipSupported(Boolean(document.pictureInPictureEnabled)), [])

  const poke = useCallback(() => {
    setControls(true)
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current)
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!video.current?.paused) setControls(false)
    }, 2600)
  }, [])

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    if (v.paused) v.play().catch(() => {})
    else v.pause()
  }, [])

  const seekBy = useCallback((s: number) => {
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    v.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(v.duration || 0, v.currentTime + s))
    setFlash(s > 0 ? `+${s}s` : `${s}s`)
    window.setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 500)
  }, [])

  const toggleFullscreen = useCallback(() => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) wrap.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
    else document.exitFullscreen?.().catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    const v = video.current
    if (!v) return
    const saved = Number(localStorage.getItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`))
    const onMeta = () => {
      setDuration(v.duration)
      if (saved && saved < v.duration - 15) v.currentTime = saved
      const tt = v.textTracks[0]
      if (tt) tt.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    let lastSave = 0
    const onTime = () => {
      setTime(v.currentTime)
      if (v.buffered.length) setBuffered(v.buffered.end(v.buffered.length - 1))
      if (Date.now() - lastSave > 4000) {
        lastSave = Date.now()
        localStorage.setItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`, String(Math.floor(v.currentTime)))
      }
    }
    const onPlay = () => {
      setPlaying(true)
      setEnded(false)
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    }
    const onPause = () => setPlaying(false)
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true)
    const onCanPlay = () => setWaiting(false)
    const onVolume = () => {
      setVolume(v.volume)
      setMuted(v.muted)
    }
    const onEnded = () => {
      setEnded(true)
      localStorage.removeItem(`sy-pos-${storageKey}`)
    }
    const onError = () => {
      setWaiting(false)
      setError('Video yüklenemedi. Bağlantı geçersiz olabilir ya da kaynak erişime kapalı.')
    }
    v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
    v.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('progress', onTime)
    v.addEventListener('play', onPlay)
    v.addEventListener('pause', onPause)
    v.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
    v.addEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
    v.addEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
    v.addEventListener('ended', onEnded)
    v.addEventListener('error', onError)
    const onFs = () => setFullscreen(Boolean(document.fullscreenElement))
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)
    return () => {
      v.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onMeta)
      v.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('progress', onTime)
      v.removeEventListener('play', onPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('pause', onPause)
      v.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting)
      v.removeEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('playing', onCanPlay)
      v.removeEventListener('volumechange', onVolume)
      v.removeEventListener('ended', onEnded)
      v.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFs)
    }
  }, [storageKey])

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = trackEl.current
    if (!t) return
    const onCue = () => {
      const active = t.track.activeCues
      if (!active || active.length === 0) return setCue('')
      setCue(
        Array.from(active)
          .map((c) => (c as VTTCue).text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ''))
          .join('\n'),
      )
    }
    const onLoad = () => {
      t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    }
    t.addEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
    t.addEventListener('load', onLoad)
    t.track.mode = 'hidden'
    return () => {
      t.removeEventListener('cuechange', onCue)
      t.removeEventListener('load', onLoad)
    }
  }, [subtitleSrc])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return
      const v = video.current
      if (!v) return
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase()
      if (k === ' ' || k === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault()
        toggle()
      } else if (k === 'arrowright' || k === 'l') seekBy(k === 'l' ? 10 : 5)
      else if (k === 'arrowleft' || k === 'j') seekBy(k === 'j' ? -10 : -5)
      else if (k === 'arrowup') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.min(1, v.volume + 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'arrowdown') {
        e.preventDefault()
        v.volume = Math.max(0, v.volume - 0.1)
      } else if (k === 'm') v.muted = !v.muted
      else if (k === 'f') toggleFullscreen()
      else if (k === 'c') setSubsOn((s) => !s)
      else return
      poke()
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [toggle, seekBy, toggleFullscreen, poke])

  const VolIcon = muted || volume === 0 ? VolumeX : volume < 0.5 ? Volume1 : Volume2
  const pct = duration ? (time / duration) * 100 : 0
  const bufPct = duration ? (buffered / duration) * 100 : 0
  const showUi = controls || !playing || menu

  return (
    <div
      ref={wrap}
      onMouseMove={poke}
      onTouchStart={poke}
      onMouseLeave={() => playing && setControls(false)}
      className={cn('dark group/player relative aspect-video w-full select-none overflow-hidden bg-black text-foreground [container-type:inline-size]', fullscreen ? 'rounded-none' : 'rounded-3xl', !showUi && 'cursor-none')}
    >
      <video
        ref={video}
        src={src}
        poster={poster ?? undefined}
        playsInline
        preload="metadata"
        className="absolute inset-0 size-full"
        onClick={toggle}
        onDoubleClick={toggleFullscreen}
      >
        {subtitleSrc && <track ref={trackEl} kind="subtitles" src={subtitleSrc} srcLang={subtitleLang} label={subtitleLang.toUpperCase()} default />}
      </video>

      {subsOn && cue && (
        <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 flex justify-center px-[6%] transition-all duration-300', showUi ? 'bottom-[18%]' : 'bottom-[7%]')}>
          <p
            className={cn('whitespace-pre-line text-center font-semibold leading-snug text-on-scrim', prefs.subtitleBg ? 'rounded-lg bg-black/70 px-[0.6em] py-[0.25em]' : '[text-shadow:0_2px_4px_#000,0_0_2px_#000,0_0_8px_#000]')}
            style={{ fontSize: `max(13px, ${SUB_SIZES[prefs.subtitleSize]})` }}
          >
            {cue}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {waiting && !error && (
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
          <Loader2 className="size-12 animate-spin text-primary" />
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence>
        {flash && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-black/60 px-5 py-3 font-mono text-lg text-on-scrim backdrop-blur">{flash}</span>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {!playing && !waiting && !error && !ended && (
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label="Oynat" className="absolute inset-0 m-auto grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_60px_var(--primary)] transition hover:scale-105">
          <Play className="ml-1 size-8 fill-current" />
        </button>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-black/80 p-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-on-scrim">Oynatma hatası</p>
          <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-on-scrim/70">{error}</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => location.reload()} className="mt-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
            Tekrar dene
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {ended && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-black/75 p-6 text-center backdrop-blur-sm">
          <p className="label-mono text-primary">Bölüm bitti</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current?.play()} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-on-scrim/30 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm text-on-scrim">
              <RotateCcw className="size-4" /> Tekrar izle
            </button>
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
                Sonraki bölüm <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={cn('pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/70 to-transparent p-4 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:p-6', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}>
        <p className="label-mono text-[10px] text-primary">{episodeLabel}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-on-scrim sm:text-lg">{title}</p>
      </div>

      <div className={cn('absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-black/40 to-transparent px-3 pb-3 pt-14 transition-opacity duration-300 sm:px-5 sm:pb-4', showUi ? 'opacity-100' : 'pointer-events-none opacity-0')}>
        <div
          className="group/seek relative mb-2 flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center"
          onMouseMove={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            const x = Math.min(Math.max(e.clientX - r.left, 0), r.width)
            setHover({ x, t: (x / r.width) * duration })
          }}
          onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
          onClick={(e) => {
            const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (video.current) video.current.currentTime = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * duration
          }}
          role="slider"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label="İlerleme"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={Math.round(duration)}
          aria-valuenow={Math.round(time)}
          aria-valuetext={`${fmtTime(time)} / ${fmtTime(duration)}`}
        >
          <div className="relative h-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-on-scrim/20 transition-all group-hover/seek:h-1.5">
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-on-scrim/35" style={{ width: `${bufPct}%` }} />
            <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-primary" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="absolute size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 scale-0 rounded-full bg-primary shadow transition group-hover/seek:scale-100" style={{ left: `${pct}%` }} />
          {hover && (
            <span className="absolute -top-8 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-md bg-black/80 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-on-scrim" style={{ left: hover.x }}>
              {fmtTime(hover.t)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-on-scrim sm:gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={toggle} aria-label={playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
            {playing ? <Pause className="size-5 fill-current" /> : <Play className="size-5 fill-current" />}
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(-10)} aria-label="10 saniye geri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCcw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => seekBy(10)} aria-label="10 saniye ileri" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
            <RotateCw className="size-4" />
          </button>
          <div className="group/vol flex items-center">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => video.current && (video.current.muted = !video.current.muted)} aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              <VolIcon className="size-5" />
            </button>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={1}
              step={0.02}
              value={muted ? 0 : volume}
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (!video.current) return
                video.current.volume = Number(e.target.value)
                video.current.muted = Number(e.target.value) === 0
              }}
              aria-label="Ses seviyesi"
              className="w-0 accent-[var(--primary)] opacity-0 transition-all duration-300 group-hover/vol:w-20 group-hover/vol:opacity-100 focus:w-20 focus:opacity-100"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="ml-1 font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-on-scrim/80 sm:text-xs">
            {fmtTime(time)} / {fmtTime(duration)}
          </span>

          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1">
            {prevHref && (
              <Link href={prevHref} aria-label="Önceki bölüm" className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid">
                <SkipBack className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {nextHref && (
              <Link href={nextHref} aria-label="Sonraki bölüm" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <SkipForward className="size-4" />
              </Link>
            )}
            {subtitleSrc && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setSubsOn((s) => !s)} aria-pressed={subsOn} aria-label="Altyazı" className={cn('grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10', subsOn && 'text-primary')}>
                {subsOn ? <Captions className="size-5" /> : <CaptionsOff className="size-5" />}
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="relative">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} aria-label="Oynatıcı ayarları" className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                <Settings className={cn('size-5 transition-transform duration-500', menu && 'rotate-90')} />
              </button>
              <AnimatePresence>
                {menu && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    className="absolute bottom-12 right-0 w-64 rounded-2xl border border-on-scrim/10 bg-black/90 p-3 text-sm text-on-scrim backdrop-blur-xl"
                  >
                    <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Hız</p>
                    <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                      {SPEEDS.map((s) => (
                        <button
                          key={s}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSpeed(s)
                            if (video.current) video.current.playbackRate = s
                          }}
                          className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs transition', speed === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}
                        >
                          {s}x
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    {subtitleSrc && (
                      <>
                        <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-[9px] text-on-scrim/50">Altyazı boyutu</p>
                        <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                          {(['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const).map((s) => (
                            <button key={s} type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleSize: s })} className={cn('rounded-lg py-1.5 font-mono text-xs uppercase transition', prefs.subtitleSize === s ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'hover:bg-on-scrim/10')}>
                              {s}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setPrefs({ subtitleBg: !prefs.subtitleBg })} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-2 transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
                          Altyazı arka planı
                          {prefs.subtitleBg && <Check className="size-4 text-primary" />}
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
            {pipSupported && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (document.pictureInPictureElement) document.exitPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                  else video.current?.requestPictureInPicture().catch(() => {})
                }}
                aria-label="Resim içinde resim"
                className="hidden size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10 sm:grid"
              >
                <PictureInPicture2 className="size-4" />
              </button>
            )}
            <button type="button" onClick={toggleFullscreen} aria-label={fullscreen ? 'Tam ekrandan çık' : 'Tam ekran'} className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full transition hover:bg-on-scrim/10">
              {fullscreen ? <Minimize className="size-5" /> : <Maximize className="size-5" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\profile\profile-editor.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { ExternalLink, Loader2, Music2, Plus, Save, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { updateProfile, type ProfileInput } from '@/app/actions/profile'
import type { PublicUser } from '@/lib/users'
import { THEMES } from '@/lib/themes'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'
import { MusicSearch } from '@/components/music/music-panel'
import { Card, Toggle } from '@/components/settings/settings-panel'
import { Avatar } from '@/components/shell/user-menu'

const LINK_TYPES = [
  ['discord', 'Discord'],
  ['github', 'GitHub'],
  ['instagram', 'Instagram'],
  ['x', 'X'],
  ['youtube', 'YouTube'],
  ['spotify', 'Spotify'],
  ['twitch', 'Twitch'],
  ['tiktok', 'TikTok'],
  ['steam', 'Steam'],
  ['website', 'Web sitesi'],
] as const

const input = 'h-12 w-full rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

export function ProfileEditor({ user, favorites }: { user: PublicUser; favorites: { id: number; title: string; cover: string | null }[] }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [songPicker, setSongPicker] = useState(false)
  const [favs, setFavs] = useState(favorites)
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProfileInput>({
    displayName: user.displayName,
    username: user.username,
    bio: user.bio,
    location: user.location,
    avatar: user.avatar ?? '',
    background: user.background ?? '',
    backgroundDim: user.backgroundDim,
    accent: user.accent,
    links: user.links,
    song: user.song,
    favorites: user.favorites,
    effects: user.effects,
  })
  const set = <K extends keyof ProfileInput>(k: K, v: ProfileInput[K]) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }))

  function save() {
    start(async () => {
      const res = await updateProfile({ ...form, favorites: favs.map((f) => f.id) })
      if (!res.ok) toast.error(res.error)
      else {
        toast.success('Profil kaydedildi', { action: { label: 'Görüntüle', onClick: () => router.push(`/u/${res.username}`) } })
        router.refresh()
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <Card title="Kimlik" accent="bilgileri">
          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Görünen ad</span>
              <input className={input} value={form.displayName} maxLength={40} onChange={(e) => set('displayName', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Kullanıcı adı</span>
              <div className="flex items-center rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background pl-4 focus-within:border-primary">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">/u/</span>
                <input className="h-12 flex-1 bg-transparent pr-4 text-sm outline-none" value={form.username} maxLength={20} onChange={(e) => set('username', e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_.]/g, ''))} />
              </div>
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm sm:col-span-2">
              <span className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                Biyografi <span className="font-mono text-xs">{form.bio.length}/300</span>
              </span>
              <textarea className="min-h-24 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed outline-none focus:border-primary" value={form.bio} maxLength={300} onChange={(e) => set('bio', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Konum</span>
              <input className={input} value={form.location} maxLength={60} placeholder="İstanbul, TR" onChange={(e) => set('location', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Profil fotoğrafı URL</span>
              <input className={input} value={form.avatar} placeholder="https://…" onChange={(e) => set('avatar', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Görünüm ve" accent="arka plan">
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-5">
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Arka plan (resim veya .mp4 / .webm video URL)</span>
              <input className={input} value={form.background} placeholder="https://…/arkaplan.mp4" onChange={(e) => set('background', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                Karartma <span className="font-mono text-xs">%{form.backgroundDim}</span>
              </span>
              <input type="range" min={0} max={90} value={form.backgroundDim} onChange={(e) => set('backgroundDim', Number(e.target.value))} className="accent-[var(--primary)]" />
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Vurgu rengi</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {THEMES.map((t) => (
                  <button key={t.id} type="button" aria-pressed={form.accent === t.id} onClick={() => set('accent', t.id)} className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-xs transition', form.accent === t.id ? 'border-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-foreground/40')}>
                    <span className="size-4 rounded-full" style={{ background: t.swatch }} />
                    {t.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="divide-y divide-border">
              <Toggle checked={form.effects.tilt} onChange={(v) => set('effects', { ...form.effects, tilt: v })} label="3D eğim efekti" description="Kart fare hareketine göre eğilir." />
              <Toggle checked={form.effects.typewriter} onChange={(v) => set('effects', { ...form.effects, typewriter: v })} label="Daktilo biyografi" description="Biyografi harf harf yazılır." />
              <Toggle checked={form.effects.glow} onChange={(v) => set('effects', { ...form.effects, glow: v })} label="Parlama" description="İsim ve avatar vurgu renginde parlar." />
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Profil" accent="şarkısı">
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
            {form.song ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border p-3">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={form.song.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate font-medium">{form.song.title}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">{form.song.artist}</p>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => set('song', null)} aria-label="Şarkıyı kaldır" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-muted-foreground hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Ziyaretçiler profiline girdiğinde çalacak şarkıyı seç. Adını yaz, bul ve seç.</p>
            )}
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setSongPicker((v) => !v)} className="flex h-11 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary">
              {songPicker ? <X className="size-4" /> : <Music2 className="size-4" />}
              {songPicker ? 'Kapat' : form.song ? 'Şarkıyı değiştir' : 'Şarkı seç'}
            </button>
            {songPicker && (
              <MusicSearch
                pickLabel="Seç"
                pickedIds={[]}
                onPick={(t) => {
                  set('song', { title: t.title, artist: t.artist, url: t.url, cover: t.cover ?? null })
                  setSongPicker(false)
                  toast.success(`"${t.title}" profil şarkısı olarak seçildi`)
                }}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Sosyal" accent="bağlantılar">
          <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
            {form.links.map((l, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-border">
                  {l.type === 'website' ? <ExternalLink className="size-4" /> : <BrandIcon name={l.type} />}
                </span>
                <select
                  value={l.type}
                  onChange={(e) => set('links', form.links.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, type: e.target.value } : x)))}
                  className="h-12 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  aria-label="Bağlantı türü"
                >
                  {LINK_TYPES.map(([v, label]) => (
                    <option key={v} value={v}>
                      {label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <input className={input} value={l.url} placeholder={l.type === 'discord' ? 'kullanıcı adı veya davet linki' : 'https://…'} onChange={(e) => set('links', form.links.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, url: e.target.value } : x)))} aria-label="Bağlantı adresi" />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => set('links', form.links.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} aria-label="Bağlantıyı sil" className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-2xl text-muted-foreground hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" />
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {form.links.length < 8 && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => set('links', [...form.links, { type: 'instagram', url: '' }])} className="mt-3 flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-dashed border-border px-5 text-sm transition hover:border-primary hover:text-ink">
              <Plus className="size-4" /> Bağlantı ekle
            </button>
          )}
        </Card>

        <Card title="Favori" accent="animeler">
          {favs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Anime sayfalarındaki “Favorilere ekle” butonuyla buraya ekleyebilirsin.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-6">
              {favs.map((f) => (
                <li key={f.id} className="group relative">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={f.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={f.title} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-xl object-cover" />
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setFavs(favs.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id))} aria-label={`${f.title} favorilerden çıkar`} className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full bg-scrim/70 text-on-scrim opacity-100 transition sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100">
                    <X className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      <aside className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start">
        <div data-theme={form.accent} className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-border bg-scrim p-6 text-foreground">
          {form.background && !/\.(mp4|webm)(\?|$)/i.test(form.background) && (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img src={form.background || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full object-cover" />
          )}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-scrim" style={{ opacity: form.backgroundDim / 100 }} />
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 p-6 text-center backdrop-blur-xl">
            <span className={cn('rounded-full p-1', form.effects.glow && 'shadow-[0_0_40px_var(--primary)]')} style={{ background: 'var(--primary)' }}>
              <Avatar user={{ username: form.username, displayName: form.displayName, avatar: form.avatar }} className="size-20" />
            </span>
            <p className={cn('text-2xl font-bold', form.effects.glow && '[text-shadow:0_0_20px_var(--primary)]')}>{form.displayName}</p>
            <p className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground/60">@{form.username}</p>
            <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground/75">{form.bio}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {form.links.slice(0, 6).map((l, i) => (
                <span key={i} className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground/10">
                  {l.type === 'website' ? <ExternalLink className="size-3.5" /> : <BrandIcon name={l.type} className="size-4" />}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-center font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-foreground/50">Canlı önizleme</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={pending} className="flex h-14 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-primary font-semibold text-primary-foreground transition hover:brightness-110 disabled:opacity-70">
          {pending ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="size-4" />}
          Değişiklikleri kaydet
        </button>
        <Link href={`/u/${user.username}`} className="flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border text-sm font-medium transition hover:border-primary">
          Profilimi görüntüle <ExternalLink className="size-4" />
        </Link>
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\profile\profile-view.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useMotionValue, useSpring, useTransform } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { CalendarDays, Check, Copy, ExternalLink, Eye, Heart, MapPin, Pause, Pencil, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import type { PublicUser } from '@/lib/users'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { BrandIcon } from '@/components/ui-kit/brand-icon'
import { Avatar } from '@/components/shell/user-menu'
import { fmtTime } from '@/components/music/music-panel'

function Typewriter({ text, enabled }: { text: string; enabled: boolean }) {
  const [out, setOut] = useState(enabled ? '' : text)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return setOut(text)
    let i = 0
    setOut('')
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      i++
      setOut(text.slice(0, i))
      if (i >= text.length) window.clearInterval(id)
    }, 28)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [text, enabled])
  return (
    <span>
      {out}
      {enabled && <span className="ml-0.5 inline-block h-[1em] w-[2px] translate-y-[2px] animate-pulse bg-primary" />}
    </span>
  )
}

const PROVIDER_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { discord: 'Discord ile bağlı', google: 'Google ile bağlı', github: 'GitHub ile bağlı', email: 'E-posta hesabı' }

export function ProfileView({ user, favorites, isOwner }: { user: PublicUser; favorites: { id: number; title: string; cover: string | null }[]; isOwner: boolean }) {
  const [entered, setEntered] = useState(false)
  const [views, setViews] = useState(user.views)
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0)
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null)
  const card = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  const mx = useMotionValue(0)
  const my = useMotionValue(0)
  const rx = useSpring(useTransform(my, [-0.5, 0.5], [9, -9]), { stiffness: 150, damping: 18 })
  const ry = useSpring(useTransform(mx, [-0.5, 0.5], [-11, 11]), { stiffness: 150, damping: 18 })

  const isVideo = Boolean(user.background && /\.(mp4|webm|mov)(\?|$)/i.test(user.background))

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = `sy-viewed-${user.username}`
    if (sessionStorage.getItem(key)) return
    sessionStorage.setItem(key, '1')
    fetch('/api/profile/view', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ username: user.username }) })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j) => j.views && setViews(j.views))
      .catch(() => {})
  }, [user.username])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user.song) return
    const a = new Audio(user.song.url)
    a.loop = true
    a.volume = 0.5
    audio.current = a
    const t = () => setProgress(a.currentTime)
    const m = () => setDuration(a.duration || 0)
    const p = () => setPlaying(true)
    const s = () => setPlaying(false)
    a.addEventListener('timeupdate', t)
    a.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', m)
    a.addEventListener('play', p)
    a.addEventListener('pause', s)
    return () => {
      a.pause()
      a.removeEventListener('timeupdate', t)
      a.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', m)
      a.removeEventListener('play', p)
      a.removeEventListener('pause', s)
    }
  }, [user.song])

  function enter() {
    setEntered(true)
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('sy:pause-music'))
    audio.current?.play().catch(() => {})
  }

  const joined = new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
  const badges = [
    { key: user.provider, label: PROVIDER_LABEL[user.provider], icon: user.provider === 'email' ? null : user.provider },
    ...(user.favorites.length >= 5 ? [{ key: 'collector', label: 'Koleksiyoncu', icon: null }] : []),
    ...(user.song ? [{ key: 'dj', label: 'Profil DJ', icon: null }] : []),
  ]

  return (
    <main data-theme={user.accent} className="dark relative isolate flex min-h-dvh items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-scrim px-4 py-16 text-foreground">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        {user.background ? (
          isVideo ? (
            <video src={user.background} autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="size-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
            <img src={user.background || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
          )
        ) : (
          <div className="size-full bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_35%,var(--scrim))_0%,var(--scrim)_65%)]" />
        )}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-scrim" style={{ opacity: user.background ? user.backgroundDim / 100 : 0.2 }} />
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0" />
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {!entered && (
          <motion.button
            type="button"
            onClick={enter}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, backdropFilter: 'blur(0px)' }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7 }}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-scrim/60 backdrop-blur-2xl"
            aria-label="Profile gir"
          >
            <motion.span animate={{ opacity: [0.4, 1, 0.4] }} transition={{ duration: 2.4, repeat: Infinity }} className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl">
              tıkla ve <span className="font-serif font-normal italic text-primary">gir</span>
            </motion.span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.35em] text-foreground/50">@{user.username}</span>
          </motion.button>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <motion.div
        ref={card}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40, scale: 0.94 }}
        animate={entered ? { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 } : {}}
        transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 120, damping: 18, delay: 0.15 }}
        onMouseMove={(e) => {
          if (!user.effects.tilt || !card.current) return
          const r = card.current.getBoundingClientRect()
          mx.set((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5)
          my.set((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5)
        }}
        onMouseLeave={() => {
          mx.set(0)
          my.set(0)
        }}
        style={user.effects.tilt ? { rotateX: rx, rotateY: ry, transformPerspective: 1000 } : undefined}
        className="relative w-full max-w-[460px]"
      >
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-5 overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/[0.06] px-6 pb-6 pt-10 text-center shadow-[0_40px_120px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] backdrop-blur-2xl sm:px-8">
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-primary to-transparent" />
          <div className={cn('relative rounded-full p-[3px]', user.effects.glow && 'shadow-[0_0_60px_-5px_var(--primary)]')} style={{ background: 'conic-gradient(from 180deg, var(--primary), transparent 40%, var(--primary))' }}>
            <div className="rounded-full bg-scrim p-1">
              <Avatar user={user} className="size-28" />
            </div>
            <span className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 size-4 rounded-full border-[3px] border-scrim bg-primary" aria-label="Çevrimiçi" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
            <h1 className={cn('text-balance text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight sm:text-4xl', user.effects.glow && '[text-shadow:0_0_24px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_70%,transparent)]')}>{user.displayName}</h1>
            <p className="font-mono text-sm text-foreground/55">@{user.username}</p>
          </div>
          <ul className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-1.5" aria-label="Rozetler">
            {badges.map((b) => (
              <li key={b.key} title={b.label} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] text-foreground/80">
                {b.icon ? <BrandIcon name={b.icon} className="size-3.5 text-foreground" /> : <Heart className="size-3 text-primary" />}
                {b.label}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {user.bio && (
            <p className="min-h-12 max-w-sm text-pretty leading-relaxed text-foreground/80">
              <Typewriter text={user.bio} enabled={entered && user.effects.typewriter} />
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-foreground/55">
            {user.location && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <MapPin className="size-3.5" /> {user.location}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <CalendarDays className="size-3.5" /> {joined}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Eye className="size-3.5" /> {views.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} görüntülenme
            </span>
          </div>

          {user.links.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
              {user.links.map((l, i) => {
                const isHandle = l.type === 'discord' && !l.url.startsWith('http')
                const inner = l.type === 'website' ? <ExternalLink className="size-5" /> : <BrandIcon name={l.type} className="size-5 text-foreground" />
                return (
                  <motion.li key={i} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={entered ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : {}} transition={{ delay: 0.5 + i * 0.06 }}>
                    {isHandle ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigator.clipboard.writeText(l.url)
                          toast.success('Discord kullanıcı adı kopyalandı')
                        }}
                        aria-label={`Discord: ${l.url}`}
                        className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_-6px_var(--primary)]"
                      >
                        {inner}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <a href={l.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label={l.type} className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-foreground/5 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_-6px_var(--primary)]">
                        {inner}
                      </a>
                    )}
                  </motion.li>
                )
              })}
            </ul>
          )}

          {user.song && (
            <div className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/40 p-2.5 text-left">
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={user.song.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className={cn('size-12 rounded-xl object-cover', playing && 'animate-[spin_12s_linear_infinite] rounded-full')} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{user.song.title}</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs text-foreground/55">{user.song.artist}</p>
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="h-1 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-foreground/15">
                    <div className="h-full bg-primary transition-[width] duration-300" style={{ width: duration ? `${(progress / duration) * 100}%` : '0%' }} />
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-foreground/50">{fmtTime(progress)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!audio.current) return
                  audio.current.muted = !muted
                  setMuted(!muted)
                }}
                aria-label={muted ? 'Sesi aç' : 'Sesi kapat'}
                className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full text-foreground/70 transition hover:bg-foreground/10"
              >
                {muted ? <VolumeX className="size-4" /> : <Volume2 className="size-4" />}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => (playing ? audio.current?.pause() : audio.current?.play())}
                aria-label={playing ? 'Duraklat' : 'Oynat'}
                className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
              >
                {playing ? <Pause className="size-4" /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {favorites.length > 0 && (
            <div className="w-full">
              <p className="label-mono mb-2 text-left text-[9px] text-foreground/50">Favori animeler</p>
              <ul className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {favorites.slice(0, 8).map((f) => (
                  <li key={f.id}>
                    <Link href={`/anime/${f.id}`} className="group block overflow-hidden rounded-xl ring-1 ring-foreground/10">
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img src={f.cover || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={f.title} className="aspect-[2/3] w-full object-cover transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-110" />
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href)
              setCopied(true)
              window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600)
            }}
            className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/40 px-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-foreground/70 backdrop-blur transition hover:text-foreground"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="size-3.5 text-primary" /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" />}
            sytheris/u/{user.username}
          </button>
          {isOwner && (
            <Link href="/profil" className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
              <Pencil className="size-3.5" /> Düzenle
            </Link>
          )}
          <Link href="/" className="flex h-10 items-center rounded-full border border-foreground/10 bg-scrim/40 px-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground/80 backdrop-blur transition hover:text-foreground">
            SYTHERIS
          </Link>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </main>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\providers\app-providers.tsx =====
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { Toaster } from 'sonner'
import { MusicProvider } from '@/components/music/music-provider'
import { PreviewProvider } from '@/components/anime/preview-provider'
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from './theme-provider'

function ErrorReporter() {
  useEffect(() => {
    let sent = 0
    const report = (message: string, stack?: string) => {
      if (sent > 5) return
      if (/ResizeObserver|Script error|youtube|chrome-extension/i.test(message + (stack ?? ''))) return
      sent++
      fetch('/api/log', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message, stack, path: location.pathname }),
        keepalive: true,
      }).catch(() => {})
    }
    const onError = (e: ErrorEvent) => report(e.message, e.error?.stack)
    const onRejection = (e: PromiseRejectionEvent) => report(String(e.reason?.message ?? e.reason), e.reason?.stack)
    window.addEventListener('error', onError)
    window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', onRejection)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('error', onError)
      window.removeEventListener('unhandledrejection', onRejection)
    }
  }, [])
  return null
}

function ThemedToaster() {
  const { dark } = useTheme()
  return (
    <Toaster
      theme={dark ? 'dark' : 'light'}
      position="top-center"
      toastOptions={{
        classNames: {
          toast: '!bg-popover !text-popover-foreground !border-border !rounded-2xl !font-sans',
          description: '!text-muted-foreground',
        },
      }}
    />
  )
}

export function AppProviders({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode; introEnabled?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <MusicProvider>
        <PreviewProvider>
          {children}
          <ThemedToaster />
          <ErrorReporter />
        </PreviewProvider>
      </MusicProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\providers\theme-provider.tsx =====
'use client'

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom'
import { THEME_IDS, themeHex, type ThemeId, type ThemeMode } from '@/lib/themes'

type Ctx = {
  theme: ThemeId
  mode: ThemeMode
  dark: boolean
  setTheme: (id: ThemeId, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => void
  setMode: (m: ThemeMode, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => void
}

const ThemeCtx = createContext<Ctx | null>(null)

function systemDark() {
  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
}

function withTransition(apply: () => void, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const doc = document as Document & { startViewTransition?: (cb: () => void) => { ready: Promise<void> } }
  const reduce = document.documentElement.classList.contains('reduce-motion') || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  if (!doc.startViewTransition || reduce) {
    apply()
    return
  }
  const x = origin?.x ?? window.innerWidth / 2
  const y = origin?.y ?? 0
  const r = Math.hypot(Math.max(x, window.innerWidth - x), Math.max(y, window.innerHeight - y))
  const t = doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply))
  t.ready
    .then(() => {
      document.documentElement.animate(
        { clipPath: [`circle(0px at ${x}px ${y}px)`, `circle(${r}px at ${x}px ${y}px)`] },
        { duration: 650, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)', pseudoElement: '::view-transition-new(root)' },
      )
    })
    .catch(() => {})
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<ThemeId>('green')
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>('system')
  const [dark, setDark] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = (localStorage.getItem('sy-theme') as ThemeId) || 'green'
    const m = (localStorage.getItem('sy-mode') as ThemeMode) || 'system'
    setThemeState(THEME_IDS.includes(t) ? t : 'green')
    setModeState(m)
    setDark(document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'))
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
    const onChange = () => {
      if ((localStorage.getItem('sy-mode') || 'system') === 'system') {
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', mq.matches)
        setDark(mq.matches)
      }
    }
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]')
    if (meta) meta.setAttribute('content', themeHex(theme))
  }, [theme])

  const setTheme = useCallback((id: ThemeId, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    withTransition(() => {
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = id
      localStorage.setItem('sy-theme', id)
      setThemeState(id)
    }, origin)
  }, [])

  const setMode = useCallback((m: ThemeMode, origin?: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    withTransition(() => {
      const d = m === 'dark' || (m === 'system' && systemDark())
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', d)
      localStorage.setItem('sy-mode', m)
      setModeState(m)
      setDark(d)
    }, origin)
  }, [])

  return <ThemeCtx.Provider value={{ theme, mode, dark, setTheme, setMode }}>{children}</ThemeCtx.Provider>
}

export function useTheme() {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider')
  return ctx
}


===== DOSYA: components\random\random-spinner.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { AnimatePresence, animate, motion, useMotionValue } from 'motion/react'
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ArrowRight, Loader2, Shuffle, Star } from 'lucide-react'
import type { MediaCard } from '@/lib/anilist-types'
import { GENRE_LIST, formatTr, genreTr, pickTitle, splitTitle, stripHtml } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { fetchRandomPool } from '@/app/actions/random'

const CARD = 168
const GAP = 16
const STEP = CARD + GAP
const REEL = 48

export function RandomSpinner({ initialPool }: { initialPool: MediaCard[] }) {
  const [pool, setPool] = useState(initialPool)
  const [genre, setGenre] = useState('')
  const [reel, setReel] = useState<MediaCard[]>(() => initialPool.slice(0, 12))
  const [spinning, setSpinning] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<MediaCard | null>(null)
  const x = useMotionValue(0)
  const viewport = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  async function changeGenre(g: string) {
    setGenre(g)
    setLoading(true)
    const next = await fetchRandomPool(g || undefined)
    setLoading(false)
    if (next.length) {
      setPool(next)
      setReel(next.slice(0, 12))
      x.set(0)
      setResult(null)
    }
  }

  async function spin() {
    if (spinning || !pool.length) return
    setResult(null)
    setSpinning(true)
    const winner = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]
    const filler = Array.from({ length: REEL }, () => pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)])
    const targetIndex = REEL - 6
    filler[targetIndex] = winner
    setReel(filler)
    x.set(0)
    await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => r(null)))
    const width = viewport.current?.clientWidth ?? 800
    const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * CARD * 0.6
    const target = -(targetIndex * STEP) + width / 2 - CARD / 2 + jitter
    await animate(x, target, { duration: 4.6, ease: [0.12, 0.7, 0.08, 1] })
    await animate(x, -(targetIndex * STEP) + width / 2 - CARD / 2, { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 22 })
    setSpinning(false)
    setResult(winner)
  }

  const title = result ? pickTitle(result.title) : ''
  const { head, tail } = splitTitle(title)

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-10">
      <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
        {['', ...GENRE_LIST].map((g) => (
          <button
            key={g || 'all'}
            type="button"
            disabled={spinning}
            aria-pressed={genre === g}
            onClick={() => changeGenre(g)}
            className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition disabled:opacity-50', genre === g ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink')}
          >
            {g ? genreTr(g) : 'Tümü'}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="dark relative isolate overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-border bg-scrim py-10 text-foreground">
        <div className="grain absolute inset-0 -z-10" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-10 w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-scrim to-transparent sm:w-48" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-10 w-24 bg-gradient-to-l from-scrim to-transparent sm:w-48" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-8 z-20 h-[268px] w-[184px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-3xl border-2 border-primary shadow-[0_0_60px_-10px_var(--primary),inset_0_0_40px_-20px_var(--primary)]" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-0 z-20 -translate-x-1/2 border-x-[10px] border-t-[14px] border-x-transparent border-t-primary" />
        <div ref={viewport} className="overflow-hidden">
          <motion.ul style={{ x }} className="flex w-max" aria-hidden={spinning}>
            {reel.map((m, i) => (
              <li key={`${m.id}-${i}`} style={{ width: CARD, marginRight: GAP }} className="shrink-0">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={m.coverImage.extraLarge || m.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" className="aspect-[2/3] w-full rounded-2xl object-cover" draggable={false} />
              </li>
            ))}
          </motion.ul>
        </div>
        <div className="relative z-20 mt-10 flex justify-center">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={spin}
            disabled={spinning || loading}
            className="group flex h-14 items-center gap-3 rounded-full bg-primary px-8 text-lg font-semibold text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_10px_50px_-10px_var(--primary)] transition hover:scale-[1.03] active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-70"
          >
            {spinning || loading ? <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" /> : <Shuffle className="size-5 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:rotate-180" />}
            {spinning ? 'Çark dönüyor…' : result ? 'Tekrar çevir' : 'Çarkı çevir'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {result && (
          <motion.section
            key={result.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 220, damping: 24 }}
            className="grid items-center gap-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-primary/40 bg-card p-6 sm:p-10 md:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]"
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
            <img src={result.coverImage.extraLarge || result.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt={title} className="mx-auto aspect-[2/3] w-44 rounded-3xl object-cover shadow-2xl md:w-full" />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <p className="label-mono text-ink">Kaderin seçimi</p>
              <h2 className="text-balance text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.02] tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">
                {head} <span className="accent-serif">{tail}</span>
              </h2>
              <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {result.averageScore ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-ink">
                    <Star className="size-4 fill-current" /> {result.averageScore}%
                  </span>
                ) : null}
                {[result.seasonYear, formatTr(result.format), result.episodes ? `${result.episodes} bölüm` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                {result.genres?.slice(0, 3).map((g) => (
                  <span key={g} className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs">
                    {genreTr(g)}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </p>
              <p className="line-clamp-3 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{stripHtml(result.description)}</p>
              <Link href={`/anime/${result.id}`} className="group mt-2 flex h-12 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 font-medium text-primary-foreground">
                Detaylara git <ArrowRight className="size-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" />
              </Link>
            </div>
          </motion.section>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\schedule\schedule-view.tsx =====
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { ScheduleItem } from '@/lib/anilist'
import { formatTr, pickTitle } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const TZ = 'Europe/Istanbul'
const dayKey = (ts: number) => new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: TZ })

export function ScheduleView({ items }: { items: ScheduleItem[] }) {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(Date.now() / 1000)
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now() / 1000), 30000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [])

  const days = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ScheduleItem[]>()
    for (const it of items) {
      const k = dayKey(it.airingAt)
      if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, [])
      map.get(k)!.push(it)
    }
    return [...map.entries()].slice(0, 8)
  }, [items])

  const todayKey = dayKey(Date.now() / 1000)
  const [active, setActive] = useState(todayKey)
  const current = days.find(([k]) => k === active) ?? days[0]

  if (!days.length) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">Takvim şu an yüklenemedi.</p>

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0" role="tablist" aria-label="Günler">
        {days.map(([k, list]) => {
          const d = new Date(`${k}T12:00:00`)
          const isActive = k === current?.[0]
          return (
            <button
              key={k}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={isActive}
              onClick={() => setActive(k)}
              className={cn('relative flex shrink-0 flex-col items-start rounded-2xl border px-5 py-3 text-left transition', isActive ? 'border-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary/50')}
            >
              {isActive && <motion.span layoutId="day" className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 rounded-2xl bg-primary" transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 34 }} />}
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{k === todayKey ? 'Bugün' : d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { weekday: 'long' })}</span>
              <span className={cn('font-mono text-[11px]', isActive ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                {d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} · {list.length}
              </span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <ol className="relative flex flex-col gap-3 border-l border-border pl-6 sm:pl-8">
        {current?.[1].map((it) => {
          const aired = now > 0 && it.airingAt <= now
          const time = new Date(it.airingAt * 1000).toLocaleTimeString('tr-TR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: TZ })
          return (
            <li key={it.id} className="relative">
              <span className={cn('absolute -left-[31px] top-7 size-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background sm:-left-[39px]', aired ? 'bg-muted-foreground/40' : 'bg-primary shadow-[0_0_12px_var(--primary)]')} />
              <Link href={`/anime/${it.media.id}`} className={cn('group flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-3 transition hover:border-primary sm:gap-6', aired && 'opacity-60')}>
                <span className="w-14 shrink-0 font-mono text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums sm:w-16 sm:text-xl">{time}</span>
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img src={it.media.coverImage.large || '/placeholder.svg'} alt="" loading="lazy" className="h-20 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block truncate font-medium group-hover:text-ink">{pickTitle(it.media.title)}</span>
                  <span className="mt-1 block text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Bölüm {it.episode}
                    {it.media.episodes ? ` / ${it.media.episodes}` : ''} · {formatTr(it.media.format)}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className={cn('hidden rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider sm:inline', aired ? 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' : 'bg-accent text-ink')}>{aired ? 'Yayınlandı' : 'Yakında'}</span>
              </Link>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ol>
    </div>
  )
}


===== DOSYA: components\search\search-filters.tsx =====
'use client'

import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { GENRE_LIST, genreTr } from '@/lib/format'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const SORTS = [
  ['POPULARITY_DESC', 'Popülerlik'],
  ['TRENDING_DESC', 'Trend'],
  ['SCORE_DESC', 'Puan'],
  ['START_DATE_DESC', 'En yeni'],
  ['FAVOURITES_DESC', 'Favori'],
] as const
const FORMATS = [
  ['', 'Tüm formatlar'],
  ['TV', 'TV'],
  ['MOVIE', 'Film'],
  ['ONA', 'ONA'],
  ['OVA', 'OVA'],
  ['SPECIAL', 'Özel'],
] as const
const STATUSES = [
  ['', 'Tüm durumlar'],
  ['RELEASING', 'Yayında'],
  ['FINISHED', 'Tamamlandı'],
  ['NOT_YET_RELEASED', 'Yakında'],
] as const
const SEASONS = [
  ['', 'Tüm sezonlar'],
  ['WINTER', 'Kış'],
  ['SPRING', 'İlkbahar'],
  ['SUMMER', 'Yaz'],
  ['FALL', 'Sonbahar'],
] as const

const selectCls = 'h-11 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-4 text-sm outline-none transition focus:border-primary'

export function SearchFilters() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const params = useSearchParams()
  const [pending, start] = useTransition()
  const [q, setQ] = useState(params.get('q') ?? '')
  const years = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => new Date().getFullYear() + 1 - i)

  const update = (patch: Record<string, string>) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString())
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(patch)) {
      if (v) next.set(k, v)
      else next.delete(k)
    }
    next.delete('page')
    start(() => router.push(`${pathname}?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false }))
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if ((params.get('q') ?? '') !== q.trim()) update({ q: q.trim() })
    }, 450)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [q])

  const genre = params.get('genre') ?? ''
  const active = ['q', 'genre', 'year', 'season', 'format', 'status', 'sort'].some((k) => params.get(k))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-5 top-1/2 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Anime adı ara…"
          aria-label="Anime adı"
          className="h-16 w-full rounded-full border border-border bg-card pl-14 pr-14 text-lg outline-none transition focus:border-primary focus:shadow-[0_0_0_4px_color-mix(in_oklch,var(--primary)_18%,transparent)]"
        />
        {pending && <Loader2 className="absolute right-6 top-1/2 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-ink" />}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <select aria-label="Sıralama" className={selectCls} value={params.get('sort') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ sort: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="">Sırala: Varsayılan</option>
          {SORTS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              Sırala: {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Format" className={selectCls} value={params.get('format') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ format: e.target.value })}>
          {FORMATS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Durum" className={selectCls} value={params.get('status') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ status: e.target.value })}>
          {STATUSES.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Sezon" className={selectCls} value={params.get('season') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ season: e.target.value })}>
          {SEASONS.map(([v, l]) => (
            <option key={v} value={v}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select aria-label="Yıl" className={selectCls} value={params.get('year') ?? ''} onChange={(e) => update({ year: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="">Tüm yıllar</option>
          {years.map((y) => (
            <option key={y} value={y}>
              {y}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {active && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQ('')
              start(() => router.push(pathname, { scroll: false }))
            }}
            className="flex h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition hover:text-destructive"
          >
            <X className="size-4" /> Temizle
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
        {GENRE_LIST.map((g) => (
          <button
            key={g}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={genre === g}
            onClick={() => update({ genre: genre === g ? '' : g })}
            className={cn('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm transition', genre === g ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:text-ink')}
          >
            {genreTr(g)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
